articleTitle: A smart roadside parking navigation system based on sensor networks for ITS
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: To solve the serious problem of hard deployment and high power waste in existing roadside parking system of intelligent transportation system (ITS), a smart roadside parking management system based on sensor networks is presented in this paper. Every node in sensor networks is small and low-power and it can identify parking space automatically by sensing the disturbances in the Earth's magnetic field. To further reduce power waste, nodes can sleep periodically. The node can be waked up by internal microcontroller to collect parking lot information and communicates with other sensor nodes. The system consists of the infrastructure of intelligent transportation system and experiment data shows that it can deal with the existing problems efficiently.

articleTitle: A novel low-profile, dual-band, dual-polarization broadband array antenna for 2G/3G base station
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, a novel dual-band broadband array antenna with low profile and dual polarization is proposed and developed. The array is formed by arc-probe-fed annular ring elements and pairs of cross microstrip dipoles nested together. The bandwidth of the annular ring antenna is improved through arc-probe-fed technique. The measured impedance bandwidths determined by VSWR≪2 cover 806∼960 MHz and 1710∼2170MHz. The port isolation and the symmetry of the radiation for the lower band are improved by the “anti-phase and dual-feed” technique which also reduces the cross polarization level. The influences on the radiation patterns of upper band caused by the phase error are invested and the radiation patterns are improved through the phase compensation. In the end, the array is designed and the simulated and measured results are presented. The proposed array antenna is highly applicable to the base station of multi-band operations.

articleTitle: A novel cluster formation algorithm for wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Recent years have witnessed an increasing interest in using wireless sensor networks (WSNs) in many applications, including health monitoring, military and national security, environmental monitoring, and many other fields. In these applications, tiny sensors with limited energy resource are deployed and left unattended to continuously report parameters such as temperature, pressure, humidity, light, and chemical activity. Once deployed, the tiny sensor nodes are usually inaccessible to the users. Therefore, energy efficiency is an important design issue that needs to be enhanced in order to prolong the effective lifetime of a network with a limited energy supply. Clustering technique has been proven to be an effective approach for organizing wireless sensor network into a connected hierarchy. Nodes that are clustered together can easily be able to communicate with each other. In this paper, we describe a novel cluster formation algorithm for wireless sensor networks according to considering the energy as an optimization parameter while clustering is imperative. We illustrate the algorithm for clustering the sensor nodes such that each cluster (which has a cluster head) is balanced and the total energy consumption between sensor nodes and cluster heads is minimized. Balancing the clusters is needed for evenly distributed the load on an all cluster heads. This problem is modeled and then gives the solution and simulation result to it.

articleTitle: Low crest mapping for PAPR reduction in OFDM systems
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) has several properties which makes it an attractive modulation technique for High Speed Data Transmission. However one major disadvantage of OFDM is that the time domain OFDM signal which is a sum of several sinusoids leads to a high Peak-to-Average Power Ratio (PAPR). High PAPR can cause Non Linear Distortion of the signal at the Transmitter (In-band and out-of-band distortion). Number of Techniques have been proposed in the literature for the reduction of the high PAPR of the OFDM signal. But most of these techniques are unable to achieve simultaneously a large reduction in PAPR, with low complexity, with low coding overhead and without performance degradation. In this paper a new technique ‘Low Crest Mapping (LCM)’ is proposed for Reduction of PAPR in OFDM Systems. This new technique is a simple and novel one without any increase in Bandwidth and no in-band and out-of-band distortions apart from its simplicity. Simulation results show a considerable reduction in the PAPR when the Low Crest Mapping (LCM) is applied to a sample of Four/Eight Sub carriers with BPSK Modulation.

articleTitle: High quality 0.6/1.2/2.4kbps multi-band LPC speech coding algorithm
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, a new 0.6/1.2/2.4kbps multi-band LPC speech coder is presented. To improve speech quality and reduce the bit rate, a multi-mode residual multistage matrix quantization is developed. Other new techniques for improving the performance include pitch smooth and gain-shape vector quantization for gain quantization. Experimental results show that the speech quality of the proposed speech coder is intelligible with good naturalness.

articleTitle: Modified decision feedback equalizer (DFE) for sparse channels in underwater acoustic communications
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: A modified adaptive decision feedback equalizer (DFE) is proposed to exploit fully the long sparse channels in high-speed underwater acoustic digital communications. Based on the relationships between the optimal feedforward filter, feedback filter (FBF) on the one hand and the channel impulse response on the other hand, influence of the precursor with different strength on the FBF is analyzed. The results show that only a few tap coefficients are significant in case of sparse channels. We give a fairly detailed theoretical analysis on how to predict the positions of these significant taps. Our modified DFE only works on the predicted significant taps. Comparing with the conventional DFE, the computational load of our modified DFE is greatly reduced with only a very small cost in performance. Our modified DFE has also another advantage of faster convergence since it needs only to work on considerably fewer tap coefficients. Computer simulations on sparse channel measured at sea confirm the above advantage of our modified DFE over the conventional DFE.

articleTitle: Energy balanced transmission range adjustment in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Recent studies show the capacity of WSNs can be significantly increased when the nodes can have variable transmission ranges. It is well known that in wireless sensor networks (WSNs), the network lifetime can be prolonged by using energy efficiently and keeping as more sensors alive as possible. This can be achieved by balancing the sensors' energy consumption. In this paper, the trade-off between the energy balance and energy efficiency is considered in a linear sensor network with variable transmission ranges. To cope with the trade-off between the energy balance and energy efficiency, a non-linear optimization problem is formulated to find the optimal route nodes and their various transmission ranges. Numerical results show the presented scheme can achieve energy consumption balance and high efficiency at the same time.

articleTitle: IPTV and coding technology
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: IPTV is one of the most important services and components of NGN. To ensure good QoS of IPTV in various kinds of networks, and to minimize developing cost, an efficient coding technology must be adopted. This paper related the principle of IPTV with the characteristics and principle of H.264, suggested that H.264 would be an advisable coding technology for IPTV.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of orthogonal space-time block coding with reduced-complexity antenna selection
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Orthogonal space-time block codes (OSTBCs) is an attractive technique of 3G and 4G in wireless communication, which can achieve a full rate with more than two transmit antennas at the expense of losing some degree of diversity and increasing the decoding complexity. One simple method for improving the array gain and adapting OSTBCs to any number of transmit antennas is antenna selection, where the OSTBC is transmitted on a subset of the transmit antennas. In the paper, we present OSTBCs with reduced-complexity antenna selection and analyze its symbol-error rate (SER) performance. Finally we present numerical examples and simulation results. It shows that considerable improvement in average SER is achieved and the cost and complexity is decreased.

articleTitle: WLAN emulation on StarBED
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper we present the Wireless LAN (WLAN) emulator that we design to run on StarBED, the large scale network experiment environment of the Hokuriku Research Centre in Ishikawa, Japan. As WLANs start to spread on an ever wider scale, the need to investigate application deployment on WLANs has become stringent. We develop an emulation environment since it allows using in experiments the real applications that will be deployed in practice. In addition, it offers full control of the network conditions in which the applications will be tested. Our approach is user-oriented in the sense that the input of the system is a user-level scenario representation. This is subsequently converted into a quality degradation description that represents the effect the network will have on application traffic. Finally, the quality degradation description is transformed into an emulator configuration that is effectively used in the emulation environment to enforce network quality degradation on the application traffic.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a Wireless Personal Area Network based on AODVjr routing
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: This paper presents a scheme for an intellectualized Wireless Personal Area Network (WPAN) based on a simplified Ad hoc On-demand Distance Vector [1] routing (AODVjr) and IEEE802.15.4 technologies. The design of the network focuses on improving performance in adaptive routing and flexible management. The experimental data show that the network is robust and reliable in practical applications.

articleTitle: Routing with congestion control using cross-layer design in wireless mesh network
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Wireless mesh network (WMN) is an innovative approach in packet radio networks. Routing is one of key challenging issues since the unpredictable behaviours of the medium and the network topology. In this paper two statistical MAC layer parameters are explored: available residual bandwidth and Frame Transmission Efficiency (FTE). A metric called Degree of Congestion Control is defined so that the routing algorithm can effectively search the better quality path with least congestion towards the final destination. A novel routing protocol called Least Congestion QoS-aware Routing (LCQSR) using cross-layer design approach is proposed to achieve a good trade-off between QoS aware and network performance based on DSR. The simulation results show that the protocol can improve the performance of network congestion effectively in terms of delay, packet delivery ratio and throughput.

articleTitle: A home security Zigbee network for remote monitoring application
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Security monitoring systems are popular in home automation, and Zigbee is a new industrial standard wireless sensor networks. This paper introduces an experimental home security monitoring and alarming system based on Zigbee technology, it is capable of monitoring door & window magnetic contact, smoke, gas leak, water flooding, providing simple controls such as turning off the valves, and sending the alarms to the residential area security network etc. The security alarming system is based on Zigbee chip MC13192 and low power consumption micro-controller MSP430F135. A description of the system architecture, circuit principle and the firmware flowchart is presented. The system uses a control key fob for activating and de-activating the alarm easily, supports Web interface so that user can access the system remotely to control, search or review the history record, and offers a LCD panel for simple configuration. The experimental system has been designed and its wireless communication test result shows that the Zigbee wireless network can improve the home security with low power and easy to implement solution.

articleTitle: Implementing a wireless portable healthcare monitoring system for physiological signals
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Design and development of a novel healthcare shirt for wireless monitoring of physiological signals was studied in this paper. The vital signals of ECG, blood pressure and body temperature are measured by sensors embedded in the shirt. The clothing structure can facilitate the attachment of the measuring device. The electrical signals are digitized by a single chip MCU (MSP430F169) and are recorded in Flash ROM. The patient' ID information is also written in Flash ROM and is also transmitted in every information data packet. The biomedical information is automatically sent to a personal digital assistant (PDA, HP iPAQ FA675A) by a Bluetooth module and then will be transmitted to the medical centre or the patient's doctor by WLAN. The PDA embedded with Bluetooth, WiFi and WINCE OS is selected as the mobile device platform. An expansion compact flash card is used for the GPRS application of PDA. The application program written in Delphi served as web server page in the medical centre for the patients' database and communication to the PDA. The patient's vital signals and chart will be automatically displayed in the doctor's screen with one kind of Bluetooth, WiFi and GPRS. The proposed system was demonstrated to promote the mobility and flexibility for both the patients and the medical personnel, which further improves the quality of healthcare.

articleTitle: A simple broadband MIMO channel sounder prototype
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: To obtain channel characteristic and provide references for China B3G system design, we design a simple channel sounder of 2Tx and 2Rx MIMO system. Engineering parameters of the sounder have been analyzed in this paper. The example of the measurement campaigns performed in indoor by the sounder is given.

articleTitle: Implementation of fountain codes over fading channels
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Fountain codes are a class of rateless codes. In this paper, the design and construction of Luby Transform (LT) codes, the first efficient class of Fountain Codes with fast encoding and decoding algorithms, is presented with new simulation results evaluating their performance over the Rayleigh fading channel. The degree distribution used in the design of LT codes is also described briefly. The results show that LT codes perform well over a fading channel with increasing erasure boundary size, but also with increasing complexity and bandwidth use.

articleTitle: Web application performance analysis based on comprehensive load testing
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Web application performance analysis plays an important role in quantifying Web application's QoS and designing the server's configuration. This research paper presents a performance analysis method based on comprehensive load testing by running a series of load testing on the client side while resource consuming is also performed on the server side. A performance model is then built based on these test results, which gives us a method to quantify and analysis system performance. We applied this method on a typical Web application system. By comparing the results with other traditional load testing methods, we have proven the feasibility, accuracy and efficiency of this method.

articleTitle: Performance of current digital pulse modulation schemes for optical wireless communications
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, the performance of current digital pulse modulation schemes for optical wireless communications was examined by simulation, and we concluded that PPM is suitable for long distance optical wireless communication systems especially for military use due to its best power efficiency and also suitable for optical wireless communication systems working near sea surface; DPIM and DH-PIM are suitable for normal outdoor applications, for example, being used in city or suburb, for its moderate performance and no need of symbol-level synchronization; MPPM is especially suitable for indoor optical wireless communication systems with diffused channel due to its best bandwidth efficiency.

articleTitle: An agent-based multimodal user interfaces middleware for ubiquitous computing environments: Intelligent exhibition hall
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: With the development of emerging technologies, lots of ubiquitous computing environments will be established in the near future. In those environments like intelligent exhibition hall services should be provided intelligently and initiative while users may want to utilize the same services and get the same information content on all available devices. Therefore we propose and agent-based multimodal user interfaces middleware to solve the problem. Agents have to learn users' preferences and context information to offer them suitable services. Multiple user interfaces on different devices are provided as well.

articleTitle: An implementation of LVS-based highly-available Radius server
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The goal of Linux Virtual Server (LVS) is to provide a basic framework to build highly available and scalable network services such as Radius authentication and accounting in our implementation. Scalability is achieved by transparently inserting or removing a node in the cluster, and high availability is supported by detecting node or daemon failures and reconfiguring the system appropriately. This article, rather than proposing a new cluster technique, illustrates the basic concept of LVS, an implementation of LVS-based highly-available Radius server, and the performance testing and analysis of the whole system by a testing software named testrad developed by us. Through the benchmarks, we can conclude that the performance of the system can linearly increase along with the increasing number of the real servers before the director gets fully-loaded. Thus, it can provide high availability and scalability for network services.

articleTitle: Beamforming for MIMO systems with limited feedback
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Beamforming and power allocation at the transmitter are both effective means to improve the performance of multiple input multiple output (MIMO) system. They are both dependent on the channel state information (CSI). We propose a scheme including optimal beamforming and power allocation in which the CSI at the transmitter is obtained through limited feedback. Two codebooks of beamforming matrices and power allocation vectors are constructed offline and both known by the transmitter and the receiver. Using the MMSE criterion, we choose the optimal variables from the codebooks. The data to convey to the transmitter are the indexes of the variables. We validate the proposed scheme by computer simulations from which we see the scheme can achieve a fine performance with several bits of feedback.

articleTitle: Design of an intelligent transportation system based on GPS and GPRS
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The design of an intelligent transportation system which bases on GPS and GPRS is advanced. In this system GPS information, vehicle, GPS and traffic light information are transmitted by means of GPRS wireless network to traffic control center, and finally the traffic control center displays above information and sends commands control to all the subsystems. In this paper we introduce the whole structure of this system, including hardware components and software framework, and analyze the implementation of the key technology and the performance of the system. This system has much good performance such as high speed of the transportation of the data, high precision, real time and good reliability.

articleTitle: Generalized quasi-cyclic LDPC codes for wireless data transmission
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: While in wired access networks meeting packet error requirements requested by the applications are simplified by the stability of the channel conditions, in the case of wireless networks, this is not the case. Especially for real-time applications using User Datagram Protocols (UDP) for fast, unordered and unacknowledged delivery of packets, reliability is greatly compromised. Low Density Parity Check (LDPC) codes are especially suitable for wireless applications as they exhibit near-capacity performance. In this paper we demonstrate a generalized LDPC design, which covers a large family of LDPC codes. The new generalized LDPC codes are defined by a small number of parameters. The proposed LDPC codes cover a large set of code lengths and rates, which can be used for transmission of different types of data over wireless channels. Furthermore performance of these codes, under iterative decoding algorithm, compares well with other well-structured LDPC codes such as BIBD and array LDPC codes as well as pseudo-random LDPC codes.

articleTitle: Research on two UWA frequency-hopped spread-spectrum communication methods in low sonic energy condition
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Correlation, balance, power spectrum and multi-address of m sequence and chaotic sequence based on two-dimension mapping have been studied comparatively. An underwater acoustic (UWA) communication frame utilizing frequency-hopped spread-spectrum (FH-SS) technology in low sonic energy condition is proposed. Realization method of coding and decoding has been brought forward. The feasibility of two methods in UWA communication has been verified by outfield experiment, and satisfactory results have been obtained.

articleTitle: An improved NLOS error mitigation TOA reconstruction method
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In recent years, wireless location techniques have gained much attention. In general, the performance of mobile location systems is limited mainly by errors primarily caused by non-line-of-sight propagation (NLOS). In order to mitigate the NLOS influence on the location accuracy, an improved TOA reconstruction method based on ring of scattering model is proposed in this paper. By using this method, the influence of the NLOS error can be reduced noticeably, as demonstrated by our simulation under different channel environments. In particular, compared with other algorithms, the proposed method can significantly improve the location accuracy under bad channel environments.

articleTitle: A novel seamless handoff mechanism for MPLS multicast
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, a novel mechanism of mobile seamless handoff based on MPLS multicast is proposed on the basis of analyzing handoff latency combining Hierarchical MIPv6 (HMIPv6) and Fast MIPv6 (FMIPv6). By searching the cross LSR with an effective and simple method, we rebuild the LSP from it to new access router and create dynamic buffer on the cross LSR. So we could minimize LSP path that need to be rebuilt and number of lost package may be deceased. With these measures, fast seamless handoff based on MPLS multicast could be realized.

articleTitle: Perturbation analysis of regularized ESPRIT for noncircular signal direction finding with one solitary acoustic vector-sensor
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this contribution, the perturbation analyses of both the norm-penalized regularized ESPRIT and the subspace-constraint regularized ESPRIT devised for single-acoustic-vector-sensor direction finding of multiple noncircular signals are provided. It is shown that the norm-penalized regularized ESPRIT is biased (but bounded) and have a minimum mean-squared-error (MSE) for some finite regularization factor whereas the subspace-constraint regularized ESPRIT is unbiased and its MSE approaches minimum when the regularization factor becomes infinite. This observations are potentially useful for the determination of regularization parameters. Simulation results are also given to validate the analyses.

articleTitle: Research and design of english mobile learning system based on J2ME
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In order to improve learning flexibility and efficiency, and break the constraints of time and space, an English mobile learning system based on J2ME was proposed and realized in the paper. The structure of system, realization process and key technologies of J2ME system structure, XML analyzing, Data transmission between mobile terminal and Web server were introduced in the paper. XML language was the middleware to realize data exchange and processing for isomerism system. HTTP protocol was used to communicate etween Internet website and mobile terminal. The system was also used in some network school, the results manifested that the system could support E-learning better. Thus, we thought it might be a practical solution to realize self-learning and self-promotion in the lifelong education age.

articleTitle: Research of universal home gateway architecture and its functions
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: This paper proposes home network, which is extension of broad band network to home and an important composing part of NGN, and home gateway, which is the core of home network. The paper analyzes architecture of universal home gateway from hardware and software architecture. Functions of universal home gateway are analyzed and researched deeply from five sides, which include access function, interconnect function, transmission function, core function and service function.

articleTitle: A practical one-time password authentication implement on internet
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: A one-time password authentication protocol is proposed which can be used by common Internet users and services providers. The protocol is simple to implement and secure for common applications without additional hardware involved. Static password is used widely in conventional authentication. In the light of a threat of guessing attacks, a strong secret should be shared by communication participants. But the strong password is too hard to remember and easily eavesdropped by adversaries when transferred on-line. One-time password technology can counter replay attack resulted from eavesdropping. But existing one-time password schemes is too complicated to be accepted by common Internet users. The proposed protocol is simple to implement and secure for common Internet appliance without additional hardware involved. It is an improved version of challenge/response one-time password mechanism.

articleTitle: A new route optimization algorithm for nested NEMO
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In NEMO (Mobile Network) research, route optimization for nested mobile networks is one of the major challenges. So we propose a new route optimization algorithm for nested NEMO in this paper. Its basic idea is to integrate NEMO with MANET (Mobile Ad hoc Networks) to eliminate nesting when several mobile networks are attached together. In other words, a mobile router acts as an ad hoc node when it wants to select an Access Router (AR) in foreign link, so that it can select the fixed foreign router as its AR directly even there's multi-hop between them. Evaluation results show that our approach has little additional communication cost and almost has no influence on the current protocols. Furthermore, our scheme has good adaptability to fast handoff scenario. We also discussed other issues such as address assignment, router advertisement in the framework of our algorithm.

articleTitle: Joint interference cancellation technique for STBC-OFDM system under fast fading channel
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Under fast fading time-variant channel, the orthogonality between sub-carriers of orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) system is destroyed resulting in inter-carrier interference (ICI). In multiple input multiple out orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (MIMO-OFDM) system, due to interference from different antennas, another interference, co-channel interference (CCI) exists. Both interferences make the performance of MIMO-OFDM system degrade under fast fading channel. A novel joint interference cancellation technique is proposed in this paper for space-time block coded orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (STBC-OFDM) system to suppress the ICI and CCI at the same time to improve the system performance.

articleTitle: Blind despreading of BOC signal in the radio-navigation satellite system
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Binary Offset Carrier (BOC) modulation is considered for the modernized military GPS and the European Navigation System Galileo. The way of BOC signal blind despreading can be deducted from the way of BPSK. Taking the advantage of the carrier correlation of civil and military signals, carrier synchronization can be got before chip synchronization, so that the baseband signal is got which is easier to estimate the PN code. Noticing the frequency dual sides of BOC signals, the upper side band and lower side band can be separated and combined together to raise the signal-to-noise ratio for non-coherent integration. At the same time, signal can be down sampled to the rate of PN code for the relationship between the subcarrier and the PN code, that is to say, the PN code can be estimated directly ignoring the subcarrier, which simplifies hardware implementation. Experiment and simulation results show that this proposed “dual side bands combine-downsample-eigenanalysis” arithmetic can provide a good estimation to BOC signal, even in low SNR.

articleTitle: A new secure authentication scheme based threshold ECDSA for mobile ad hoc networks
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Security is an important issue for mobile ad hoc networks (MANETs), especially for security-sensitive application. In this paper, we advance the threshold ECDSA authentication scheme, and construct a new way to choose distributed CAs severs of threshold authentication scheme. Our simulation results and analysis show that our scheme can reduce effectively bandwidth and computation resources while providing a highly secure, robust and highly available authentication service.

articleTitle: Design of FFT processor for OFDM-based UWB communication system
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The FFT processor is used for OFDM-based UWB wireless communication system. 64/128 points FFT is employed in the processor by using mixed-radix algorithm to meet the requirement of different UWB systems. The FFT processor, using the pipelined parallel structure, the register reusing architecture and the shift-add algorithm, can reach a device utilization of 100% and a 500MS/s throughput rate(FPGA based), which meets the specification of UWB system.

articleTitle: An efficient method for carrier phase ambiguity resolution in GPS attitude determination
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Integer ambiguity resolution is a key problem of GPS attitude determination system. A modified ambiguity resolution method based on LAMBDA is proposed in the paper. First, regularized least-squares algorithm is used in the float value estimation, and LAMBDA algorithm is applied in the ambiguity search to improve search efficiency. Then, baseline length information is used to reduce the number of epochs required for ambiguity resolution. Finally, a modified ratio test is proposed to assure the correct integer ambiguity to be chosen.

articleTitle: SIM card based e-cash applications in the mobile communication system using OTA and STK technology
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In the coming era of e-commerce and m-commerce, the payment becomes one of concerns for both customers and vendors. Various of payment systems have been proposed for this manner. The electronic payment schemes, e-cheque and e-cash, are the most popular ways. The SIM cards for mobile handset provide the capacity of authentication, memorization, and development so as to be used for e-cash applications. In this paper, we implement the e-cash over The Air(OTA) and tool kit(STK) technology to establish the flows of including the function of e-remission, e-ATM, e-payment, and e-account-transferring.

articleTitle: Simplified transceiver design for multi-user OFDM communication system using convex optimization
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, we consider a multi-user Single-Input-Single-Output (SISO) communication system which employs Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) and zero-forcing equalizers. We use convex optimization techniques to substantially simplify our early designs of multi-user transceivers which were based on solving a Semidefinite Programming (SDP) subproblem in each iteration [1]. In particular, we use OFDM structure to transform the SDP subproblems into Second Order Cone Programming (SOCP) problems, resulting in simple diagonal multi-user transceiver designs. Such a transformation has led to a substantial reduction in the computational complexity. Computer simulations through SeDuMi software show that the devised transceivers have much more superior mean square error performance than the existing transceivers.

articleTitle: A 12-bit 125-MHz segmented current-steering DAC for communication application
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: A 12-bit 125-MHz digital-to-analog converter (DAC) for communication application is designed. It is based on current-steering segmented architecture and modified Q<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> random walk switching scheme to obtain 12-bit accuracy. A new voltage swing reduced driver (VSRD) is implemented to promote the dynamic performance. The DAC uses 0.18 µm 1.8 V standard digital CMOS technology. The die area (core) is 2.7 × 2.1mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and power consumption is 37.1mA.

articleTitle: Joint optimization of routing and scheduling for higher throughput in IEEE 802.16 mesh networks
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Wireless mesh networks are emerging to be a promising technique for the next generation wireless networks. Specifically, the MAC layer in IEEE Standard 802.16-2004 supports mesh mode. In this paper, an optimal scheduling scheme is proposed to increase the network throughput. The problem of finding the maximum network throughput in the optimal scheduling scheme can be formulated as an integer linear problem. Meanwhile, a minimal interference routing algorithm is introduced to improve the network throughput by reducing the interference among the links. Furthermore, the simulation results show that the combination of the optimal scheduling scheme and the minimal interference routing algorithm can achieve significant improvement in the throughput performance.

articleTitle: On the connectivity and reliability of the large-scale wireless sensor network with the percolation
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: This paper investigates the critical connectivity phenomena in the large-scale wireless sensor network with continuum percolation theory. We analyze the critical number of nodes and critical transmit radius that above which the network is fully connected. The impact of node reliability on network connectivity is also studied and discussed. Our results are of practical value for the design and simulation of wireless sensor networks.

articleTitle: Joint routing, MAC, and link layer optimization in virtual MIMO sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, joint routing, MAC and link layer optimization based on virtual MIMO techniques in wireless sensor networks (WSNs) is studied. The minimum energy consumption as well as the optimum routing, MAC and link layer parameters are obtained by this cross-layer optimization. For the purpose of approaching the realistic system model, we extend the single source node into multiple source nodes, and analyze the optimal routing of minimizing total energy and transmission energy with or without the link adaptation in detail. The energy efficiency of different systems is also compared.

articleTitle: Design of variable-rate adaptive LDPC codes for DVB-S2 applications
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Both constant and variable Forward Error Correcting (FEC) coding is provided by the DVB-S2 system[ 11]. Variable FEC can be used to provide different levels of error protection according to applications, & may be combined with the use of return channels, to achieve Adaptive Coding. The novel idea explained in this paper, introduces an algebric method for construction of well-structured Low Density Parity Check (LPDC) codes, enabling the system to switch between LDPC codes of different rates (9/10, 8/9, 5/6, 4/5,…) and perform FEC based on the required level of error protection. In this scheme instead of using different parity check matrices for the different code rates, LDPC codes of different rates are derived by structurally modifying a mother parity check matrix. It is different from the rate-compatible [8] code construction in the sense that the H-Matrix used for different code-rates is independent of the H-matrices used for all other code-rates in the set.

articleTitle: Performance of LDPC-Coded interleave-division multiple-access (IDMA) system
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper regular (3,6) LDPC codes is applied to IDMA system (called as LDPC-Coded IDMA system) and performance comparison between IDMA systems based on LDPC Codes and based on convolutional codes is completed over different transmitting environments without power attribution. Simulation results show that the system purposed by this paper owns excellent capacity of multiple access similar to the latter system and can acquire greater coding gain relative to the latter system through short and middle frame transmitting over three channels at the bit error rate (BER) level of 10{−3} and 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−6</sup> when the number of users is 16. Thus higher quality data services get ensured through the front system. Meanwhile this indicates voice service may be supported better by the front system over short frame transmission once the delay of receiver hardware is further reduced.

articleTitle: A solution of hybrid TCP transmission in RFID reader network
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: A new solution about hybrid transmission in RFID reader network, based on the wireless and wired channel characteristics, is purposed. The framework and critical approaches are analyzed in detail. Being different from the tradition TCP mechanism, the new wireless and wired TCP mechanism (W2-TCP) is presented in the solution. W2-TCP adequately utilizes the wireless and wired channel parameters respectively to evaluate exactly the channel status to modulate the data packet sending mechanism. Experiments show that the solution does improve highly the performance of data transmission and save largely the energy of mobile RFID readers.

articleTitle: Video transcoding for wireless gateway system
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper we study the problem of accessing video streams through handheld devices and wireless networks. We first review and discuss the major technologies of video transcoding. Then, we introduce a wireless video transcoding gateway system to handle the heterogeneous mobile devices and the smallness capability of the handheld devices. To gain higher video quality and lower complexity, we propose an efficient video transcoding structure based on close-loop model and a fast motion vector re-estimation algorithm. Based on this, we design a novel service scheme, which can provide better video content access service on current mobile communication systems. Moreover, we implement a test prototype of MPEG2-to-H264 transcoding system and simulate the video streams access service in a wireless LAN.

articleTitle: IEEE 802.11 WLAN load balancing using adaptive antennas and cooperative controls
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: This paper extends our recent researches on using intelligent agents to improve 802.11 WLAN systems performance. Agent-controlled semi-smart antennas and multi-agent systems are proposed. The use of agent negotiation and cooperatively change antennas' radiation patterns can significantly improve overall data rates for WLAN users, especially for geographically non-uniform distributed users (so called “hot spot” traffic). Distributed agents can negotiate with each other resulting mutual changing radio patterns to re-balance traffic at hot spot area. The simulation has taken multi-path effects into consideration, as most WLAN systems are deployed in in-door environment. Simulation results show significant overall system performance improvement over traditional configurations. A network planning tool is used to create path loss models based on building structures and floor plans. The design and building of prototype semi-smart antennas and their control units are also discussed.

articleTitle: Client-class based admission control for distributed Video-on-Demand systems
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Admission control is one important Quality of Service (QoS) mechanism for maintaining performance of streaming media service. The focus of this paper is to analyze the client-class based admission control scheme for distributed Video-on-Demand (VoD) systems. In order to assure specific QoS, clients are classified into K priority classes based on their contributions in terms of profits, and blocking probabilities of different client classes are calculated through the recursive algorithm. Also the paper presents an adaptive threshold policy based on client request time to better improve the resource usage. Numerical analysis shows that the client with higher priority does have more chances of accessing the video server resources, thus maximizing the system's profits.

articleTitle: A design of RFID tag antenna based on bowtie
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The design rules of RFID tag antenna are presented at first. Both operating principle and attribute of bowtie are briefly introduced secondly. Then, two bowtie tag antennas operated at 915MHz band are analyzed and designed. Simulation results show that both dimension and S11 of the two proposed bowtie tag antennas are smaller than those of the current tag antennas reported, the bandwidth of the two proposed bowtie tag antennas is about twice that of the half-wave dipole at 915MHz band, and the performance of the fan bowtie antenna is better than that of the general triangle bowtie antenna. The experimental results are also in good consistency with the simulation results.

articleTitle: Mitigating intercarrier interference by rotating received symbols in OFDM communication systems
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: For intercarrier interference (ICI) due to frequency offsets, this paper studies an ICI self-cancellation scheme for combating the impact of ICI on OFDM systems. Its basic idea is symbols rotation and interference self-cancellation. At the transmitter, original symbols are mapped into one special symbol block, and then it is transmitted as a conventional OFDM system. Received signals are divided into two paths at the receiver. The each sampled data of the received signal at one path is multiplied by relevant sub-carriers, respectively. Later, these results are subtracted from those of the relevant signal at another path, and then the resultant signals are demodulated to obtain the estimation of original data symbols as a conventional OFDM system. Analysis results show that the ICI contained in the received signals can be effectively reduced by using the scheme, and the Carrier-to-Interference power Ratio (CIR) of the scheme is obviously better than that of a conventional scheme and another similar scheme. Similarly, simulation results show Bit Error Rate (BER) performance of the scheme is better than that of two other schemes.

articleTitle: A fast signal reconstruction algorithm from wavelet transform modulus maxima
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Based on the wavelet multiscale analysis theory, a fast signal reconstruction algorithm from its wavelet transform modulus maxima(WTMM) is presented here. The WT coefficients in each scale are reconstructed by using monotone piecewise cubic Hermite interpolation polynomial between two modulus maxima points. If the signs of two neighborhood modulus maxima are the same, we add a new interpolation point between them. This method has explicit physical meaning. It is less complex and can be implemented conveniently. Numerical results show that the proposed reconstruction approach is effective and to a better solution than the algorithm in [1] and [5].

articleTitle: Link delay inference based on Simulated Annealing constrained optimization method
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: With the rapid development of the network, it is necessary to know its internal characteristics, so to design, control and manage the network. At present, network measurement is mainly deployed to acquire internal characteristics of the network and identify network topology. Network Tomography technology is one of the network measurement methods. Inference of network internal link characteristics is a very important to Network Tomography technology. On the basis of traditional methods used to infer link delay characteristics in Network Tomography, we propose a new method based on Simulated Annealing constrained optimization to improve the precision of inference of link delay cumulant generating functions by gathering the constrained information in network. The simulation results show that with measurement error, our constrained optimization method infers link delay more precisely than non-constrained ones do.

articleTitle: Framework and access technology for integration between WLAN and B3G
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The paper discusses the significance and development foreground of integration between wireless local area network (WLAN) and B3G mobile cellular network in composite radio context. The concept of composite reconfigurable wireless network is introduced in the paper, and the development of future wireless communication systems is also discussed. The basic configuration framework of network interoperation is given, and the functions of important parts are analyzed. We propose a management platform for co-operation between WLAN and cellular network, adding several models to the original systems. In this paper, the solutions to network access problems for two types of mobile terminals (MTs), i.e. reconfigurable MTs and non-reconfigurable MTs, are also discussed. So particularly, the flow chart and the main programs for reconfigurable MTs with 3G registration accessing to WLAN are drawn. Then the access method and detailed processes for non-reconfigurable MTs without 3G registration are also shown.

articleTitle: The optimization and real-time implementation of G.729A codec on TMS320C5510
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Three layer optimizations in algorithm, DSP programming and compiling respectively for G.729A codec and real-time implementation on TMS320C5510 DSPs is described. A new algorithm is proposed for calculating line spectrum pair parameters with higher accuracy and less executing time consumption. The outstanding solutions of DSP programming and compiling optimizations for real-time implementation are also introduced. The optimal codes with different techniques are implemented and tested on TMS320C5510 DSPs. The test results of the optimal codes with DSP/BIOS programming show that the encoding and decoding are correct, real-time proceeding and computing delay is much smaller than the required minimum delay, the whole performance of G.729A codec is much improved.

articleTitle: Spontaneous sensor networks for context-aware computing
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: This paper analyzes context awareness for pervasive computing. In terms of context acquisition, it classifies context as three types: provided context, sensed context and derived context. Based on the context types and considering sensor networks and spontaneous networks, a new network, spontaneous sensor network, is proposed and discussed.

articleTitle: Antenna Design for Long Range 13.56MHz RFID Reader
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Antenna is the most important device to extend the working range of long range 13.56MHz radio frequency identification (RFID) system. Methodology of field strength calculation, bandwidth decision and common mode noise compensation is proposed to obtain better antenna performance. A new antenna driving method is proposed to remove blind area caused by in-phase and out-of-phase complementary antennas and realize all vertical orientation recognition of tags. Both the formulation and simulation results are given to explain the advantage of this method.

articleTitle: Optimization of transmit-antenna selection / equal gain transmission in Rayleigh fading channels
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper we investigate a scheme combining transmit-antenna selection (TAS) and equal gain transmission (EGT). The expected received SNR of the proposed systems is derived according to the probability distribution of channel fading. The algorithm of determining the minimum of required RF chains is put forward in terms of a given transmit antennas. A new phase quantization algorithm of optimum precoding vector was given, which has low complexity and can adapt the transmission rate of feedback channel. Simulation results demonstrate the superiority of the proposed systems. Comparing with 8 diversity EGT systems, the proposed systems only require 5 RF chains instead of 8 ones. In this case, the proposed algorithm with 4 bits phase quantization can mostly approach optimal performance. Therefore, the algorithm with more than 5 bits is meaningless for performance improvent.

articleTitle: An efficient intra-frame prediction algorithm based on autocorrelation for H.264/AVC
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: H.264/AVC is the latest video coding standard with high compression efficiency. Due to its time-consuming, it cannot meet the real-time application requirements. In this paper, an efficient algorithm was proposed based on autocorrelation according to the feature of Intra-frame prediction. In this algorithm, each macroblock is predicted before coding, and one of the two prediction modes is selected. As a result of this processing, coding time has been reduced dramatically. Experimental results show that the coding time of proposed algorithm is 26.9% less than that of H.264/AVC, at the expense of little quality degradation..

articleTitle: A Modified EKV Model for RF Application
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: This paper presents a RF MOST model using the EKV model which has been initially developed for the design and analysis of low-voltage, low-current analog circuits. Since most MOSFET models are generated for digital and low-frequency analog design, a RF MOSFET model with the consideration of the HF behavior is necessarily and urgently needed for RF design. A modified EKV model is presented in this paper, with some extrinsic components used for predicting the RF characteristics of the device. The extraction procedure of model parameters is provided. Measured result from a 0.25 µm RF CMOS process with simulated result show the validity of the model.

articleTitle: A novel WiMAX patch antenna
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: It is well known that conventional microstrip antennas have drawback of narrow bandwidth. In this paper, we propose a novel WiMAX patch antenna in crisscross shape operating at 3.5GHz. To design a broad band antenna, a shorting pin is embedded in each arm of the crisscross and two triangles are cut out from the end of each arm. The shorting pin also helps the reduction of resonant frequency. The measured return loss of this antenna is less than -15dB when the operation frequency band is in the range of 3.4GHz to 3.6GHz. Further details for the design of the antenna and the experimental results are presented in the paper. Especially, the simulation has been made to investigate the effects of the position of the shorting pins and the triangles to the performance of the patch antenna.

articleTitle: A dynamic and scalable security framework for ad-hoc sensor network
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Ad-hoc network is a well known autonomous mobile system connected by distributed wireless nodes, in which each one is free to move or join and without any fixed infrastructure. Providing a comprehensive security model for Ad-hoc network is a bit hard, although some specific solutions have been proposed recently. In this paper, we firstly introduce a threshold signature approach and a distributed slave certificate based trust membership management scheme, and then present a novel security framework, which is effectively integrated with forenamed two methods and is fully dynamic and scalable for member-sporadic Ad-hoc network groups. Finally, the model analysis and a conclusion is described.

articleTitle: Using XML to implement Attribute-Based Delegation
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In existing information systems, a delegation means a user who can assign his/her permissions to someone. In these information systems, however, the delegation security depends entirely on delegations and system administrators, for delegation constraint in delegation is only a prerequisite role. This paper proposes an Attribute-Based Delegation Model (ABDM) with an extended delegation condition consisting of both delegation attribute expression (DAE) and delegation prerequisite role (CR). In ABDM, a delegator can restrict the delegatee candidates more strictly, thus relieves delegator and system administrator of security management workload in delegation. To implement ABDM in a web or distributed environment, XML is employed to represent all kinds of data used in delegation, such as user, permission, role, delegation attribute expression, prerequisite role and other delegation constraints. An implementation architecture of ABDM is also given in this paper.

articleTitle: R-AODV: Rate aware routing protocol for WiFi mesh networks
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Multi-rate mechanism is adopted widely in wireless communication systems, such as WiFi mesh networks. Most of routing protocols which are employed in Ad Hoc networks use minimum hop-count as a performance metric to select the routing path, such as AODV, DSR, etc. These routing protocols are not effective in WiFi mesh networks. Rate aware routing protocol based on AODV (R-AODV) uses minimum network layer transmission time as a performance metric. The calculation method of network layer transmission time is given in this paper. Nodes will select higher data rate link using R-AODV. The simulation result indicates that R-AODV can improve the network throughput and decrease network delay.

articleTitle: An error recovery scheme for satellite direct-to-home reliable multicast communication
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: A new error recovery scheme for satellite direct-to-home (DTH) multicast communications is proposed in this paper. With the aid of XOR encoding and decoding, the new error recovery scheme can recover several damaged packets in one retransmission. Moreover, an optimal retransmission algorithm based on retransmission matrix preprocessing is designed to minimize the number of retransmissions. The onboard buffering and processing contribute to alleviating the influence of long propagation delays of the GEO satellite links, reducing the recovery time by half of the RTT. Analysis and simulation results show the efficiency of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Human behavior analysis and its application to a pervasive computing security system
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In recent years, the research on intelligent environment based on pervasive/ubiquitous computing technology has attracted more and more attention, especially in security, such as KidsRoom by MIT AI Lab and SmartLab System. In this paper, we illustrate an intelligent security system based on a Human-Centered Pervasive Computing system model which is proposed in the view of engineering. When strange person intrudes into the surveillant environment, this system can detect his activities, analyze his behaviors, and send out alert messages. Six simple human behaviors can be recognized which are walking, standing, sitting, squatting, leaning and lying. We design the security system based on pervasive computing and propose the implementation methods step by step.

articleTitle: Minimizing energy with a risk based temperature monitoring protocol for wireless digital sensor network
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Though there had been many proposals to managing or saving energy for distributed sensors in wireless sensor network, we tried in a different dimension so as to enable the current available methods can benefit from our research. Our proposal reduces the communication volume with risk estimation, where historical sensing data was recorded and PERT technique had been involved. Since the monitoring sites are distributed with long distance in the sea and it is impossible to connect them with lines across the sea, all monitoring sites are connected with a wireless network. The historical temperature data from each sensor network was recorded in the central control machine. Since the temperature data is consecutive changing data, the historical data is supposed to be distributed in the curve of Gaussian. The probability of the temperature changes for each monitoring sites are analyzed and the involved interval is decided. Here in this paper, several formulas are proposed and the interval is analyzed so as to determine the suitable interval with the tradeoff between the communication volume and the possible of mission the temperature sensing. The dynamic temperature data is used to adjust the distributing function so as to match the environment adaptively. The research work has been evaluated with a simulation, and the results showed that the communication volume reduced significant while there was very little delay of temperature change. The protocol turned out to be effective and efficient in energy saving.

articleTitle: Amalgamating RFID and wireless networks for clinical path management
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The clinical path is the organization and sequencing of patient care interventions for a specified procedure. This paper introduces a holistic system, which amalgamates RFID and wireless networks for managing hospitalization process of patients. Re-engineering the treat paths for both surgery and delivery treatments are studied while implementing the RFID. The advantage and efficiency after the deployment of RFID are discussed.

articleTitle: Scheduling multicast and unicast traffic in buffered crossbar switches
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Multicast traffic exhibits an increasing proportion of traffic on the Internet. In order to support multicast scheduling, most of the presented multicast scheduling schemes are originated from traditional scheduling schemes based on crossbar switches. Due to the traffic expansion of multicast replication, they are still unpractical and unscalable. In this paper, we propose a low-cost multicast scheduling (LCMS) scheme based on buffered crossbar switches. In this scheme, both multicast and unicast traffic can be simultaneously supported in a single buffered crossbar fabric without any additional switch module. Furthermore, LCMS is a distributed scheme, the arbitrations of it can be implemented on each input and each output independently and in parallel, hence is more practical and scalable. The simulation results also verify a good performance of the LCMS scheme.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of antipodal CSK communication system in a noisy multiuser environment
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: To provide a quantitative description for noisy multiuser performance of digital communications with chaos, this paper presents an effective approach to analyzing the noisy multiuser performance of an antipodal chaos-shift-keying system with a coherent correlator. Using a Logistic map as the discrete chaos generator, the BER is derived in terms of the signal-to-noise ratios, the number of users and the length of chaotic sequence. The BER and its upon bound for single-user systems are the special cases of the multiuser system. The calculated BERs are consistent with those found from simulations.

articleTitle: Evaluation and removal of EMI between ECG monitor and GSM mobile phones
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The electromagnetic interference (EMI) can influence the working of most medical equipment, cause malfunction, and make the doctor have erroneous diagnosis. The electrocardiogram (ECG) monitor is an important way to determine people's health, but it would be interfered with the EMI even when people using wireless phone. We study the relation between the position of antenna and the electric-field intensity what is produced by GSM mobile phone. Moreover we record the field strength when changing the distance. Besides, in order to research how much the GSM phone can influence the detection of the ECG signal, we take many methods, such as electromagnetic shielding, analogue-filter, the whole coefficient band-pass or low-pass filter and self-adapting filter. Furthermore, we design the experiments and sample those related data. Basing on the frequency spectrum analysis to the experimental data, we compare those methods and get their different feature.

articleTitle: QoS routing algorithm used in k-fold multicast Ad Hoc network
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, On basis of analysis the characteristic of the Ad Hoc network, we have introduced a k-fold multicast network. This new network architecture can reduce the cost of the system and the energy. We researched the change situation of the node connection degree in this network and designed a workload balance algorithm. The simulation result indicated this algorithm can control the congestion well and increase the network stability.

articleTitle: Compact dual-band slot antenna for WLAN applications
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, we present the investigations on a compact dual-band slot antenna for 802.11a/b/g wireless applications. The antenna is composed of two orthogonal slots and the size of ground plane is about 50mm × 20mm. In this way the antenna can be easily integrated in one circuit board with other electric circuits as a whole. To understand the characteristics of the proposed antenna, the influences of different geometric parameters on the antenna resonant frequency is investigated. The simulated and measured results show that the proposed antenna can completely cover both 2.4/5 GHz bands with satisfactory radiation characteristics for 2.4/5 GHz indoor wireless applications.

articleTitle: A new source route algorithm of communication network
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: For the source route algorithm of network based on the calculation of the shortest route in graph theory, it is difficult to satisfy the requirement of the network reliability analysis, route centralizing layout and management and network future development because the optimal route of the current network state can be obtained according to the special parameters, but all the route can not be obtained, what's more, the complex calculation must be performed again when the parameters are changed. In this paper, a new source route algorithm based on logic algebra is studied, which is fit for all kinds of topology network. For a network with n nodes, all the routes between any two nodes expressed through symbols can be obtained after n time matrix transformation. The validity and rationality of the algorithm are discussed and the compatibility and superiority of the algorithm for the classical Dijkstra and Bellman-Floyd algorithm are introduced. The calculating course of the algorithm is illuminated and the correctness is validated through an example

articleTitle: URNS: A new name service for uniform network resource location
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Name and resource location are critical in large-scale distributed system. Currently the Internet uses Domain Name System (DNS), however there are some problems. It is host-centric, unsuitable for increasingly data and services location; it finishes only one level of name resolution which coverts domain names into IP addresses, not adapt in heterogeneous network environment; it maintains a static database, not support for fast update. On the other hand, peer-to-peer (P2P) overlay routing provides a decentralized and dynamic solution, but it is lack of control and organization, not suitable for global and uniform deployment. This paper describes the design and implement of the Uniform Resource Name System (URNS), a novel name service, which provides dynamic and fast update, uniform resource location for miscellaneous services in heterogeneous network environment, and a transition from legacy DNS. The most important novelty and contribution compared to other implements is that our new system aims to increasingly data, services and new devices for the next generation Internet. Our small-scale implement proved its feasibility of functions, and the simulation shows that with more nodes joining the URNS, the lookup cost and the lookup failure rate will decrease in miscellaneous services and heterogeneous network environment.

articleTitle: A novel hybrid Operating System dedicated to Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The Operating Systems (OS) dedicated to Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) are becoming an important research topic in recent years. This kind of OS has two natures: the resource-aware design and the wireless routing capability. This paper presents a Novel Hybrid Operating System (NHOS) dedicated to WSN. It consists of two parts: a hybrid real-time micro-kernel: LIMOS (LIghtweight Multi-Threading Operating System); a dedicated hybrid wireless protocol stack: CIVIC (Cooperative Inter-Vehicle Intelligent Communication). LIMOS combines the advantages of TinyOS and SDREAM. It has tiny resource consumption and supports the distributed real-time multi-thread applications. CIVIC is a context-aware routing protocol which is implemented to support the infrastructure and ad-hoc network, the hybrid MANET protocol and the multi-support wireless access mediums. This paper demonstrates the key features of NHOS.

articleTitle: Analysis on connectivity of inter-orbit-links in a MEO/LEO Double-Layer Satellite Network
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: As an important scheme of future global mobile satellite communication systems to provide multimedia service, a Double-Layer Satellite Network (DLSN) with MEO satellites and LEO satellites is proposed. The Inter-Orbit-Links (IOLs) between layers is an essential factor, which affects performances of the DLSN systems. In this paper, considering certain constellation parameters, geometric characteristics of IOLs are described and the connectivity of MEO satellites and LEO satellites in the DLSN is analyzed. By computer simulation, results show that IOLs should be selectively established according to certain parameters rather than the simple in-sight principle.

articleTitle: Algorithm of nonlinear compensation in OFDM systems
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In recent years, there has been increasing interest in OFDM (orthogonal frequency division multiplexing) applying to the mobile communication system in terms of considering its various advantages in combating the severe effects of the frequency selective fading. However, the OFDM system suffers from the strong sensitivity to the nonlinear distortion, introduced by the transmitting high power amplifier (HPA), since the OFDM system has the high peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR). Based on the analyzation of some classic nonlinear compensation methods, we propose a new approach to compensate the nonlinearity in this paper. Its performance is verified through computer simulations. Specifically, the enhanced performance in terms of the bit error rate (BER) is documented for the solid state power amplifier (SSPA) HPA model.

articleTitle: A new method for ultra wideband channel modelling based on ray-tracing
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, a new technique is presented combining wideband channel modelling techniques with the latest computer graphic functionality, which enables interactive channel simulation and dynamic coverage estimation for system design and development. This technique is currently developed with focus on baseband Ultra Wideband (UWB) systems operating above 3.1GHz. The channel model generated by this technique eliminates the need for two simplifying assumptions in the IEEE802.15.3a model, thus creating a more accurate depiction of the channel than the purely statistical approach. By employing very simple 3D models and structures, the cluster centres are found without assuming a delay-invariant arrival rate or a constant relative variance for fading. The delay profile is generated using a new progressive tracing algorithm that eliminates full traces of the less likely paths. Texture-based reflection and refraction patterns are other advantages of this approach.

articleTitle: Intelligent time synchronization in sensor network
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Much time critical applications, require a real-time clock with an accuracy of microseconds. In a centralized system it is easy to implement the requirements, but in a distributed system, this is more difficult as there is no global system tick. Synchronizing the local clocks of all nodes with a sufficient accuracy can solve this problems. This paper compares recent clock synchronization protocols on the sensor network and get some conclusions.

articleTitle: A novel array formed by diamond antennas with high isolation for base station applications
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: A novel linear array formed by diamond antennas with low profile and high isolation is developed and studied experimentally in this paper. The array can provide unidirectional patterns with a HPBW (Half-Power Beam Width) of 65±6° in azimuth plane and more than 15dBi peak gain in 1710–2170MHz with VSWR≪1.5. The antenna consists of five dual-polarized array elements named “four-diamond” antenna. The isolation of two different polarized input ports of the array can be enhanced to −30dB by employing some isolation enhancement technologies. A dual-polarized broadband linear array is fabricated and the measured results are presented. The proposed array antenna is suitable for the GSM1800, CDMA1900 and ITU's IMT-2000 base station applications.

articleTitle: Combined impacts of IQ imbalance from both transmitter and receiver in OFDM systems
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The combined impact of IQ imbalance from both the transmitter and the receiver in an OFDM system is analyzed mathematically and depicted graphysically. It is shown that when the amplitude imbalance is rather big and the angular imbalance is rather small, the actual impacts of IQ imbalance is under-estimated if only considering the receiver's IQ imbalance, otherwise the actual impacts is over-estimated when only the receiver's IQ imbalance is considered.

articleTitle: Heterogeneous sensor networks with effect of small world
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, a heterogeneous sensor network with effect of small world (SW_HSN) is built on the super links consisting of the super nodes with more energy and processing capability. A routing policy is put forward in this network, and an analytical grid model is developed in order to analyze the gain in path length reduction and energy saving by using the super links. The innovative point consists in adopting the Genetic Algorithm (GA) to optimally deploy the super links for obtaining the optimal energy efficiency. The results reveal that adding a few appropriate super links to a wireless sensor network can evidently reduce the average energy expenditure per sensor node. In a network with 11×11 dimension, the path length reduction and energy saving reaches at 50–70% with 4–12 super links, depending on the location of the sink.

articleTitle: A hierarchical IP/MPLS wide area multicast architecture
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Multicast has been widely accepted as the effective scheme to deal with multimedia services. For wide area multicast, it is unavoidable to have communication among several administrative domains. At this time, the fact that different multicast routing policies are adopted in different domains becomes a serious problem. Current multicast architecture does not have enough scalability and is not suitable for the whole Internet. In this paper, we present a hierarchical IP/MPLS multicast architecture which can solve this problem.
