Inter-domain routing mechanism and label aggregation algorithm are proposed to support this method. We compare global IP multicast architecture with our hierarchical IP/MPLS method architecture and demonstrate that the performance penalty for the hierarchical organization of multicast is small. At the same time, it enables the composition of different administrative networks, each with its own independent multicast protocol and administrative policy. It is also scalable and flexible for both the service providers and multicast users to adopt multicast services by using their networks.

articleTitle: Fast intra mode selection algorithm for MPEG-2-to-AVS transcoding
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: AVS (Audio Video Coding Standard), the latest multimedia coding standard developed by AVS Working Group of China, employs many new techniques. Compared with MPEG-2, which only supports DC intra prediction, AVS adopts complicated intra prediction modes in pixel domain, which result in a high computational load for MPEG-2-to-AVS transcoding. In this paper, we propose a novel algorithm to fast select intra mode utilizing the energy distributing properties of DCT coefficients decoding from MPEG-2. Based on the analysis of intra prediction in transform domain, we select the best intra mode according to the relation between different energy groups of DCT coefficients. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm decreases the complexity while maintaining similar performance.

articleTitle: Performance analysis on Ka-band multi-model single channel angle tracking system
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Ka-band angle tracking system is a significant part on satellite. The precision of tracking receiver directly influence the quality of link. This paper analyzes the performance of multi-model single channel angle tracking system. It expatiates envelop detection theory and introduces synchronous detection. It simulates each scheme and gets useful results. After comparing the two schemes, it suggests using synchronous detection instead of envelop detection on beaconing tracking. It also analyzes the major factors influencing system performance. The simulation results can be used as reference in real engineering applications.

articleTitle: An intelligent wireless bus-station system dedicated to disabled, wheelchair and blind passengers
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The urban public transportation systems are usually not appropriate for disabled, wheelchair and blind passengers (DWB). This paper introduces the MobiPlus system that aims at improving the public transportation service so as to meet the needs of DWB. The MobiPlus system is an intelligent wireless bus-station interactive system with the integration of multi-wireless techniques (RFID, ZIGBEE, WiFi, and GPS). It consists of three subsystems: DWB detection subsystem, wireless communication subsystem, and bus service subsystem. This paper presents the design of the MobiPlus wireless interactive system at different levels, such as hardware, software and protocol, and also gives the function description of its three subsystems. Currently, this system has been implemented and is under evaluation at Clermont-Ferrand city, France.

articleTitle: Efficient Mobile IP registration from pairings
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Mobile IP will be used to provide the macro-mobility in the B3rd/4th generation mobile communication. When providing security, Mobile IP registration should also take account of the efficiency requirements of the mobile communication. This paper devotes to the problem of improving both the security of the Mobile IP registration and the efficiency including the latency, the throughput and the security cost. Our method integrates the symmetric cryptosystem with the ID-based non-interactive key agreement from parings. Further, the authentication in Mobile IP registration is optimized. Security and performance analyses show that our scheme is both secure and efficient.

articleTitle: A new adaptive equalization algorithm in multiple antenna systems
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, a reduced complexity adaptive decision feedback equalization scheme based on affine projection algorithm (APA) is proposed for multiple antenna systems under time-varying flat fading environment. Computational complexities of least mean-squares (LMS-DFE), recursive least squares (RLS-DFE) and APA-based adaptive equalization (AP-DFE) algorithm are compared. The proposed algorithm provides fast convergence speed and low computational complexity. Simulation results show that the AP-DFE adaptive equalization algorithm outperforms LMS-DFE algorithm and can obtain significant computation saving over RLS-DFE algorithm with approximately the same BER performance.

articleTitle: Fuzzy adaptive power control based on PID algorithm for clusterheads of wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The distribution of nodes in wireless sensor networks are asymmetrical due to them broadcasted randomly. This situation affects the performance of networks. The power control technology of clusterheads is needed to optimize the framework of networks. Therefore we present an approach of fuzzy adaptive power control about clusterheads based on PID (Proportional, Integral and Differential) algorithm to solve the problem which is difficult to establish an exact mathematic model. The approach is easy to understand and the simulation results showed its validity.

articleTitle: BSIM3v3.2 model parameter extraction and improved model used for RF simulation
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The paper mainly introduce the DC parameter extraction process of BSIM3 model and the model improvement for RF simulation. First, we simply introduce the development of the BSIM3 model, and then we extract and optimize some DC parameters based on BSIM3 manual. At the same time, the paper provides the contrast between simulation and experiment. The BSIM3 can't model the MOSFET precisely when the frequency becomes higher and higher. So we extend the BSIM3 model by adding some parasitic components. For instance, we add the gate resistance in order to simulate the distributed transmission line affect and NQS affect. We can remove the influence to the Y12 and Y22 by adding substrate resistance components. Adding capacitance and inductance is to simulate the parasitic affect between any two poles. At the end of this paper, we provide the S parameter contrastive curves between simulation and measurement.

articleTitle: Modified fully public-key traitor tracing schemes
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Lyuu et al [1] presented a fully public-key traitor tracing scheme based on Chinese Remainder Theorem; In terms of security, the scheme is basically equivalent to the ElGamal cryptosystem. They also presented a possible way of forging decryption keys. In this paper, we propose two modified traitor tracing schemes and a corresponding tracing algorithm which can trace all the traitors contributing to the pirate decoder. The proposed schemes have all the advantages of the original scheme. In addition, one of our proposed schemes can save nearly half the communication bandwidth, and the other enhances the security of the original scheme. Further our proposed schemes are feasible to be used to construct multi-channel pay-TV schemes.

articleTitle: Capacity analysis of the multi-service cellular systems with MIMO
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Based on the new concept which is called the Equivalent Minimum Acceptable Carrier-to-Interference Ratio(EMACIR), a new method is proposed to analyze the capacity of the multi-service cellular systems with MIMO multiple input multiple output). Conveniently, the method can predict the outage capacity of the multi-service cellular system after deploying multiple antennas based on the parameters which are already known in the existing SISO (single input single output) system.

articleTitle: Fully distributed authentication scheme for mobile ad hoc network
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Public key authentication is a difficult security problem in no fixed infrastructure networks, especially for mobile ad hoc network with many new features different from traditional networks. In this paper, we proposed a fully distributed authentication scheme suitable for mobile ad hoc networks, in which each node stores part certificates and implement authentication by Multiple length-bounded paths authentication algorithm. The simulation results show our scheme is high assurance of authentication, good performance, fully self-organized, and scalable.

articleTitle: Multiple multicasts in mesh/torus interconnection networks with Relative Quadrant-Based algorithm
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: This paper presents an efficient algorithm, named Relative Quadrant-Based (RQ), to implement multiple multicast communications in wormhole-switched mesh/torus networks. Based on concept of relative quadrants, RQ can achieve high degree of parallelism by dividing the network into several blocks and sending message copies concurrently in each block. We also studied how to decrease the increasing contentions caused by improving parallel operations. By applying adaptive unicast algorithm, RQ can decrease the delay of channel contention. By organizing the multicast trees carefully, RQ algorithm with NR (Nearest-node Rooted) strategy can decrease the delay of node contention. Simulation results indicated that RQ-NR can achieve low average delay.

articleTitle: An improved HSM packet classification algorithm using pruning trie and space compression
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Hierarchical Space Mapping (HSM) [1] is excellent in the search time performance with the complexity of log(n), but it consumes great memory. So we propose a improved HSM(called C-HSM) using pruning trie to make the performance of search time independent of the filter number, and using heuristic to compress the space to save memory. The experiment results show that it can trade off time and space practically and enlarge the applicability.

articleTitle: Uplink scheduling of MPEG video transmission for 802.16 wireless MAN
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The mechanism of medium access control (MAC) layer in IEEE 802.16 system is becoming a hot spot because of its much more complication compared with many other wireless protocols. In this paper we propose an efficient uplink scheduling algorithm called unsolicited grant piggyback request (UGPR) to solve the problem of the current real-time polling service (rtPS) scheme for the quality of service (QoS) guarantee of MPEG video transmission due to its burstiness and variable bit rate. By using typical test video traces in a simple “BS to one SS” system, the proposed algorithm shows better performance in the aspects of video frame delay and jitter with similar channel utilization as the existing scheme.

articleTitle: A fast intra-frame prediction algorithm for H.264/AVC
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: H.264/AVC is the latest video coding standard with high compression efficiency. Due to its time-consuming in coding, it cannot meet the real-time application requirements. In this paper, an efficient algorithm was proposed based on 2D-Histogram according to the feature of Intra-frame prediction. In this algorithm, each macroblock is predicted before coding, and one of the two prediction modes is selected. As a result of this processing, coding time has been reduced dramatically. Experimental results show that the coding time of proposed algorithm is 16.26% less than that of H.264/AVC, at the expense of little quality degradation.

articleTitle: A multi-hop local energy aware routing algorithm for wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, a new multi-hop clustering routing algorithm MH-LEA for wireless sensor networks was proposed. Large surveillance area was divided into a series of concentric rings and packets were relayed between the adjacent rings. Heterogeneous of the size of clusters was utilized to overcome “hot spot” problem. From the objective of minimum energy consumption in first ring and balance of it between first ring and the other rings, the optimal choice of cluster number for each ring was deduced. Simulation proved that this algorithm has good performance under large area circumstances.

articleTitle: Computer vision used in photogrammetry to build Digital Elevation Model
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Computer vision is a new subject which develops fast in nearly 20 –30 years. The question it studied is similar in photogrammetry, and there is some difference between them also. This article discussed the relation of them in developmental eye. It give a example about the images of a low-level microminiaturize plane to construct Digital Elevation Model. It is the primary step of the “digital city” that construct tridimensional digital map [1][2]. It has met the real time 's request by experimental verification. Some new algorithms were used in this progress.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of Blocking probability in Mobile network
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: As an important parameter of network, Blocking probability has been investigated in various type of networks such as GSM, WLAN, etc. In this paper, blocking probability of mobile router in Mobile network (NEMO) is investigated with analytical model of Markov chain, considering two factors of node mobility model and call arrival rate. First we describe NEMO architecture, then three types of Mobile Network Node (MNN) defined in NEMO are divided into different priority according to network resource allocation, the blocking probability of mobile router in these two types of systems are put forward respectively. Furthermore, we also propose a way to compute blocking probability in nested NEMO. At last analysis result is presented.

articleTitle: Adaptive bit and power loading for OFDM systems
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: An adaptive bit and power allocation algorithm for OFDM systems was proposed. Adaptive loading can improve the performance of broadband OFDM system because each individual subchannel has its own attenuation. The proposed algorithm allocates bits adaptively in the subchannels according to the subchannel gains to minimize the total transmission power for a given bit error rate. The algorithm can be used over multipath frequency selective fading channels for stable transmission speed. Results show that the proposed scheme can achieve considerable performance enhancement over non-adaptive systems.

articleTitle: The study on the context-aware application architecture in NGN
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Context-aware has become a key technology for the integration of the next generation network (NGN) and pervasive computing. In order to make network human-oriented, NGN services should be able to take advantage of context-aware technology to adapt to environmental changes, and minimize user attention. Thus, the context-aware framework should have the ability of capturing context information, context modeling, context interpretation, context management, and etc. In this paper, we break through the traditional sensors - applications mode and introduce the concept of context service. Then we provide Context-Aware General Service Model (CAGSM) for use in NGN. Its functional structure and implementation technologies are discussed in detail with applications scenarios included.

articleTitle: Simulation and analysis of anti-interference UWB-OFDM system
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The robustness of anti-interference UWB-OFDM (AI-UWB) system in presence of narrow-band interference or jamming is examined. We analyzed the bit error rate performance and compared the robustness. Encoded the transmitted symbols and spread the power of the symbols over all sub-bands, AI-UWB system could make full use of the frequency diversity across the sub-bands and has more robustness to the narrowband interference. Simulating results show that it has more than 5 dB interference margin in the AI-UWB system. Encoding and spreading could suppress narrow-band interference effectively.

articleTitle: Text extraction in video image based on Wavelet Modulus Maximum
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Text extracting in video image is a valuable task, because video text includes much useful information. In this paper, a new algorithm is proposed for text extracting. Use Wavelet Modulus Maximum to detect artificial text area in video image. Transform the image with wavelet and acquired the modulus maximum points. These points constitute the feature image. In the feature image extracts the feature to original and statistic feature to division the text area and the background. The experiment expresses that the result of the algorithm is better than other algorithms that are referred in the paper.

articleTitle: Research on required data number in multipath fast fading channel simulation
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Monte Carlo simulation is often used to detect the bit error rate (BER) performance of communication systems. The reliability and validity of simulation results, which is described in this paper by max relative error (MRE) at a certain confidence probability, rely on simulation number. A universal conclusion on how to choose simulation number in multipath fast fading channel is drawn in this paper. The result of computer simulation demonstrates that the conclusion is effective under conditions of multipath fast fading channel, both perfect and imperfect channel estimation situations.

articleTitle: A blind source separation method based on generalized eigendecomposition in the wavelet domain
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, a blind source separation method based on generalized eigendecomposition in the wavelet domain is proposed. It uses two random numbers as the filter coefficients to realize the linear transform, while the time domain algorithm needs selecting different filter for different source signals. The proposed method is steady, very fast and easy to implement. The computer simulations results demonstrate the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of DSTBC-OFDM system in Frequency Selective Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, the differential space-time block coding (DSTBC) technology combined with orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) is studied in Frequency Selective Fading Channels. The influence on this system of number of subcarriers, number of paths and max Doppler frequency is analyzed. Simulation results show that the performance of the system will be improved as the number of subcarriers or multipaths increase. It is concluded that DSTBC-OFDM system is well tailored for high-mobility environment.

articleTitle: A channel assignment algorithm in cellular networks
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Based on DCMOGADES algorithm, a new channel assignment approach is proposed. The objective is to obtain a channel assignment scheme, which satisfies both the traffic demand requirements and electromagnetic compatibility constraints with a lower bound number of channels. The traffic demand requirements can be satisfied throughout the whole process of iteration, using the genetic-fix crossover and mutation operators we proposed, and effective selection and migration operators are also used. The results obtained by the simulation to some well-known benchmark problems show that our algorithm is a better approach for solving the channel assignment problem.

articleTitle: Construction of good quasi-cyclic LDPC codes
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The BER performance of presented quasi-cyclic (QC) low-density parity-check (LDPC) codes is not good as that of randomly constructed LDPC codes, while the lack of structure of randomly constructed LDPC codes implies serious disadvantages in terms of storing and accessing a large parity-check matrix. To solve the problems, this paper proposes a design of good quasi-cyclic (QC) low-density parity-check (LDPC) codes, the obtained algebraically structured codes have large minimum distances and good BER performance. The proposed design is based on index matrices, which determines the shifts of the circulant matrices of the sparse parity-check matrices. Compared with the presented design of QC LDPC codes, the designed QC LDPC codes are free from girth 4, sometimes free from girth 6, and have much larger minimum distances. Based on the algebraic code structure, the conditions of the girth and minimum distance of the codes are found. The BER performance of the designed QC LDPC block codes compares with that of randomly constructed LDPC codes for any block lengths. Better BER performance is obtained by increasing the circulant size of the base QC code. Simulations verify the construction of the QC LDPC codes to be valid.

articleTitle: An assignment scheme for downlink OVSF codes based on analyzing the two-dimensional state of codes
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In downlink of WCDMA, Orthogonal Variable spreading factor (OVSF) codes are used to support variable bit rate services. So the assignment scheme and allocation arithmetic of OVSF codes determine the utilization of downlink bandwidth and affect the performance of the whole network. In this paper, we analyze the disadvantages of DCA scheme and propose a new multi-code reassignment scheme which can increase the utilization of downlink bandwidth and decrease the code fragments on the OVSF code tree. The simulation results show that this scheme can reduce the impact of reassignment process to system efficiently and maintain low call blocking ratio at the same time.

articleTitle: A novel call admission algorithm with degradation mechanism in CDMA systems
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In order to increase the bandwidth utilization of the CDMA system and ensure the service quality of the real-time call, this paper presents a degradation call admission control algorithm. According to the features that data service is not sensitive to the delay, it can reduce the data bit rate of non-real-time call so as to lower the load of system and meet the call need from new user. This paper brings forward design project and does system simulation, of which the result proves that DCAC can effectively decrease calls' block probability and remarkably increase the total number of the real-time on-line users. So this scheme has bright application future.

articleTitle: The implementation of Custom RISC core for Access Network Protocols
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Multiform ANP (Access Network Protocols) and fast-changing communication market require high-performance yet flexible processing solutions. The ANPCC (Custom RISC Core for Access Network Protocols) project in this paper aims to develop a survey for ANP with high-flexibility and programmability. We present the design methodology, giving emphasis to architecture of the RISC-based core and instruction set extension with application-specific instructions. The ANPCC is estimated to be able to handle different access network protocols, such as SONET/SDH, E1/T1, and Ethernet .etc.

articleTitle: Interference canceling Time-Domain Equalization for CP-OFDM
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: We propose a Time-Domain Equalization (TDE) algorithm for Cyclic Prefixing - Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (CP-OFDM) signal. Because TDE is together with Interference Cancelling (IC), we call the scheme “CP-OFDM-IC-TDE”. OFDM with TDE appeared in Zero Padding - OFDM (ZP-OFDM) originally to avoid frequency-domain zero locations, and our algorithm make CP-OFDM take advantage of TDE also. Simulations show that CP-OFDM-IC-TDE receiver achieves lower bit error rate than traditional CP-OFDM receiver.

articleTitle: Blind digital watermarking technique using Fresnel hologram and phase encryption mask
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, we present a new blind digital watermarking algorithm based on optical Fresnel hologram, phase encryption mask (PEM) and discrete wavelet transform (DWT). The watermark image is converted into Fresnel hologram by using phase encryption mask, and then it is embedded within the coefficient matrixes of the host image DWT. By using the pixel substitution in the coefficient matrixes, the original host image is no longer necessary in the process of withdrawing watermark information, and then the blind watermarking is obtained. Numerical experiments show that the algorithm is robust to the attacks, such as the JPEG lossy compressing, cropping, superposing noise and resampling from the screen copy. Because the encryption keys (phase encryption mask, diffraction distance and wavelength) can be designed in a large degree of freedom, the blind digital watermarking algorithm has high security and practical value.

articleTitle: Modeling and parameters extraction of InP-based spiral inductors
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In RFIC, the high resistivity of InP substrate results in low substrate loss and the improvement of devices and circuits' performance. At present a few of people do research on modeling of InP-based spiral inductors. The paper has developed an equivalent circuit model of InP-based spiral inductors. Because of the high resistivity of InP substrate, magnetic substrate loss is neglected, and a resistor in series with parasitic capacitance of pads is used in order to account for parasitic substrate resistance. Using a ladder ‘4-element’ structure and a resistor, the model accurately predicts the skin effect and proximity effect of spiral inductor over a wide-frequency range. A capacitor Cf is adopted to represent the coupling capacitance between metal lines and overlap capacitance of two metal layers. The proposed model has been verified by measured results of spiral inductors fabricated on InP substrate and excellent agreement with measurement data up to 35GHz is demonstrated.

articleTitle: The study and implementation of building PACS based on intelligent-agent
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: A good system structure can effective reduce the PACS system development cycle, and enables PACS, which develops in this foundation, to be able to have the higher operating efficiency, the better flexibility and the extension. This paper discussed all kinds of PACS structure used nowadays, and presented a new one. In the structure, it used two technologies -- intelligent agent and workflow, and adopted distributed mechanism. The structure could improve doctors' work efficiency, diagnoses veracity, and fit the needs of magnanimous medicine picture processing.

articleTitle: Adaptive modulation with power constraint in SC-FDE
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Based on the concept of optimal signal subspace, signal spectrum transformation is carried out according to channel state information before transmission, and system performance can be improved considerably. In this paper, we propose an adaptive modulation algorithm that guarantees a desired bit error rate with uniform power allocation, and the algorithm has low complexity and high spectrum efficiency. Our approach is novel in that we optimize both bit allocation and power allocation to maximize spectral efficiency under the constraint of power and bit error rate. The new adaptive modulation algorithm can greatly improve system performance without increasing system complexity significantly.

articleTitle: A soft-switching method for channel equalization algorithms based on decision-annulus rule
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, we introduce and investigate the switching methods between blind equalization and conventional adaptive equalization. As we known, the signal constellation will rotate and appear annulus after transmitting through wireless channel due to the fading and multi-path. So it is necessary to adopt the channel equalization to compensation the channel distortion. In order to obtain the better performance of the channel equalization, we present a new soft-switching method based on decision-annulus rule, it realizes transition automatically and smoothly between constant-modulus algorithm (CMA) and decision-directed least mean square (DD-LMS) algorithm. Combined with this soft-switching method, a new structure to adjust joint blind equalization and carrier recovery is also given for example. Simulation results demonstrate that our soft-switching method outperforms previously proposed hard switching methods. It improves performances of adaptive channel equalization by increasing the convergence rate and enhancing the algorithm stability.

articleTitle: Address assignment in wireless sensor networks using game approach
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, we propose a game model to solve the MAC address assignment in sensor networks. Insufficiency of battery power of sensors makes the conservation of the energy be the main design issues for the sensor networks. Due to the small packet payload, the MAC header is a significant and energy-costly overhead. To remedy this, we propose a novel scheme for a MAC address assignment. The key feature which makes our approach unique is that we propose a mixed strategy game model to solve the address assignment problem. We prove that there is a mixed strategy Nash equilibrium in our game model. The model takes advantage of the exploitation of spatial address ruse to save energy. Our model is easy to implement, which makes it a potential candidate for practical implementations, even for very large networks.

articleTitle: A novel algorithms of timing synchronization for MIMO-OFDM systems
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Under exploiting the MIMO-OFDM systems spatial characteristics in wireless multipath channel, the maximum number diversity algorithms based on one preamble symbol for MIMO-OFDM timing synchronization in high-mobility environments is presented. This diversity algorithms is investigated to overcome hurdle in timing synchronization performance degrade under wireless multipath channel deep fading. The mathematical expression of timing synchronization error probability distribution function and probability density function in the MIMO-OFDM systems are derived for the diversity algorithms. The simulation results for MIMO-OFDM systems frame and symbol synchronization on high speed wireless multipath COST 207 channel model are given.

articleTitle: Effect of Node-B scheduling algorithms on High Speed uplink Packet Access with E-TFC selection
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, the effect of Node-B scheduling algorithms on High Speed uplink Packet Access (HSUPA) with E-TFC selection is evaluated. Node-B scheduling as the key technique of HSUPA is important for the performance. The scheduling algorithms, Proportional-Fair (PF) and Round-Robin (RR), as the key components of Node-B scheduling are presented and studied in the case of HSUPA here. With the modeling and system simulations, the difference between PF and RR in HSUPA is discussed by the way of qualitative and quantitative analysis. PF can offer a little bit higher cell throughput compared to RR in the case of heavy load. Generally speaking, the difference between scheduling algorithms is marginal due to some other factors, e.g. UE category, channel conditions, maximum re-transmission number, the load target setting, etc. The scheduling algorithm as the part of Node-B scheduling, which is coupled with the E-TFC selection process, is not the only factor affecting the performance of HSUPA.

articleTitle: Complexity-reduced multistage detection for MIMO systems using sphere decoding
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: A complexity-reduced iterative algorithm based on multistage detection and soft sphere decoding (SD) for multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems is presented in this paper. As m-QAM constellation can be decomposed into several QPSK constellations, and it's very efficient for a soft sphere decoder in QPSK systems. Our scheme combines these together for high order modulation iterative detection and decoding (IDD) systems with remarkable reduced complexity and moderate performance degradation. Performance of our scheme is evaluated by simulation and the performance/ complexity trade-off is explained.

articleTitle: A new dynamic traffic & entertainment system and its mobile multimedia terminal based on DTV ground network
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: This paper reports a new dynamic traffic & entertainment System, which based on the ground network of digital TV. It includes the traffic information such as road status, construction, important event, public service and passenger variety information. It also can provide entertainment content of TV, broadcasting etc. Meanwhile, a mobile multimedia terminal with DDR (Drive Data Recorder) is presented in detail.

articleTitle: Path diversity for multi-radio access
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Future wireless communication will be a multi-radio access environment. [1] A path diversity mechanism for multi-radio access environment is proposed. With this mechanism, the terminal with multi-radio access function can improve the network transmission performance with lower packet loss rate and shorter latency. The mechanism was verified by the simulation and test.

articleTitle: New method to eliminate cross-term in wigner distribution
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In signal process, the application of Wigner distribution is limited by its cross-term, a lot of method had been present in order to eliminate it. In paper, a new method to eliminate the cross-terms in Wigner Distribution is presented, which is called the Standardization of the Pseudo Quadratic Form (SPQF). This approach is based on the signal that has been decomposed by Matching pursuits algorithm. The approach has been proved in mathematics, and moreover, both the advantages and disadvantages about the method are also described.

articleTitle: An HSBE-LPC low bit wideband speech coding algorithm
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: This paper addressed the design, implementation and evaluation of a low bit-rate wideband speech coding algorithm HSBE-LPC based on Harmonic Sinusoidal Speech Model (HSSM) and Linear Predictive Coding technique. An improved HSSM was presented, where an improved sub-harmonic-harmonic high precision pitch algorithm to detect pitch, exacting frequency offsets and the SEEVOC to get envelope. The Voiced Possibility was iteratively computed combined with the Least Square Method of Sinusoidal Speech Model (SSM) technique on the basis of the obtained pitch and envelope. A split vector quantization method with Dynamic Time Warping to search codebook is used to encode LPC parameters obtained from amplitudes. The algorithm calculated LPC in frequency domain and picked up harmonic offsets to ensure high quality of re-construct speech. Simulation results and the mean opinion score (MOS) indicate that the proposed algorithm can reduce speech coding rate with high accuracy for speech parameter analysis, easy on-line realization and satisfied synthesis speech quality.

articleTitle: A novel robust pilot tones arranging pattern for OFDM frequency offset tracing
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The paper researches rudimental frequency offset tracing using pilot tones after frequency offset acquisition and presents a new OFDM system pilot tones arranging pattern by introducing the ideas of self inter-carriers interference (ICI) cancellation into frequency offset tracing. The pattern is an improvement of the existing pilot tones arranging patter. Theoretical analysis and simulation results show that the new pattern has greater robustness than existing pattern.

articleTitle: Sending on demand in heterogeneous collaborative editing systems
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: With heterogeneous devices proliferating, collaborative work among ubiquitous environment is needed. For the limited bandwidth of wireless network and the limited size of screen on palmtop computer, tailored communication and data exchanges between desktop and mobile sites was studied in our research. We proposed a grouping scheme together with Sending on Demand Policy to reduce the message flow in heterogeneous collaborative editing systems implemented by different devices. Consistency maintenance relevant to grouping is solved by a Linked History Buffer. The scheme has been implemented in our prototype system that can work well in heterogeneous environments.

articleTitle: New multiuser detection algorithm using least p-Norm criterion
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Alpha stable distribution is better for modeling impulsive noises than Gaussian distribution in wireless communication system. This class of process has no close form of probability density function and finite second order moments. We proposed a new adaptive recursive least p-norm state space multiuser detection algorithm based on least p-norm of innovation process with infinite variances. The simulation experiments show that the proposed new algorithm is more robust than the conventional state space multiuser detection algorithm.

articleTitle: A novel iterative control variates algorithm for efficient simulation in multipath fast-fading channels
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, an iterative control variates simulation algorithm (ICVA) for multipath fast-fading channels is proposed, in the situation of unknown amplitude of the transmitted signal (TSA). This algorithm utilizes a certain cumulative distribution function as the control variates, and can obtain an unbiased and variance-reduction estimator of bit error rate (BER) and TSA. Compared with Monte-Carlo (MC) methods, ICVA's estimator has lower variance. The simulation results indicate that ICVA is fast convergent, and both the variance of BER's estimator and that of TSA's estimator are inversely proportional to square of simulation data number, which demonstrates this algorithm is effective than MC.

articleTitle: Novel hybrid parallel PN code acquisition scheme for multiplex system of spread spectrum communication and range measuring
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, we present a novel hybrid parallel code acquisition scheme for inner-sequence of multiplex system. For decreasing the probability of false alarm in acquisition process and keeping the track of the incoming sequence after returning from the false alarm state, we propose two different local code registers in each Acquisition Module, and make the two modules can interconnect each other while they are performing correlation of the incoming sequence and local sequence. In our performance analysis, we have derived the probability of detection and false alarm under an AWGN channel. Simultaneously the expected mean acquisition time are given by using flow-graph technique. Our performance analysis shows that the mean acquisition time is 4.6 ms at −20 dB chip-to-noise ratio, much faster than the typical rapid acquisition scheme.

articleTitle: Efficient control for network congestion
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Efficient congestion control should fully use the bandwidth for a large network with many routers and terminals. This paper develops a congestion control algorithm based differential equations' fluid model. The proposed control algorithm considers that under many flows, the stability of the fluid model ensures the convergence of the average rate to its equilibrium point, may impose excessive restriction of our choice of AQM parameters. Simulations verify the proposed control design can avoid of the congestion problem of bottleneck network. Under many flows with large capacity, simulations have shown that the AQM system utilization still approaches to full utilization, while the buffer size on the order of bandwidth-delay product is necessary for the stability of the fluid model with full utilization.

articleTitle: Digital image watermarking capacity estimation based on the channel selection in the wavelet domain
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: It is very important to estimate the capacity of the watermark information that can be embedded in a digital image. This paper proposes a new the digital image watermarking capacity estimation method by selecting the reliable channels in the wavelet domain. Based on the JPEG2000 compress principle and the human vision system(HVS) characteristics, find out the maximal watermarking capacity under the invisibility constrain, balance well about the relationship among the watermarking invisibility, robustness, and capacity.

articleTitle: Interference and error probability evaluation in CDMA-based Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The multiple access interference (MAI) analysis for CDMA-based Ad Hoc networks is analyzed in this paper and the relationship between SINR and distributed node density, normalized code mutual-interference is given under the Poisson distribution model. Theoretically, the result shows that it is necessary for CDMA-based Ad Hoc networks to detect multiple access interference (MAI) on the physical layer, avoid collisions on the MAC layer and select the code set with less normalized mutual-interference. The impact of MAI on the link error probability is evaluated and the bit error probability as a function of distributed node density and normalized code mutual-interference is presented.

articleTitle: Pairwise error probability of MIMO system over space-time correlattion Rician fast fading environments
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The paper presents a upper bound of the average pairwise error probability for a MIMO spatial multiplexing (SM) system in the presence of transmit correlation and a Ricean component. SM such as V-BLAST, based upon channel matrix inversion, rely on the linear independence of antenna channel responses for stream separation and suffer considerably from high levels of fading correlation and/or dominating ill-conditioned line-of-sight channel components. We investigate the influence of space-time correlation and Rician fast fading on the performance of MIMO system, and obtain a upper bound of the average pairwise error probability in space-time correlation Rician fast fading channels. Ultimately, we compare the influence of different channel characters on the performance of system.

articleTitle: Closed-form expressions for outage performance in macroscopic MRC environments
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Closed-form expression for the probability density function of output signal-to-noise ratio of macroscopic maximal ratio combiner are derived by means of moment generating function and Gauss-Hermite quadrature, then outage performance is analyzed for different parameter schemes over Nakagami-Lognormal composite fading channels. The theoretical expressions are validated by numerical results. The results show that the performance of macroscopic maximal ratio combining is mainly impacted by shadowing. Considering unbalanced branches, the unbalance of shadowing and multipath fading slightly impact outage performance of macro-MRC, and area mean unbalance has a great influence on outage performance.

articleTitle: Widely linear decision-feedback detection for distributed transmit antenna MIMO systems
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Conventional detection algorithms for co-located antenna MIMO are no longer suitable for distributed transmit antenna multi-input multi-output (DTA-MIMO) systems, due to different antenna configurations. This paper proposes a detector based on widely linear (WL) processing combined with the decision-feedback (DF) strategy for DTA-MIMO systems, where we perform proposed WL-DF detection for the first q substreams, and conventional linear DF (L-DF) detection procedure for the remaining substreams. Simulations confirm that the proposed scheme provides considerable performance gain at the expense of an acceptable computation complexity.

articleTitle: Identity-based elliptic curve signature algorithm in tripartite key exchange protocol
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: An elliptic curve tripartite Diffie-Hellman key exchange protocol on the class three supersingular elliptic curves over GF(p<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) with positive parameter (CTP curves) is introduced in the paper. Because this method is easily attacked by “man-in-the-middle”, we propose a new identity-based elliptic curve signature algorithm to sign the transmitting message. The private key can be generated and computed easily in the algorithm. The security of the new signature algorithm is equal to the ECDSA and it saves computing time comparing with the signature algorithms' using Weil pairing. Its implementation provides a good reference for the multipartite key exchange protocol as well.

articleTitle: Analysis of power spectral density for time-hopping impulse ultra-wideband communications system
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The power spectral density (PSD) of time-hopping (TH) impulse ultra-wideband (I-UWB) communications system is derived from a general system model. And the main components of PSD are analyzed. The concrete impacts of TH frame structure, different kinds of modulations with time hopping, such as amplitude modulation, phase modulation and their combinations, on PSD are discussed in details. Next, the direct-sequence time-hopping (DS-TH) I-UWB system is introduced and from its PSD analysis, it is found that the use of DS can get rid of the impact of TH on PSD and the PSD is only determined by the energy spectral density of baseband pulse. This can be viewed as a new method to optimize system power-efficiency.

articleTitle: An effective direct multi-channel acoustic echo suppression model based on blind signal separation
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: A multi-channel acoustic echo (MCAE) suppression model via blind signal separation (BSS) is proposed. It avoids the inherent non-uniqueness problem in MCAE cancellation due to strongly cross-correlated acoustic echo-source signals. On the contrary, it makes full use of the cross-correlativity to remove echoes from a microphone input. Experimental results confirm its effectiveness.

articleTitle: An integrated warehouse management system based on RFID techniques
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: This paper introduces an integrated warehouse management system based on RFID techniques which could obtain the function of alarming and store statistics automatically. The structure of system, the function of modules, the hardware design and the flow chart of software are issued in this paper, and the anticollision algorithm based on dynamic binary is also explained.

articleTitle: Hardware-efficient combined CP reconstruction for OFDM-WLAN
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: A hardware-efficient combined iterative cyclic prefix restoration (CPR) method is presented for wireless local area network (WLAN) using orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM). Based on the analysis of both time-domain and transform-domain CPR methods, we propose the combination of them. Utilizing the hardware in the standard receiver, the new scheme performs the first iteration in a style similar to the transform-domain method for low implementation cost. Then, conducting further iterations with time-domain CPR method offers low iteration complexity. Simulations validate the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: The study of web information acquisition based on semantic zooming
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The keyword-based searching technology has its blindness in nature while the fully intelligent searching engine is still not in its maturity. To cope with this situation, this paper proposes a transitive solution. By analyzing the people's searching habit and the semantic extent of the searching keywords, we studied the association between semantics of the keywords and the searching result, whereby forming a link of words with similar semantic and different connotation. By switching between the words in this link, we can adjust and control the size of searching results. We also propose the concept of semantic zooming, combined with which, a new keyword-based searching solution is put forward.

articleTitle: CDMA signal chip code generators estimation
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Conventional linear and nonlinear intercept receivers are ineffective in detecting direct-sequence spread spectrum (DS/SS) signals if the transmissions are designed to be covert and the chip code sequences are unavailable. The detection problems are exacerbated if the users operate within a code-division multiple access (CDMA) environment. Former researches show that it is possible to use triple correlation techniques to estimate the DS/SS chip code generator. However these researches concerned only with the single DS/SS signal case. The problem of estimation of generators of CDMA signal which is the sum of multiple DS/SS signals is still unsolved. In this paper, triple correlation function (TCF) of CDMA signal is investigated and the way to use TCF to estimate CDMA chip code generators is presented..

articleTitle: A hierarchical buffer management scheme for network nodes with QoS requirements
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, a buffer management mechanism with hierarchically dynamic thresholds is proposed. This mechanism can not only provide fair buffer allocation hierarchically, but also improve the buffer utilization by using the reserved buffer from dynamic threshold. The parameters of dynamic thresholds for each hierarchy, the parameters for low threshold and the buffer sizes are all decided for all parts constituting the switch fabric through system simulation.

articleTitle: Optimization flow control with DFP variable metric method algorithm
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, we proposed a distributed algorithm for obtaining the optimal fair bandwidth allocation based on local algorithms and measurements. The approach we use is draw from Davidon-Fletcher-Powell variable metric method (so called quasi-Newton method) in optimization theory, and the simulation result show that the algorithm converge faster than other algorithm used before.

articleTitle: Evolution towards next generation wireless broadband communications challenges
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In order to satisfy the requirements and expectations of the user to have more advanced wireless communication in mobile environments, this paper outlines the technical issues involved in Beyond Third Generation (B3G) mobile communications, High-Speed large capacity transmission capability is an essential requirement for B3G mobile communications for which we suggest VSF-OFCDM, SCS-MC-CDMA, OFDMA and IFDMA, efficient modulation demodulation techniques to achieve higher spectral utilization efficiency (such as combination of OFDM with CDMA, error control coding using LDPC codes); wireless multi-system terminals with End-to-End Reconfigurability. Frequency allocation (of Europe) is a major issue in the performance (how much date rate it can offer with available bandwidth) of wireless networks.

articleTitle: Construction of optimal optical orthogonal signature patterns for high throughput optical code division multiple access image transmission
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: It is stated that high throughput optical code division multiple access image transmission need parallel transmission because of the speed limitation of current opto-electronic devices and the high requirement to opto-electronic devices. Aiming at the problem that signature sequences of the parallel transmission system are two-dimensional optical orthogonal signature patterns different from conventional signature sequences and the construction of the maximal capacity of the optical orthogonal signature patterns is lacked now, a novel construction algorithm based on block design is presented. The idea and the procedures of the algorithm are explained in detail. Simulation based on the algorithm is done. The simulating result shows that this algorithm can construct optimal optical orthogonal signature patterns effectively.

articleTitle: A practical scheduling algorithm for buffered-crossbar switch
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Recently, buffered-crossbar (CICQ) switch is becoming more and more attractive to high performance router builders than other bufferless schemes, as it can achieve throughput, rate and delay guarantees. In this article, we propose a practical scheduling algorithm called the least congested cross-point buffer first, shorted by LC<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>BF. The main features of this scheduling algorithm are in its easier implementation in hardware, as the complexity is merely associated with the size of the cross-point buffers, and fewer hardware resources are needed than existing schemes. By controlling size of the cross-point buffers, our scheduling scheme can achieve good delay and stability performances. Finally in this article, we present one hardware implement framework for our algorithm, according to it, users can implement our scheduling scheme using VHDL.

articleTitle: A novel adaptive diamond search for fast block-matching motion estimation
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Block-matching algorithm (BMA) is always the focus of video compression techniques in the past decades. In this paper, the focus is not played on the search pattern but on the search strategies. The proposed search algorithm has four novel points: new adaptive motion vector prediction, new zero MV priority, new adaptive search early termination threshold, and new adaptive search pattern based on sequences' motion characteristics. We care all the performances including PSNR, number of search point (NSP) and bit-rate. Simulation results using extensive standard sequences have shown that the proposed search algorithm is superior to conventional fast BMAs because of its robustness, adaptability and efficiency.

articleTitle: Improved SPW and predistortion to overcome the nonlinear distortion of the OFDM communication system
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Because of so many sub-carriers, OFDM signal has very wide amplitude distribution. Even though the predistortion is used to compensate for the HPA nonlinearity, the power efficiency of the HPA (high power amplifier) is still very low since the PAPR (peak to average power ratio) is very high. So, reduction of the PAPR of the OFDM signal before the predistortion will improve the power efficiency and nonlinear compensation. In this paper, we propose a new combined method of SPW (subblock phase weighting) for PAPR reduction and predistortion technique. That is an improved SPW method to use a novel weighting factor combination of the complementary sequence characteristic plus PAPR threshold technique. From the simulation results, BER performance is improved and in-band and out-of-band spectrum radiations are mitigated. Power efficiency of HPA is enhanced because of the PAPR reduction. So, the proposed system improves about 3dB and 1dB performance than the LCP (linearized constant peak-power)-OFDM and LCP-OFDM plus SPW at BER=10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−4</sup>.

articleTitle: A privacy-respecting context-aware architecture
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: This paper targets personal privacy protection concerns in context-aware ubiquitous computing environments. It proposes a generic context-aware architecture that is specially designed with privacy protection in mind. The proposed context-aware architecture provides functional support for context collecting, storage, processing and dissemination. It also provisions access control mechanisms to protect context information against unauthorized access, and develops a privacy agent technology to enable individuals to manage their privacy requirements towards dynamic context-aware environments with relative ease.

articleTitle: Performance of a new blind estimation algorithm of timing offset for PCC-OFDM system
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: This paper proposed a novel blind frequency offset estimation algorithm of timing offset for polynomial cancellation coded orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (PCC-OFDM) systems with symbol overlapped. Compared with general frequency offset estimation, this estimation is carried out in the time domain and an optimal frequency offset variable is achieved by reconstructing a pair of linear demodulated components at the discrete fourier transform (DFT) output. The numeric results show that the estimate is a linear function of frequency offset and has better bandwidth efficiency.

articleTitle: A link adaptation scheme in wireless LAN based on channel estimation
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: A novel link adaptation scheme using linear Auto Regressive (AR) channel estimation algorithm to enhance the performance of auto rate selection mechanism in IEEE 802.11g is proposed. Low efficiency caused by time interval between the Received Signal Strength (RSS) measured time and the frame transmitted time is overcome. The best rate is selected based on data payload length, frame retry count and the estimated RSS value. Simulation results show that the proposed scheme enhances mean throughput performance up to 7% in saturation state, and up to 24% in finite load state compared with those non-estimation schemes. Performance enhancements in average drop rate and average number of transmission attempts per data frame delivery also validate the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: A realized embedded streaming media system
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, we present an embedded streaming media system. In the system, RTP, RTCP and RTSP are realized in PS (Protocol Session) module. The received multimedia data is capsulated in FFC (File Format Capsulation) module, and then decoded by hardware decoder. The system proves to play back MPEG1/2/4 streaming data smoothly and also succeeds in streaming download.

articleTitle: Minimal capacity loss Round-Robin scheduling algorithm for downlink beamforming multiuser MIMO systems
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, we propose a minimal capacity loss round-robin scheduling (MCLRRS) algorithm for downlink zeroforcing beamforming multiuser MIMO systems. Based on conventional round-robin scheduling, we select user with less spatially correlated channels. It guarantees full fairness of users and at the same time we can get multiuser diversity. The analysis and simulation results have both shown that MCLRRS algorithm distinctly outperforms conventional Round-Robin scheduling algorithm.

articleTitle: 2D cyclic ESPRIT via Hermitian mapping
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: To circumvent the rank deficiency from highly correlated or coherent signals of interest (SOIs), the spatial smoothing (SS) methods are perfect solutions, but reduce the effective aperture of the array. And this directly result in a certain performance degradation. Via Hermitian mapping, a novel 2D cyclic ESPRIT algorithm without conjugate centrosymmetric array configuration is presented in this paper, which has closed-form, automatically paired 2-D angle estimates and a better performance in the presence of multipath propagation. Finally, simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Multi-channel MAC for ad hoc networks
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: This paper proposes a medium access control (MAC) protocol for ad hoc wireless networks that utilizes multiple channels dynamically to improve performance. Our proposed protocol enables hosts to utilize multiple channels by switching channels dynamically, thus increasing network throughput. The protocol requires only one transceiver per host, but solves the multi-channel hidden terminal problem using temporal synchronization. Our scheme improves network throughput significantly, especially when the network is highly congested. The simulation results show that our protocol successfully exploits multiple channels to achieve higher throughput than IEEE 802.11.

articleTitle: Multistage sequential Gaussian Approximation for MIMO systems
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: This paper presents a reduced complexity detection scheme, based on sequential Gaussian Approximation (SGA), called multistage SGA detection (MSGA), for multi-input multi-output wireless communication systems with high-order QAM modulation. In the SGA detection, only part of transmit symbol combinations contributing significantly to posterior probabilities are retained, having a complexity linear with retained branches number. We develop a multistage SGA for QAM MIMO system with a modulation order M<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</inf> by decomposing the original QAM symbol into M<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</inf>/2 4-QAM symbols, resulting in a complexity reduction from exponential in the modulation order to linear, compared to basic SGA detection. Simulation results show that the multistage SGA can approach the performance of the basic SGA detection.

articleTitle: An effective voice activity detection algorithm in mobile communication corrupted by impulse noise
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Existing voice activity detection (VAD) algorithms degrade drastically in mobile communication environments corrupted by impulse noise. A novel fusion algorithm is proposed for VAD adapted to such environments. Theoretical and experimental analyses were done to justify the effectiveness of the algorithm, which demonstrated that the proposed VAD algorithm operates accurately and reliably at the presence of impulse noise even with a varying signal-to-impulse-noise ratio (SINR). Moreover the proposed algorithm needs less computational complexity overhead and is suitable for real-time implementation.

articleTitle: Robust watermarking for video based on Quasi-3D DWT/DCT
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: A robust video watermarking scheme based on quasi-3D DWT/DCT is proposed. The scheme uses 2-D DWT to depict intra-frame information and uses 1-D DCT to depict temporal axis information. During the watermark embedding process, watermarking is embedded into HH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> subband in wavelet domain and DC coefficients in discrete cosine transform (DCT) domain. In the extraction procedure, the scheme utilizes synchronization frames' Geometric Moment to correct geometric distortion. The simulation results demonstrate that the scheme is robust enough and has low computation overhead.

articleTitle: An adaptive predistortion for nonlinear amplifier in OFDM communication systems
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: An adaptive predistortion linearization is proposed to compensate for the linear and nonlinear distortions induced by high power amplifiers (HPAs) in orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) systems. The uncertain HPA with memory is represented by the three-box model with a Wiener-Hammerstein structure. A simplified Volterra series model (VSM) is applied to approximate the input-output property of the HPA, and an adaptive predistorter is generated directly by using the VSM which need not to identify the inverse model of the HPA. When OFDM signals pass through the cascade system of the predistorter and the HPA, overall linearization from predistorter input to HPA output can be achieved. The effectiveness of the proposed predistortion method is validated by numerical simulation for 64-ary quadrature amplitude modulation OFDM (64QAM-OFDM) transmission systems.

articleTitle: Intelligent Service Gateway for pervasive computing
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: This paper will design a Service Gateway which has ability of context-aware and provides automatic services based on occupants' preference inside pervasive computing space. We select 10 parameters describing the space and its occupants. The service gateway uses OSGi as basic framework. And the devices use Jini to provide services. The decision process uses rule engine. The result shows the system work effectively according to the change of parameters.

articleTitle: An enhanced RF receiving circuitry design for UHF RFID reader
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Blind spots often occur in RFID system. This paper presents an enhanced RF receiving circuit design including four receiving channels and a circulator. The proposed design is simple, but it can eliminate blind spots and improve reading performance. Experimental results show that the proposed design improves the reading efficiency distinctly, and reduces the blind spots obviously compared to the conventional RFID reader design.

articleTitle: WebGIS developing architecture and working mechanism based on J2EE platform
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: By deep analysis of J2EE platform and WebGIS systematic structure, this section settles the key technology of the coordinated operation of J2EE and WebGIS, expatiates the cooperation principle, proposes a WebGIS developing architecture based on J2EE platform, and then gives the working mechanism of WebGIS directed by this architecture. The architecture avoids the illogicalities and problems which lying in the architecture of nowadays correlative research and application about WebGIS, offers a optimized architecture for WebGIS development, and has definite value in theory and application.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of GMSK with limiter discriminator detection in the slow frequency hopping system
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, a noncoherent GMSK detector using Limiter Discriminator Detection (LDD) followed by Viterbi decoding(VD) in the SFH system is presented. The performance of this detection technique is theoretically analyzed by using a Gaussian approximation and found by computer simulation. Simulations show the efficacy of the proposed detector in an AWGN channel. This method described in this paper can adapt modern frequency-hopping communication's require for transmitting a mass of high rate data and video information and reduce the hardware complexity of the SFH/GMSK receiver.

articleTitle: A new method for interference mitigation with coexisting spectrum users for UWB pulse radio
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, a new method for interference mitigation with coexisting spectrum users for ultra-wideband (UWB) pulse radio is proposed. This method uses adaptive frequency spectrum estimator to give the estimates of each coexisting spectrum users' center frequency and frequency band. Based on these estimates, the frequency band of UWB communication system can be adaptively divided into multi-bands. Combing with Parr's pulse design method, the final obtained pulse for UWB transmitter can dramatically suppress the mutual interferences between UWB systems and multiple coexisting spectrum users in mobile communication environment. This new method successfully solves the coexistence problem between UWB systems and the coexisting spectrum users without the need of reducing UWB pulse power spectral density (PSD) over the whole UWB frequency band. Therefore, the application range of UWB systems can be enlarged by increasing the transmitted UWB pulse power.

articleTitle: DCCP with RCS for real-time multimedia services in wireless networks
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: DCCP (Datagram Congestion Control Protocol) is proposed by IETF to transmit real-time traffic as a substitute for UDP. There are two main congestion control mechanisms in DCCP, which are CCID2 and CCID3. However they are designed for wired links which are assumed to have negligible errors, so they are not suitable for wireless networks with long RTT and high bit error rates. RCS (Rate Control Scheme) is an application layer rate control scheme rightly for real-time applications in networks with long RTT and high bit error rates. By the combination of DCCP and improved RCS, we make DCCP a more suitable protocol for real-time multimedia services in wireless networks.

articleTitle: An improved multiple packet reception algorithm in MANET
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, we present an improved multiple packet reception (MPR) algorithm for mobile ad hoc networks (MANET) based on polynomial phase sequences (PPS) blind interference cancellation. Decision feedback and channel estimation are used in the proposed algorithm to improve the correct ratio of the recovered packets. Simulation results illustrate the obvious reduction of bit error ratio (BER) of the recovered packets and the excellent performance of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: An approach to analyze the performance of a 0-π phase shifter effect on the modulationof PSK signals
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: This paper presents an analysis and simulation that the performance of a 0- π phase shifter influence on the modulation of PSK signals. According to the analysis results, the carrier wave suppression is not only in connection with the phase error, but also with the switching speed and the parasitic amplitude modulation. Simultaneously the performance analysis and the simulation results of the performance of the 0-π phase shifter effecting on the BPSK signal are given. At last a 0-π phase shifter are fabricated and tested. The experimental results coincide with the simulation.

articleTitle: An ad hoc cooperative routing algorithm based on optimal channel selection
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Cooperative routing technology can efficiently improve the performance of the network by initiatively selecting cooperative nodes to forward data. Based on optimal channel selection, we propose a cooperative routing algorithm for Ad Hoc networks, whose model and implementation are presented in this paper. We compare the proposed algorithm with DSDV protocol by simulation. The results show that the proposed algorithm outgoes DSDV routing protocol with considerable gains.

articleTitle: Quadratic prime codes
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: This letter presents a new construction of frequency-hopping (FH) sequences, here designated as quadratic prime codes by expanding the construct idea of prime codes to the extension Galois fields GF(P<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>). Taking f(x)=x<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>−y as the irreducible polynomial, where is a quadratic nonresidue of prime number P, quadratic prime codes of length P<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> are generated, which possess ideal Hamming autocorrelation and nearly ideal Hamming cross-correlation properties. Furthermore, quadratic prime codes can be partitioned into P+1 groups, of which the maximum Hamming cross-correlation between any two FH sequences in the same group is at most one.

articleTitle: A novel high-isolation, dual-polarization broadband array antenna with low cross-polarization for 3G base station
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, a novel linear array antenna is proposed and investigated experimentally and the measured results are plotted. The measured impedance bandwidth determined by VSWR≪1.5 covers 1710∼2170MHz and the port isolation is better than −30dB by additive isolated conducting frames which change the other array characters very little. The cutting slots in the side walls of the ground provide the given HPBW of 90±8°(Half-Power Beam Width) in azimuth plane and maintain a stable array characters. The antenna has a high front-to-back ratio of radiation pattern of 25dB and a low cross polarization level (−10dB in the forward region and −22dB on the axes of peak gain). The array formed by printed microstrip antennas mainly features in the slots and the isolated conducting frames which ensure the array characters satisfy the wireless communication criterions. The array antenna is highly suitable for the base station applications for 3G system.

articleTitle: A novel closed-loop power control algorithm based on predictor
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Power control is one key technology of 3G beyond and 4G mobile communication systems. In this paper, a novel closed-loop distributed power control algorithm based on predictor has been proposed. This algorithm can trace the variation of the radio environment changes and reduces the power control error caused by the time variation of the radio channels. Simulation results show that the convergence speed of this method is fast. This algorithm can be used to design and optimize the system parameters. So this method possesses a good perspective.
