articleTitle: A novel auto-rate adaptation scheme for wireless ad hoc networks
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The IEEE 802.11 wireless media access standard has multi-rate capability in physical layer. These different rates are possible through choosing different modulation schemes. The choice of modulation scheme depends on the current quality of the transmission channel. Present wireless devices often support multiple modulation schemes. However, there are relatively few auto-rate adaptation scheme proposed for wireless Ad Hoc networks to utilize this capability. In this paper we present an auto-rate adaptation scheme called the Sender-Based Auto-Rate (SBAR) scheme. The novelty of SBAR is that SBAR not only possesses efficient channel quality estimation similar to RBAR, but also doesn't introduce other protocol overhead on the basis of IEEE 802.11. Its rate adaptation is in the sender so that SBAR can be applied to existing equipments without modification to the frame formats in IEEE 802.11. The simulation results of SBAR show that SBAR performs consistently well.

articleTitle: Forward error correction lost packet recovery algorithm based on relative packet weight in streaming media systems
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The transmission of real-time stream media is based on RTP (Real-time transport protocol) and delivered over best-effort networks without ARQ mechanism. With the theories of forward error correction (FEC) and MPEG video coding, this paper presents a FEC lost packets recovery algorithm based on calculation of relative RTP packet weight. The assignment of redundant packets takes characteristic of different video stream into consideration. Simulation results show that FEC lost packets recovery algorithm is efficient to provide higher quality for streaming media system when the packet lost rate is high by comparing with other current algorithms.

articleTitle: A novel residual ISI cancellation for OFDM system with applications to Wireless LAN
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: A novel method is developed for the orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) systems to eliminate the residual inter-symbol interference (ISI) introduced by the channel impulse response that exceeds the length of the guard interval. The method uses the decisions to estimate the residual ISI by FFT and IFFT with a very low computational complexity, and remove the residual ISI directly. Another advantage of this method is that it can be applied for non-sample spaced channel. Simulations for the application of the residual ISI cancellation algorithm to the Wireless LAN system based on IEEE Std 802.11a are performed. The simulation results show that the residual ISI cancellation algorithm presented in this paper provides good performance improvements on static fading ISI channels.

articleTitle: The application research of logistics network based on GIS
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Along with the development of e-commerce, Traditional logistics modes, management thoughts and means have changed fundamentally. Logistics system takes on a lot of new characteristics, such as information centered, automation, network centered, intelligent and flexibility, etc. For adapting to the characteristics, the introduction of new technology is an inexorable trend, and Geographic information system (GIS) is just one of them. Logistic system depends on the geographical space information greatly, so applying GIS into the logistics management can enhance the all-round control and management of the logistics process, and support efficient and high-quality logistical distribution service. In this paper, the relations between logistics and GIS, the design of key technologies of logistics network based on GIS are discussed, such as the design of logistics network, routing analysis, assistant decision analysis, and researches the recognition and organization of GIS data source, integrated system architecture and the determination of logistics model with the reasonable resolving scheme. At last, a logistics management system is developed under the architecture of system integration.

articleTitle: LDPC codes based on circulant permutation matrices for fast encoding
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper we present a class of algebraically structured quasi-cyclic (QC) low-density parity-check (LDPC) codes which have lower encoding complexity than randomly constructed LDPC codes for the specific structure of their parity-check matrices. Since the parity-check matrices are comprised of blocks of circulant permutation matrices, the storage efficiency can be improved significantly. We also show QC properties and the performance of these codes.

articleTitle: A New Scalable Scatternet Formation for Bluetooth
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper we present a scatternet formation protocol with scalability for dynamic environment. The constructions of scatternet do not need to know the underlying physical topologies and the mobile devices can join in and leave out arbitrarily. If the initial network topology is weakly connected, then our algorithm should guarantee that the resulting topology will be connected. Our algorithm divides the new scatternet into a logical tree structure that simplifies packet routing and scheduling. We also present simulation results that show our algorithm with low formation latency and also generates an efficient topology for forwarding packets.

articleTitle: Rapid long PN sequence acquisition based on fast correlation attacks
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Fast correlation attacks algorithm (FCAA) is a well-known attacking method on stream ciphers. In this paper, we demonstrate that this method can be applied to PN sequence rapid acquisition as well. By this approach, we can acquire a long PN code with a short observation interval. To evaluate the performance of our method, we have performed some simulations. Simulation results show that the performance of FCAA search is close to that of iMPAs [3] search. This method is also significant in complexity reduction compared with full parallel search and serial search. Furthermore our approach needs not to extract the cyclic graphical models, so it can be applied to linear and nonlinear sequence acquisition.

articleTitle: A study on soft handoff in IP-Based CDMA system
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In IP-based CDMA systems, the two key problems need to be solved for soft handoff are data distribution and data content merging. A new scheme is introduced here, using a soft handoff distribute table maintained by the access router. This makes it possible to distribute data accurately, retain multiple base stations (BSs) within an IP subnet, and let mobile station (MS) moves into one subnet without changing its IP address. Strict synchronization could be avoided by using different description of data and setting soft handoff mode bits. Therefore the MS receives the data accurately, and system capacity can be improved.

articleTitle: Merging clustering scheme in distributed certificate authority for ad hoc network
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Ad hoc networking is a new wireless networking paradigm for mobile nodes. Unlike traditional mobile wireless networks, ad hoc networks do not rely on any fixed infrastructure. Instead, nodes rely on each other to keep the network connected. In this paper, we present a distributed certification authority based on cluster scheme for securing ad hoc network. It enhances the efficiency of partial distributed certificate authority (PDCA) and fully distributed certificate authority (FDCA).

articleTitle: The spatial diversity algorithms of carrier frequency offset synchronization for MIMO-OFDM systems
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: According to analyzing MIMO-OFDM systems signal model in the presence of carrier frequency offset, the spatial diversity algorithms of carrier frequency synchronization using one OFDM preamble sub-symbol correlation is proposed. This method is investigated into physical link implementation for carrier frequency synchronization with channel estimation for MIMO-OFDM systems. The simulation results are given in carrier frequency synchronization for MIMO-OFDM systems on wireless multipath mobile channel.

articleTitle: Research on service quality evaluation model and parameter mapping in mobile system
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: This paper proposes a suite of customer centric quantitative analysis method aiming at evaluating service performance in new generation telecommunication service system. Firstly, bidirectional modelling approach is put forward to define the extracting process of information parameters related to service quality and hierarchical service quality evaluation model is established. Secondly, Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) combined with other different judging arithmetic is introduced to perform the mapping of information parameters among sub-layers, thereby the accuracy and validity of evaluation indicators is improved as well as an integrated analysis and assessment of customer centric service quality is achieved. Finally, FTP service over UMTS network performance simulation is examined and the evaluation of FTP service quality is accomplished. The simulation results demonstrate that the proposed approach is rational and valid.

articleTitle: Impact of mesh backbone scheme on capacity of hybrid Wireless Mesh Networks
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Wireless Mesh Networks (WMNs) are a promising technology for next generation wireless networking. Hybrid WMNs, the combination of backbone and client WMNs, are considered as the most applicable case. In this paper, the impact of mesh backbone scheme on the capacity of hybrid WMNs is analyzed in terms of both the per router throughput capacity and the per client throughput capacity. Furthermore, the performances of hybrid WMNs adopting different backbone schemes are compared. NS2-based simulation results are presented to show the throughput capacity of hybrid WMNs with different mesh backbone schemes.

articleTitle: Image copyright protection scheme in E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, we propose a watermark detection scheme to prove whether an image is watermarked, which is based on zero knowledge protocol and public-key encryption scheme. This scheme can be applied to enhance the security in E-commerce. According to the scheme, the owner of an image can prove the customer the existence of a watermark in the image without revealing any confidential information about the original image and the embedded watermark. We will embed the watermark in DWT coefficients which are assumed to follow zero mean generalized Gaussian distribution statistically model. This paper is organized as follows. First, we discuss the statistical model of the DWT coefficients of an image and obtain the testing statistic equation from log-maximum-likelihood function for watermark detection. Second, the zero-knowledge based proving process is shown in more detailed description. Finally, there is a brief analysis and a conclusion at the end of the paper.

articleTitle: Design of general media player
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: With a rapid development of communication and network, multimedia stream technology is adopted in many fields, but currently many media players are developed on DirectX SDK and they are only limited to run on the platform of x86 CPU and Windows OS platform. As video technology is widely used in embedded system, the hardware platform including PowerPC, ARM, XScale, MIPs, ADI DSP, TI DSP, TriMedia and the software platform including vxWorks, Embedded Linux, RTEMS, WinCE, and even no-OS chip require media player. This paper develops a general media player independent of hardware platform and software platform, which has important significance and practical value.

articleTitle: Establishing TCP connections between hosts behind NATs
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Firewalls and Network Address Translation (NAT) devices are becoming increasingly prevalent, and they pose a significant problem for connection establishment for peer-to-peer protocols. This paper proposes novel mechanisms to create direct TCP connections between two hosts behind NATs with minimal help from a third-party. We implement two of these solutions on common hardware within a common environment. Once this connection is established, the applications can communicate with each other using a standard TCP implementation with no further external help.

articleTitle: Wideband dual-band basestation antenna for mobile communication with L&T probes fed
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, we proposed a broadband dual-band base station antenna with L-T probes fed structure for mobile communication. The two-layered patch antenna and antenna array for the CDMA,GSM,PCS and IMT-2000 (824–960 MHZ, 1710–2170 MHz) dual band are studied. In an attempt to enhance the impedance bandwidth, the rectangle patch antenna is fed by L and T probes, and it has been experimentally studied By using foam layers of thickness 0.075λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> and 0.075 λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> (λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> and λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> represent the free space wavelength at the center frequency of the lower and upper band respectively) to support the patches that are responsible for the lower and upper band, an impedance bandwidth(S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf>≪−10dB )of 15.2% and 23.7% have been obtained respectively. The far field patterns are stable across the passband. The antenna array of two (three) units is tested and the results are satisfied.

articleTitle: Real-time audio transmission technology over Ethernet
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The applications based on Ethernet, such as aircraft operation, weapon simulator, increase with rapid Ethernet development. This kind of application asks for a strict real-time audio transmission. This paper discusses three factors of RTP/UDP/IP protocol, data packet transmission and audio data buffer management, which have remarkable effect on the performance of real-time audio transmission over Ethernet. Then the paper presents a set of effective method to improve the real-time capability of audio transmission, and provides the practical testing result of new method.

articleTitle: Simplified way of LMMSE algorithm
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Because of enabling to provide high-rate and high-quality mobile communication service in mobile wireless communication, Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) system has become the focus of study recently. Estimating and equalizing channels in OFDM system is one of the technical difficulties. In this paper, aiming at decreasing the high computing complexity degree of LMMSE algorithm, one simplified way is proposed that the LMMSE algorithm be simplified through the self-correlation matrix of channel impulse response. In other words, channel correlation is neglected. It can be seen from the simulation results that the method can simplify the computing complexity degree to some extent and offer relatively better bit error performance.

articleTitle: Optimum channel quality prediction algorithm over fading channels
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, optimum channel quality prediction algorithm is proposed based on linear Minimum Mean Squared Error (MMSE) criteria. Influence of channel estimation error and average signal-to-noise (SNR) estimation error is also analyzed. Analysis results indicate the choice of sampling time is relevant to Doppler frequency. Due to high complexity of MMSE algorithm, an adaptive iteration algorithm is proposed to predict channel quality with low complexity. Simulation results show that this algorithm can get similar performance to MMSE algorithm.

articleTitle: Adaptive weighted noncoherent receiver for UWB-PPM signal in multipath channels
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Noncoherent receivers are attractive for pulsed UWB systems due to the implementation simplicity. In this paper, a digital weighted noncoherent receiver structure with adaptive estimator for weighting coefficients and integration start point is proposed to alleviate the noise effect in detecting UWB-PPM signals. The detector adopts a square-law integrator, and allows the integrator output captured in different integration time windows to be weighted and linear combined based on the signal contribution within each integration window. Optimal and suboptimal weighting coefficients are derived to maximize the detection BER. Both analysis and simulations verify the effectiveness of weighted processing in reducing the noise level in noncoherent reception.

articleTitle: Sparse underwater acoustic channel estimation with adaptive delay filter
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: When estimating a sparse channel, the standard adaptive filter proposed by Widrow may require a great number of taps, but the Adaptive Delay Filter (ADF) with variable delay taps and variable gains need only a few elements since the delay taps can spread out to track the unknown system. For the purpose of further reducing the complexity of ADF, we adopt a polarity correlator to estimate the time delay, avoiding direct estimation of the mean square error function which is needed by the previously proposed MDRL (Maximum Deviation from Regression Line) algorithm, therefore resulting in much lighter computational load at little cost in performance. Computer simulations on the simulated underwater acoustic channel and data processing of channel measured at sea prove that our method is not only effective, but also has the ability of high resolution.

articleTitle: An end-to-end TCP enhanced scheme for ad hoc wireless networks
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) is designed for reliable fixed networks, so TCP assumes that the reason of packet losses is network congestion, and accordingly triggers congestion avoidance mechanisms. Unfortunately, this is not true for wireless networks where, due to higher bit error rate and handoff, packet losses are more frequent, whereas TCP attributes these packet losses to congestion in wireless networks. This incorrect inference results in frequent TCP re-transmission time-outs and therefore the degradation in TCP performance even at light loads. Firstly, the recent developments of wireless mobile networks with TCP are introduced, and then a new TCP enhanced scheme for mobile ad hoc networks is presented. The new scheme can identify three network states, namely congestion, channel error and route change, from each other. The identification for these network states based on end-to-end measurements is mainly achieved by TCP receiver, which successively dispatches the feedback on current network states to TCP sender via the ACK packets. Consequently, the sender takes corresponding measures. Eventually, the ns-2 simulations show that in comparison with standard TCP, the new scheme greatly improves TCP performance in wireless mobile networks.

articleTitle: A new multimodulus blind equalizer for dense QAM constellations
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Multimodulus algorithms for blind equalization are useful to diminish the undesirable ISI and recover/correct the phase offset simultaneously without needing any rotator at the end of the equalizer. In this paper, a new multimodulus algorithm, to equalize dense QAM constellations, is presented. This new blind equalizer outperforms blind equalizers based on existing Multimodulus Algorithm (MMA) and Square Contour Algorithm (SCA) in terms of convergence speed and constellation eye opening with significantly reduced complexity than that of previously proposed Adaptively Varying Modulus Algorithm (AVMA). The convergence characteristics of the proposed blind equalization algorithm demonstrated by the simulation results for 64 and 256-QAM signal constellation substantiate the efficacy of this new blind equalizer.

articleTitle: Audio-visual 3D speaker tracking
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel audio-visual data fusion approach for three-dimensional speaker tracking problem. The proposed approach fuses audio and video information within particle filtering framework for tracking the desired speaker. The simulation results demonstrate that the integration of multimodel information can significantly improve the performance of speaker tracking system.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation of simplified decoder of OSTBC over fast fading environments
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The Orthogonal space-time block codes (OSTBC) [1] have a very simple ML decoding that makes the detection of each symbol independent. This simplified decoding relies on the channel being static, which is not possible in many wireless systems. Trying to use the simplified ML decoder results in interference. In [2] a simple method of cancelling this interference is presented for two transmit and one receive antenna. This paper will extend this method to multiple receive antennas and examine its performance more throughly. Also, the tradeoff between interference cancellation and noise suppression will be examined. The result is a group of lowcomplexity decoders analyzed and simulated over timevarying channels.

articleTitle: A scheme of choosing DSCLength in cdma2000 1xEV-DO Rev A
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In cdma2000 1xEV-DO Rev A, DSC channel is used to specify the forward link data source which is the serving cell. When an AT perform handoff between two sectors belonging to different cells, the DSC channel can provide an early indication of serving cell change to access network and facilitates seamless cell switching. DSCLength is a key parameter of DSC channel which affects system capacity when AT performing forward serving cell switching. In this paper, we propose a scheme of choosing DSCLength based on analyzing the system capacity performance and the delay caused by handoff with different DSCLength value. The simulation results show that use the DSCLength determined by this scheme can obtain the trade-off between the downlink throughput and uplink capacity, and shorten the handoff-delay at the same time.

articleTitle: Energy efficient clustering algorithm in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: A critical aspect of applications with wireless sensor networks is net work lifetime. Power-constrained wireless sensor networks are usable as long as they can communicate sensed data to a processing node. Sensing and communications consume energy, therefore judicious power management can effectively extend network lifetime. In this paper we propose a mixed nonlinear integer programming model to extend the sensor network life time by clustering sensor nodes into groups. Also, an efficient heuristic algorithm for solving this programming, use iterative method, is developed. Although the problem we discussed mainly concern the energy efficiency, the method can be applied to the case where other objectives and constraints are taken into account. We give a brief discussion on how the algorithm proposed in this paper applies to more complex problems.

articleTitle: An optimal training scheme for MIMO single carrier systems
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, we propose an optimal training scheme, based on MMSE (Minimum Mean Square Error) channel estimation algorithm, for block transmissions over frequency-selective channels with single-carrier multi-antenna systems. Training is optimized in order to maximize the lower bound on the ergodic capacity. Comparing with the existing training schemes, the proposed one is more realizable and has lower PAPR (Peak to Average Power Ratio) with little loss in capacity.

articleTitle: MSON : Media service overlay networks based on SCTP
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: With the advance of wireless personal communication, multimedia applications are becoming popular in mobile networks. Following this trend, we propose MSON, a multimedia service overlay networks Based on SCTP, enabling large-scale live media application in ubiquitous environment. MSON is a comprehensive and scalable solution to flexibly compose media services and can provide QoS guarantees for the resulting contents. MSON consists of a collection of service proxy nodes (SvPs), on which a three-layer middleware is adopted to provide multimedia service functions. For organize the SvPs to find QoS-aware multicast paths in MSON, we presents a hierarchical QoS-aware multicast algorithm (HQMA).

articleTitle: Multimedia product management and service framework
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: A multimedia management and service framework, which is comprised of five parties: Digital Multimedia Product, Digital Multimedia Products Creator, Merchant/Owner, Trusted Third Party and Users, is presented in this paper. It aims to manage multimedia products effectively and provide security service. The functionality and protocols of copyright protection and integrity authentication are demonstrated in details in the proposed framework.

articleTitle: Dynamic adaptive scheduler to improve QoS in IEEE 802.11e wireless LANs
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, focusing on the problem of improving quality of service (QoS) in a mixed enhanced distributed channel access (EDCA) and hybrid coordination function (HCF) controlled channel access (HCCA) scenario, a dynamic adaptive scheduler called DAS located at the QoS-enhanced access point (QAP) is proposed, which schedules traffics to transmit frames in appropriate mode by monitoring the statuses of EDCA mode and HCCA mode in a real-time manner. Simulation results show that the proposed scheduler significantly improves quality of service (QoS) in terms of throughput and delay metrics.

articleTitle: Speech enhancement by generalized wavelet shrinkage
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The wavelet shrinkage denoising can effectively reduce the noise of non-stationary signal but preserve the local regularity. The key questions of wavelet shrinkage are how to choose shrinkage function and threshold value. A speech enhancement algorithm based on wavelet shrinkage is proposed. The generalized wavelet shrinkage functions are built and the Stein Unbiased Risk Estimate threshold value is derived. Noisy speech signals are used for the performance evaluation of the denoising algorithm. The optimal denoising scheme is achieved. The results indicate that the speech enhancement algorithm using the wavelet transform is promising.

articleTitle: Radio frequence identification design and simulation using the VHDL-AMS language
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: High-level RF design based on behaviorally described models using VHDL-AMS allows the evaluation of the performance of the architecture and system at an early stage. It also serves as the top-down design methodology in a familiar circuit design environment. In this paper we present VHDL-AMS based models of reader and tag which are designed to operate in the 2.45GHz frequency band. The models have been implemented and simulated with ADVance MS (ADMS) from Mentor Graphics. We present the results we obtained, in terms of performance and accuracy. The methodology that we deployed increased the confidence in silicon success and allowed on time delivery.

articleTitle: Study on OFDM synchronization by using PN sequence
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper we proposed a complete Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) synchronization chain by using PN sequence. In multi-path channel, the frequency estimation precision of this method is better than conventional method for it using multi-path signals. The result of compute simulation indicates that the proposed synchronization chain based on PN sequences can make precise synchronization in low SNR and also can satisfy the demand of OFDM system at moderate moving rate in Rayleigh channel or AWGN channel.

articleTitle: A new Interest Management in Distributed Virtual Environment
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Distributed simulation enables participants situated in different geographical locations to share a common virtual world, which is called a Distributed Virtual Environment (DVE). Among the different research topics concerned with DVE, there is a current trend of Using Interest Management in the DVE. In this paper we discuss the distributed Virtual Environment systems with large shared state and addresses issues related to interest management and dynamic load balancing. It identifies the efficient partitioning and distribution of the shared state as a key problem in such simulations and outlines a hierarchical multi-level interest management scheme that facilitates dynamic load balancing.

articleTitle: Reception condition and environment enfluence to smart antenna
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Object: Research how actual working conditions influence to communication ability with common and similar smart antenna. Methods: Experimental research, data comparison and the results analysis comprehensively. Test received and sent data-packets successful ratio, and its reception intensity with antenna in USB network device in Windows 98 system, under AP (infrastructure) mode with wireless broadband routers at several channels. It is greatly changing the similar smart antenna position indoors of crowd residential area, under 1 to most several BSs at the same channel. Results: The reception intensity is 70∼76%, even over 90% out of the door, the successful reception packets 14∼20%, even below 10%; sending packets below 10% even 2% between wireless router and adapter only, while signal penetrating through the much impediment walls and buildings. Uplink error is much more than omni ones. A large reflector cannot efficiently raise the performance of similar smart antenna with its own indicate software. Conclusion: It is stronger than common's in the field and less penetrating through impediments that main-directional pattern self-fit antenna for its reception and sending. Synchronous uplink for smart one keeps unblocked communication to overcome wavefront distortion and multi-path interference. The reflector is very effectual method strong signal for common antenna, but not suitable for smart one. Uni-directional antenna concentrates energy for long distance point-to-point fixed communication and weakening signal, so that it suits and penetrates through multi impediments.

articleTitle: Study of navigation based on intelligent avatar with mobile virtual reality
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Recent advances in wireless communications and the hardware performance of handset devices make possible the combination of navigation technology with mobile virtual reality (MVR). In this paper, we describe a navigation method that uses intelligent avatar (IA) and been realized in a distributed architecture. In the method, complicated A* wayfinding algorithm is applied to obtain the set of smell points (SSP) on PC server (PCS), thereafter handset client (HC) will receive the SSP via wireless network and create an IA to lead the user along the route controlled by the SSP. During navigation, the IA can apperceive the status of user's avatar in virtual environment regularly and then adjust its travel speed in order to complete harmoniously the navigation task for the user. Furthermore, the rendering of IA adopts the technology of dynamic impostor and the method of distributed rendering. In order to reduce the occupation of wireless network bandwidth, we present two methods and name them as levels of action (LOA) and simple texture compression.

articleTitle: A new QoS-aware MPLS-based micro-mobility management technology
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Considering the extended use of MPLS in mobile networks, the idea is emerged of applying IP micro-mobility management to MPLS-based wireless access subnet. A new QoS-aware MPLS-based micro-mobility management technology is proposed, where a Local Mobility Management Server (LMMS) storing the information of roaming hosts and several Paging Servers (PSs) are included, capable of providing paging functionality and eliminating the network bottleneck. QoS is guaranteed by static LSP configuration and network reliability is improved with LSP redundancy. Using LSP forwarding mechanism, the QoS grade will remain unchanged before and after handoff. The updated protocol messages are proposed and the signalling procedures of binding update and handoff are elaborated. Compared with the existing schemes, the proposed technology has shown its merits in its high reliability, flexible expansibility and good practicality.

articleTitle: Algorithm analyze and simulate of frequency allocation based on graph theory
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Frequency planning is very important and hard in GSM network planning and optimizing. This article introduces the problem of frequency planning and the past research results firstly. Then propose graph theory to search better frequency planning methods. At last simulate and analyze the proposing algorithm, and compare the algorithm with the exiting GSM frequency planning method.

articleTitle: Simulation-based performance comparison of video transmission over MIPv6, FMIPv6, HMIPv6, and FHMIPv6
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: There has been a recent trend towards an all-IP network as it provides for cost-savings together with optimized network and ease of use. Owing to explosive growth of wireless users and growing demand of wireless services, the internet body IETF has developed mobility management schemes to enhance IPv6 in mobility scenarios for wireless subscribers. These IPv6-based mobility management schemes adversely affect the performance of transport protocols during handoff. In this paper, the performance of video transmission over MIPv6 and recent MIPv6 enhancements, namely, FMIPv6, HMIPv6, and FHMIPv6 is compared. We consider the impact of different parameters like degree of mobility, wired link delay, jitter, error rate, and throughput. Due to the complexity of the required study, simulation is chosen as the most suitable analysis method. The results in this paper are based on simulation experiments performed within the ns network simulator. The simulation environment allows us also to investigate the behavior of the protocol in many cases, e.g., under channel saturation conditions, and considering different traffic sources: CBR, Video, VoIP and TCP.

articleTitle: A New Interference Suppression Algorithm for CDMA Systems
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In [1] [2], a blind recursive least squares (BRLS) adaptive algorithm for interference suppression in CDMA systems is derived. However, this algorithm and its performance analysis are reached in a heavy and complicated way. This paper presents a new and simple algorithm which has the same performance as the foregone BRLS algorithm.

articleTitle: Practical low complexity frequency domain equalizer for IEEE802.16 single-carrier system
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, a frequency domain equalizer is proposed for IEEE802.16-2004 Standard LOS (line-of-sight) single-carrier transmission mode. Transmission packets in this mode are not equipped with CP (cyclic prefix), so technique is needed to decrease the SER (symbol estimation error) caused by circularly de-convoluting a linear channel convolution process. Several structures to apply FDE (frequency domain equalization) are presented using overlap-save processing in different ways based on the FFT operation, which also enjoys the computational efficiency. A new approach is presented by performing sectioning frame processing. Simulation results show that this practical architecture has almost the same performance as the conventional one. The complexity and hardware resources of this equalization algorithm which has been implemented on FPGA can be significantly reduced.

articleTitle: Modeling and analysis of guessing attacks in strand spaces
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: This paper presents an extension of strand spaces that can reason about various forms of guessing attacks on the authenticated protocol based on password. The sequences of attacker actions corresponding to the forms of guessing attacks are modeled composition strands. We present a systematic way of analyzing a protocol for guessing attacks within our framework. In particular, we argue whether randomly guessing values can be infeasible using the concept of threshold probability which is a measure of the system's tolerance. We have illustrated these methods on GLNS protocol as an example.

articleTitle: A maximum likelihood Doppler estimation algorithm for underwater acoustic communication
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The present paper aims to provide an efficient Doppler estimation algorithm for the underwater acoustic communication. A maximum likelihood estimation (MLE) algorithm was derived from frequency offset. The MLE algorithm proposed in this paper estimated Doppler shifts by DFT or FFT, where a well-designed training symbol was used. Several pilot tones constituted the training symbol. The simulation results show that our MLE algorithm is nearly unbiased. And we also present a reduced complexity algorithm, whose performance is very close to the MLE algorithm.

articleTitle: Novel wideband low phase noise CMOS LC VCO
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In order to solve the problem between phase noise and tuning band, a novel VCO was designed on the foundation of the combination of switching-capacitance and MOS varactor. In addition, LC noise-filter was added in the tail current source to lower phase noise further more. The circuit was designed in TSMC 0.18um CMOS process, and simulated by the SpectreRF in Cadence. Under supply voltage of 1.8V, the center frequency of the VCO was 1.8G, the output frequency ranged from 1.430G to 2.134G, and the tuning range was up to 37%. Phase noise was −131dBc/Hz @1MHz and the static current of the circuit was 5.2mA.

articleTitle: Capacity of keyhole MIMO system over non-double Rayleigh fading channels
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, the capacity of keyhole MIMO system over quasi-static non-double Rayleigh fading channels is investigated. We derive probability density function of the quadratic form of complex channel matrix, present some capacity expressions in series sum form for keyhole MIMO systems over some non-double Rayleigh fading channels. Numerical results show the effect of keyhole on capacity of MIMO system.

articleTitle: Active Service based service organization model
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: This paper first introduces Active Service, a new model for discovery and customization of Web service. Based on the analysis of Active Service model and the specific requirement of service organization in Active Service, a service organization model is proposed. The basic idea is making use of meta-domain to classify the services and assembly the service to match the customers' requirements.

articleTitle: Design and architecture of a software platform of the MAC layer of IEEE 802.16-2004 standards
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The IEEE 802.16 standard meets the worldwide demand for a broadband wireless access system to enjoy high-speed and easy link to the Internet. Except for those fundamental functions and mechanisms described in the standard, there leave a lot of things for developers to design for high efficiencies, especially providing QoS (Quality of Service) in this BWA system. In this paper, we first introduce the general structure of the MAC layer in IEEE 802.16 standard. Then we propose a design of a software platform for the MAC layer and apply some simple optional mechanisms in this simulation platform. Moreover, we explore the possibility of testing more complex algorithms based on this platform to better serve the QoS of IEEE 802.16 system.

articleTitle: A novel shadow elimination algorithm for moving object segmentation
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Elimination of cast shadow is one of the most challenging problems in the computer vision. In this paper, we present a novel approach to segment moving objects by shadow flow with GMM and graph cuts. We model the cast shadow on a pixel as shadow flow models that can describes moving cast shadows on surfaces, and model intensity of each pixel as GMM. General algorithm classifies each current pixel to shadow flow, background and foreground. For Moving Object Segmentation, foreground object is the most interest, so we do not tell shadow pixel and background pixel, just tell foreground pixel and no-foreground pixel. A graph containing image information is constructed, in which different weight are assigned to graph edges according to difference between current pixel and background models, shadow flow models. Finally, a dynamic graph cuts algorithm is used to segment the moving objects from background. Experiments show that our approach achieves excellent performance.

articleTitle: Distributed multicast access control in PIM-SM
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, we present a scheme for multicast access control. The proposed solution makes use of the Rendezvous Point(RP) of PIM-SM for collecting and updating keys to implement a distributed shared-key based multicast access control system. We name this PIM-SM based access control scheme PIMac. PIMac supports both receivers and senders access control, realizes host exclusion based on expire time and is compatible with current PIM protocol. Compared with existing solutions, it has a number of benefits such as low join latency, anti-replay and DoS robustness. The results show that PIMac improves the performance of the multicast access control systems effectively.

articleTitle: An extension of sampling theory
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: This paper structures a novelty sampling and reconstruction framework for band limited signal. The conditions under which signal can be exactly reconstructed from its non-uniform samples, more general than the ones presented in [1], are developed. All this enriches and deepens the classical sampling theory.

articleTitle: Component-Based Mobile Protocol Framework
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper we present an architecture named Component-Based Mobile Protocol Framework (CBMPF). In this architecture, all wireless protocols are divided into components by different policies. CBMPF has three parts: Wireless Protocol Component Library, Wireless Protocol Component Development and Test Platform (WPCDTP) and Embedded Operating System for Dynamic Load (EOSDL). Wireless protocol components are the base of the CBMPF. Thus the protocols or part of them on the mobile devices can be replaced by the protocol or components from the remote library in order to use wireless protocols more flexibly and more efficient. The experimental results show that our CBMPF works well for wireless protocols.

articleTitle: A novel blind multiuser detection algorithm in antenna array system
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: A pre-processing blind multiuser detection algorithm based on the least squares constant modulus (P-LSCMA) in antenna array system is proposed in this paper. At first, the signals received from every antenna are used to correlate with the conjugation of the DOA vector of the expected user, and then, the pre-processed signals are applied to the LSCMA. We simulated and compared the proposed algorithm with the conventional LSCMA. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm is superior to LSCMA.

articleTitle: Practical models and control methods with data packets loss on NCS
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Data packets loss is a basic phenomenon of network, and it may affect the system stability in the networked control system (NCS). In this paper, the states and description methods of single data package and multi data packets loss in NCS is put forward, and then an applied compensation and control method is introduced, some of which includes data loss compensator, loss of real time repairing and improving of packet context and self adaptive intelligent control algorithm. The results may be regarded as a main supplement of time-delay NCS. If data package loss problem is treated properly in practical application, it will be sometimes an effective means of increasing system stability.

articleTitle: The study of an iterative algorithm of LS channel estimation in IEEE 802.16e MIMO-OFDM system
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Channel estimation is crucial for improving the performance of the MIMO-OFDM system. In this paper, an iterative Algorithm of LS channel estimation is studied and its estimation performance in IEEE 802.16e MIMO-OFDM system is evaluated. The results of the simulation show that, to achieve the performance that the BER equals to {in1×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup>, it can save 0.8dB compared with the LS method.

Author Keywords: MIMO OFDM LS 1 Channel Estimation M.1225

articleTitle: Study on host and station mobility in BGP/MPLS VPN
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: RFC2547bis-based BGP/MPLS VPN has been widely applied in the service provider's backbone networks. But with the increasing demands of its application in remote mobile working, mobile intranet meetings etc., it is urgent to provide users with convenient and reliable mobile VPN service based on the existing BGP/MPLS VPN networks. The present article has proposed different conditions for mobile application in BGP/MPLS VPN for the first time, and conducted profound analyses and discussions in two different conditions, i.e., the mobile host and the mobile site, as well as specific application conditions, to give a whole set of solutions with great value to the practical application.

articleTitle: Adaptive step-size EASI algorithm based on separating degree
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: This paper focuses on the problem of adaptive blind source separation. After detailed analyzing relevant equivariant adaptive source separation via independence (EASI) algorithms, the paper presents a new adaptive step-size EASI algorithm using separating state as the controlling factor for the first time. Because the variability of the new algorithm's step-size is based on separating state, its learning ratio is chosen adaptively according to separating degree, therefore it can improve convergence speed and reduce the misadjustment error in the steady state simultaneously. Computer simulations confirm the theoretical analysis and show the algorithm performance is superior to other EASI algorithms.

articleTitle: Interpolated signal processing for echo cancellation, precoding and turbo equalization
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Echo cancellation, precoding, and equalization are common signal processing operations performed in wireline communications. For high-speed systems such as digital subscriber line (DSL), the channel response is usually very long and the computational complexity requirement for those operations is very high. In this paper, efficient algorithms based on interpolated filtering are developed to solve the problem. The idea of interpolated filtering is realized with a cascade of an FIR and an interpolated FIR (IFIR) filter, and with a tap-weight overlapping method. The interpolated filtering scheme can effectively reduce the computational complexity while inherits all the numerical stability advantages of the conventional FIR filter. The interpolated filtering framework is then applied to echo cancellation, decision feedback equalization (DFE), and Tomlinson-Harashima precoding (THP). Performance indicates that the complexity of the proposed methods is lower enough such that real-world implementation becomes feasible.

articleTitle: Lower bounds of weights and distances of good LDPC codes
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Since the distance computation is a NP problem, most presented evaluations of LDPC codes are mainly based on the girth numbers of the codes. The computation for the distance of the codes is also depended on the girth numbers. There has been no simple way to obtain the distance of LDPC codes because the code length is very long. Based on generation matrices, this paper develops an algorithm to estimate the weights and distance of LDPC codes. The paper establishes the lower bounds of weights and distances of LDPC codes by using the vectors of generation matrices, which is different from the presented probabilitistic search methods for the weights' and distances of LCPC codes. The proposed algorithm can greatly reduce the searching time of weights and distances. Applying the algorithm we find that some LDPC codes get good BER performance although they are only free girth 4 but of great distances. Simulations verify the algorithms to be valid.

articleTitle: A modified dynamic binary search anticollision algorithm
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In RFID techniques, the dynamic binary algorithm is often applied to anticollision when there are multiple cards in the effective range of antenna. The quantity of anticollision instructions is usually large even if most of the card serial numbers are consecutive, and the reading speed of the reader will slow down. This paper issues a modified algorithm which could accelerate the reading operation of readers. By this algorithm, anticollision instruction will not be sent from readers while the collision happens at the first bit, and the serial numbers of both cards in collision will be obtained directly. Thus the speed of reading operation will be increased greatly.

articleTitle: A novel algorithm to detect link failure of AODV based on 802.11 WLAN
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Because of node mobility and power limitation, routing protocols play an important role in Ad Hoc networks. Many routing protocols such as the Ad hoc On-Demand Distance Vector (AODV) routing protocol have been developed by many researchers, but most of the research is based on simulation. In this paper, we implement an Ad Hoc network testbed based on the AODV routing protocol and find that it takes about 1.7s to rebuild the route after a link along the active route is broken. The time is too long for some application, such as the real time services of voice and video. Based on analysis of experiments, we propose a novel algorithm to detect link failure using link signal strength. The analysis of the algorithm shows that it needs only about 200ms to update the route.

articleTitle: Object-oriented unequal loss protection with product codes for wireless video transmission
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: This paper presents an object-oriented unequal loss protection scheme for robust wireless scalable 3D-SPIHT encoded video transmission using product codes. In our proposed OOULP system, the embedded video bitstream of all concerned video objects are packetized independently for transmission over wireless network. The scheme employs regular LDPC codes and Reed-Solomon codes to deal effectively with burst errors over wireless network. For optimal unequal loss protection, a coarse-to-fine strategy has been used to assign unequal rate allocation to each object within the video:(a) coarse allocation: the inter-object rate allocation assign the rate budget among different objects according to their priority level;(b) fine allocation: intra-object rate allocation provides byte-wise protection to the embedded bitstream of each object to minimize its individual mean distortion. Our proposed framework allows the users to independently access and manipulate the objects with their interests. The simulation experiment shows that the proposed framework is robust in hostile network conditions and therefore can provide reasonable visual qualities for different video objects according to their importance.

articleTitle: An efficient origin authentication protocol for securing BGP
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) is a de facto interdomain routing protocol in Internet. However, due to the lack of the mechanism within BGP to verify the authority of an AS to announce Network Layer Reachability Information (NLRI), a specific IP prefix may be announced by the illegitimate origin autonomous system (AS), leading to the widespread subversion of Internet connectivity. The current propositions either were difficult in operation, or lacked the sufficient security guarantee. In the paper, an Authentication-based Origin Verification Protocol (AOVP) is proposed, which adopts a simple centralized trust model for verifying the propriety of IP prefix origination. Compared with S-BGP and soBGP, AOVP verifies route withdrawal, supports route aggregation and incremental deployment, and needs the smallest memory. AOVP could be more easily implemented and deployed across Internet.

articleTitle: Store and sSearch of trust evidence in MANET
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Trust based security control and resource schedule are an emerging research direction, providing powerful closed loop control compared with traditional mechanisms based on static parameters. Trust relations are built based on some evidences produced by the previous interactions among entities which involve a protocol. However, the crucial challenges are coming to make trust evaluation in the scenario of mobile ad hoc networks, which forms spontaneous formation of a network of nodes without infrastructure. In this paper, we focus on the issues of storing and searching trust evidences in MANET, aiming at improving security and decreasing cost.

articleTitle: End-to-end delay reduction technique for videoconferencing over wireless campus networks
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Videoconferencing not only needs intra-stream synchronization to ensure the reconstruction quality of the stream, but also has real time requirement to satisfy the natural interaction between participants. This paper analyzed the components of end-to-end delay in the videoconferencing over wireless campus network with the objective of understanding how to reduce the delay as much as possible. Then a Network Resynchronization Delay Reduction (NRDR) algorithm was proposed to determine the optimal queuing deadline for frames in the network resynchronization, which dominates the end-to-end delay. The NRDR synthetically considers three performance metrics: the queuing delay, the discard probability of frames due to deadline misses, and the variation of discarded frames, in the attempt to obtain a compromise between the end-to-end delay and the intrastream synchronization quality. In the experiment, it was demonstrated that the NRDR is capable of providing the optimal synthesis performance, according to different requirements of videoconferencing participants.

articleTitle: A scheme to enhance the security of BGP/MPLS VPN
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: BGP/MPLS VPN provides users with security which is beyond or at least equal to the security of Layer 2 Virtual Private Network(L2VPN) which uses frame relay or Asynchronous Transfer Mode(ATM) by realizing separation of address space and routes hiding the Core Infrastructure and resistance to attacks. However, it is still confronted with many problems such as illegal access misconfiguration and internal attacks. This paper analyzes the principle of BGP/MPLS VPN's route forwarding and brings forward a new VPN membership-authentication scheme based on Customer Edge(CE) router.This scheme can detect misconfiguration or deliberate interconnection of different VPNs so that the warning can be launched.

articleTitle: Active network based TCP-friendly congestion control for reliable multicast
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Multicast is the preferred transport mechanism for simultaneously transferring bulk data to multiple receivers. The differences between unicast and multicast, however, bring great challenges to congestion control for large-scale multicast. In this paper, a novel congestion scheme for reliable multicast, called active network based TCP-friendly congestion control, is proposed through introducing active network technology, Hierarchical congestion detection, report and active multi-rate control. Simulations and results show that the proposed scheme can quickly respond to congestion anywhere in the multicast tree, effectively avoid and release congestion within limited part of network and maximize the utilization of network resource.

articleTitle: Communication Peers in a Bluetooth Scatternet
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Mobility, and the fact that nodes may change their communication peers in time, generate permanently changing traffic flows in a Bluetooth scatternet. Thus, forming an optimal scatternet for a given traffic pattern may be not enough, rather a scatternet that best supports traffic flows as they vary in time is required. In this article, we proposed an algorithm suite that enables us to modify the nodes' links and roles. Periodically executing these algorithms helps maintaining the distance between every source-destination pair at a minimum. This will allow for higher network throughput, lower packet delivery delay and nodes'energy consumption, and reduced communication overhead.

articleTitle: Robust image watermarking against geometrical attacks
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Robustness against geometric distortion is one of the crucial important issues in watermarking. In this paper, a new singular value decomposition-discrete cosine transform (SVD-DCT) composite image watermarking algorithm that is robust against affine transformation and ordinary image processing is presented. Applying the DCT to the cover image, we map the DCT coefficients in a zigzag order and padded zeroes to obtain four frequency bands. After inverse discrete cosine transform (IDCT), watermark is embedded in low frequency image by singular value decomposition. Experimental evaluation demonstrates that the proposed algorithm is able to withstand a variety of attacks including common geometric attacks.

articleTitle: Performance modeling and analysis of Hierarchical Cellular Structures
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Hierarchical Cellular Structures (HCS) have become a major requirement in 3G mobile systems. In this paper, a new general bidirectional call-overflow scheme for a two-tier HCS, which allows calls to overflow between the macrocells and microcells and cell selection in hierarchical architecture based on the velocity of the mobile making the calls, is considered. In order to evaluate the performance of such hierarchical systems, we develop an more accurate microcell (macrocell) model which was obtained by extending a Markov Modulated Poisson Process (MMPP) analytical framework based on IPP overflowed traffic from the other layer by a M/M/C/C queueing system which model the microcell (macrocell) overflowing traffic to the other layer. Theoretical analysis and numerical evaluation show that our analytical model is more reliable. In addition, new call blocking and hand off dropping is insensitive to the velocity threshold which is used to assign calls to different layers and may be adjusted according to traffic load in our scheme.

articleTitle: A fast scalable to non-scalable transcoder
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper a fast transcoder from scalable to non-scalable video coding is presented. The transcoder can convert a scalable bit stream into a non-scalable bit stream that is compatible with H.264/AVC standard. It can be used in video servers, which need to provide both scalable and non-scalable bit streams for different devices. From scalable bit stream the motion data can be extracted and used for non-scalable video coding, thus the transcoder does not have to perform the time-consuming step of motion estimation. By reducing requantization effects due to different prediction residuals the proposed transcoder can improve the coding efficiency compared to direct transcoding.

articleTitle: A new formula for the angle-of-arrival distribution in mobile environment
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: This paper theoretically derives an angle-of-arrival (AoA) distribution in multi-path mobile environment where the scatterer distribution obeys a hyperbolic sech function. Detailed comparisons with the well-known Gaussian distribution are given using simulations for varying distance between the base station (BS) and user equipment (UE) and the UE's effective radius.

articleTitle: An improved smart antenna algorithm
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In order to improve the convergence rate of Least Mean Square (LMS) algorithm in smart antenna system, this paper proposes the Frequency Domain Normalized Least Mean Square (FDNLMS) algorithm with active tap detection. By taking advantage of spatial filtering, the proposed scheme promises to reduce the bandwidth required for transmitting data by improving convergence rate. The performance of the FDNLMS algorithm in the presence of multipath effects and multiple users is analyzed using Matlab simulations. The simulations when compared to that of the LMS algorithm, a 28% overall improvement in the convergence rate is observed. The results suggest that FDNLMS algorithm can improve the convergence rate and lead to better system efficiency.

articleTitle: Dynamic resource reservation ordering based on signal prediction priority queuing in all-IP mobile networks
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: QoS in wireless mobile network is one of the hottest topics recently, while RSVP protocol is a key technology. The cell is becoming smaller to provide more service, making handoff more frequent. It is necessary to reserve resource to guarantee QoS during handoff. Moreover, priority ordering is important when many mobile hosts need to reserve resource. This paper presents a dynamic ordering algorithm based on signal prediction priority queuing (SPPQ) to efficiently reserve resource for many mobile hosts. Simulation result shows that the presented algorithm not only guarantees fast handoff but also accomplishes efficient resource reservation, and the limited resource is assigned more effectively.

articleTitle: Joint iterative channel estimation with EM algorithm for V-BLAST MIMO-OFDM systems
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: We study channel estimation for V-BLAST MIMO-OFDM systems over multipath fading channels. A joint iterative channel estimation combining EM algorithm with turbo iterative decoding is presented. The simulation results showed that the performance of the systems became better as the number of iterations increased.

articleTitle: Energy-efficient task scheduling algorithm for mobile terminal
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Dynamic voltage scaling (DVS) is one of the most effective methods to saving energy consumption for battery-operated embedded systems. In this paper, we propose a genetic optimization based task scheduling algorithm that minimizes energy consumption for the case when the task deadline times and execution cycles are given. We construct a general mathematical scaling model of the processor that can be varied either continuously or discretely. Based on this model, a task model and energy consumption model are also provided. According to these models, energy minimization is equivalent to select appropriate scaling coefficients for each task while meet their deadline constrains. A hybrid genetic algorithm, which involves very low computation cost, is introduced to determine the scaling coefficients. The scheduling algorithm is not restricted to scaling types of the processor, inter-task DVS or intra-task DVS, periodic or aperiodic tasks. Experimental results show that the algorithm can reach near 56% energy saving.

articleTitle: A new multiple-frequency millimeter diplexer using microstrip periodic-stub
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, we introduce a three-port microstrip multi-frequency diplexer which can be used in phased-array transceiver system (PATS) and local multipoint distribution service (LMDS) that employ band-stop filters with open-circuited stubs for band selection and separation. The diplexer is designed to take 39.8, 42.4, 44.8 and 47.4 GHz into port 1 and to separate 39.8 and 44.8 GHz to port 2 and 42.4 and 47.4 GHz to port 3 with minimal dispersion. The insertion loss for each frequency varies from 0.4 to 1.2 dB and the return loss is better than 17.5 dB. The isolation between channels at the four frequencies is greater than 30 dB. Each passband created between adjacent stopbands has a bandwidth over 1.2 GHz. The microstrip diplexer is designed using periodic stubs that collectively have the advantages of low insertion loss, high isolation and rejection, wide-band performance on each channel, and easy fabrication. This type of diplexer has many applications in multi-frequency transceivers for millimeter communication systems.

articleTitle: Globally Distributed Locally Centralized Architecture: An efficient and convenient architecture on home network
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Technologies currently available for home network only electronically connect devices in various forms and functions, and provide simple interaction and communication among devices. However, these technologies fail to provide mechanism for efficient and effective interoperation among devices in home network. In this paper, an architecture -- Globally Distributed Locally Centralized Architecture (or GDLC Architecture for short) together with its middleware -- is represented, which can seamlessly integrate home devices and effectively interoperate devices. Moreover, it provides a good way to manage a huge amount of data.

articleTitle: On a dynamic wavelength assignment algorithm for wavelength-routed all optical networks
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Wavelength routed optical network (WRON) is a practicable technology for next-generation high speed backbone networks. Due to the limitation of wavelength resource, it is an important problem in WRON that how to utilize limited wavelength resources and improve the blocking probability of the networks by improving the capacity of the networks. Dynamic wavelength assignment has been known to provide significant improvement of wavelength utilization in a wavelength-routed all optical networks. This paper considers the dynamic wavelength assignment problem and improves a distributed algorithm to solve it. The algorithm is based on the assumption of the availability of equate processing power at the routers and light-paths are constructed dynamically when two end-nodes need to communicate. By introducing pre-releasing scheme and overtime-releasing scheme, novel distributed dynamic algorithm could effectively release wavelength resource.

articleTitle: An simple user-classified method for modeling and analysis of hierarchical cellular networks
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The performance of a two-tier microcel/macrocel1 cellular system with bidirectional call-overflow scheme is studied, where calls are allowed to overflow between the macrocells and microcells, and cell selection in hierarchical architecture based on the velocity of the mobile making the calls. Different from the general layer-classified (macrocell and microcell) analysis, we develop a novel user-classified (fast and slow) modeling method for evaluating the performance of such systems. The user-classified models consist of a fast user model and a slow user model both of which are one-dimension Poisson Process transition diagrams instead of complicated overflow traffic model. Theoretical analysis and numerical evaluation show that our analytical model is reliable. Furthermore, strategies of applying handoff queue using our models are examined..

articleTitle: Towards multi-agent based security in dynamic e-Service market
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, we present a novel model of e-Service market to achieve the dynamic cooperation of the enterprises through the dynamically deploying and execution of the service program on the service execution environment. The service program and service execution environment are separated and provided by different enterprises in the e-Service market. Replication technique will be adopted to enable the service replica to be deployed on the dynamically selected service execution environment according to some policies. In order to ensure the safely accessing to some specific resources required by the service replica, a multi-agent based mechanism is adopted in the selection process to address the secure cooperation among the enterprises in the e-Service market.

articleTitle: The comparison of DF model of cooperative diversity with CRC and without CRC
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper we proposed the comparison of DF(Decode and Forward) model of cooperative diversity with CRC (Cyclic Redundancy Check) and without CRC. From the comparison, we find that in the low SNR (Signal to Noise Ratio) range, that the DF without CRC is better than the DF with CRC, in the high SNR range, the result is reverse. According this result, we can propose the adaptive switch method between CRC and without CRC based on the SNR of each branch.

articleTitle: A new algorithm for throughput maximizing fair scheduling in multi-rate wireless channel
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Packet scheduling algorithm is one of the key technologies in radio resource management of wireless networks. The characteristics of multi-rate channel were analyzed, and a new fairness scheduling algorithm for throughput maximizing in multi-rate wireless channel was proposed. Based on random approach theory, this algorithm can achieve the maximum throughput of wireless system, at the same time guarantee long-term fairness among the users. The setting of the associated parameters is analyzed and simulation is done to test the performance. The simulation results are presented and when compared with round robin algorithm, in the case of many users, the proposed algorithm can efficiently improve the system throughput, at the same time there is no obvious loss in user fairness.

articleTitle: Real-time cooperation intrusion detection system for MANets
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: It is well known that a lot of intrusion detection systems are required for mobile ad hoc networks (MANets). Recently, Real-time Intrusion Detection for Ad hoc Networks (RIDAN) has been proposed to detect malicious activity is less error prone than other detection techniques, such as the behavior-based. However, RIDAN lacks central monitor and cooperation function, the nodes couldn't share information with each other. In this paper, we propose an improved RIDAN based on cooperative idea, Real-time Cooperation Intrusion Detection system for MANets (RCIDMANet). The simulation results show that the RCIDMANet achieves more detecting accuracy and success than the RIDAN.

articleTitle: A novel multidimensional IP packet algorithm
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Since confliction exists in rule database, non-conflict rule database is created at first. Then, based on TSS (Tuple Space Search) algorithm and non-collision hash function, a novel IP packet classification named NCHTSS (Non-Collision Hash TSS )was proposed. NCHTSS strengthens the scalability of TSS and makes TSS can be used in multidimensional packet classification more easily. As can be seen from simulation results, NCHTSS is better than Modular in time complexity and has much better comprehensive performance. Only some disadvantages exist in memory cost.

articleTitle: On the performance of different modulation schemes for UWB systems in a multipath channel
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: This paper is concerned with bit error rate (BER) performance analysis and comparison of TH-PPM, TH-BPSK and DS-BPSK ultra wideband (UWB) systems in the presence of multiple-access interference (MAI) under AWGN channel. Under the assumption of chip-synchronous, we derive analytic expressions for BER with very low computational complexity based on the Laplace transform technique. The performance of TH and DS multiple-access schemes are compared for different number of users and SNR values.

articleTitle: Multiple Scattering centers measurements using the Kumaresan-Tufts method
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The Kumaresan-Tufts (KT) method applied to multiple scattering centers measurements is discussed in this paper. We analyze the particular properties of the KT method which are different with the IFFT method when it is applied to the measurements. The signal zeros of a linear prediction-error filter polynomial are chosen by their locations with respect to the unit circle. Results compared with [1] show that the method used in this paper is more robust than that in [1] with respect to the changes of model order. Results compared with the IFFT method are also given out.
