It is shown that the precision and resolution of the KT method are both higher than those of the IFFT method. The KT method is more sensitive to noise than the IFFT method when the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) is low. But the robustness can be significantly improved by using the mean of the estimates.

articleTitle: Subspace-based single-vector-sensor direction finding for two coherent acoustic sources having real-valued constellations
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Perfect correlations between the three particle velocity components and acoustic pressure of an acoustic source effect an efficient aperture for a solitary acoustic vector-sensor which is able to simultaneously collect the acoustic pressure and three orthogonal particle velocity components. Single-vector sensor direction finding for non-coherent signals is thus possible. For coherent signals, source decorrelation is required by many computationally attractive direction finding algorithms such as spatial filtering methods and subspace-based methods to recover the rank property of the source covariance matrix. Conventional source decorrelation techniques such as spatial smoothing and angular smoothing necessitate averaging of several shifted invariance subarrays, which is impossible for one acoustic vector-sensor. To solve the problem of rank deficiency, a novel method called phasic smoothing is herein suggested and validated for source decorrelation and direction finding of two coherent noncircular signals with one acoustic vector-sensor.

articleTitle: A proposal for a Simple Device Authentication Framework: Design and implementation of novel smart card software and its tools
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In future ubiquitous networks, devices that accept any connections over a network will need to verify the identity of a connecting peer to prevent device spoofing. In this paper, we propose an authentication framework not for human beings, but for devices. The proposed Simple Device Authentication Framework has the advantages of realizing both production-level identity using serial numbers initialized by the manufacturer, and owner-level personalized device attributes set up by users. Our proposed framework employs smart card technology to add an authentication function to a device such as an information appliance with a poor user interface. We have implemented the core component of this framework- novel smart card software and its configuration tools- to achieve device-oriented authentication.

articleTitle: Differentiated mobile IPv6 based on the movement domain
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper a differentiated optimal mobility support in IPv6 is presented in order to provide efficient mobile IPv6 implementation based on the movement domain. We explore the inefficient mechanisms of MIPv6 in current network architecture, and put forward our ideas. Analysis on the new scheme shows that the differentiate optimal mobile IPv6 can lower the cost and raise the processing efficiency.

articleTitle: A novel channel estimation method for MC-CDMA without CP
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: It is meaningful to investigate MC-CDMA systems without Cyclic Prefix (CP) because of its spectral efficiency. This paper extend a superimposed periodic scheme for channel estimation to the equivalent representation for MC-CDMA systems without CP over the FIR channel, a simple first order statistics is used. Considering multi-user cases and the affect of non-zero means, an iteration method is proposed to improve the estimation performance and no extra power is lost. The simulation results demonstrate its effectiveness.

articleTitle: A fast algorithm for wireless sensor networks localization based on Metric least squares scaling
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Accurate and low-cost wireless sensor networks localization is now a very popular research topic. Multidimensional Scaling (MDS) localization techniques have been successfully applied to the problem of node locating. In this paper, a relaxation algorithm which is based on Metric least squares scaling (LSS), a MDS technique, is devised for sensor location estimation. We investigate several variants of Metric LSS and compare their rate of convergence with relaxation algorithm. Simulation results show that our method achieves convergence faster than others at the same expense of computational cost. At last, the simulation results of localization accuracy comparison are given.

articleTitle: Antenna Selection for space time block coded single carrier frequency domain equalization systems
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, antenna selection is applied to space time block coded (STBC) single carrier frequency domain equalization (SC-FDE) system. By choosing a subset of all available transmit or receive antennas, antenna selection can retain the multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) signalling while reducing system cost. Optimal antenna subset is obtained in the bit error rate (BER) and capacity criteria with channel state information (CSI), which is assumed to be well known at the receiver. Transmit antenna selection is fed back through a low bit rate, zero-delay and error-free channel. The system structure is shown and the uplink performance is investigated in spatially correlated fading channels. Some representative simulation results are given to validate the analysis.

articleTitle: End-to-end delivery strategies for H.264 video streaming over 3G wireless networks
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: This paper address the important issues of delivery Strategies for H.264 Video Transmission Over 3G wireless Networks. By taking the time-varying wireless channel condition and H.264 video streaming structure characteristics into account, we implement JSCC(joint source and Channel codec) based on measuring packer loss-ratio. First, we present an end-to-end transport architecture for H.264 video streaming over 3G Wireless Networks. Second, we analyzing error resilience tools of H.264 video streaming which adapt to the time-varying wireless channel condition. Third, we propose a strategies which dynamically estimate the time-varying Wireless network condition by measuring packets loss-ratio and throughout. In the end, furthermore, we present simplified packing strategy in order to enhancing robust of End-to-end delivery H.264 video Streaming. By integrated strategies, we can improve the end-to-end quality of services. The simulation results show our delivery strategies can significantly improve the robustness of end-to-end delivery H.264 video Streaming.

articleTitle: Differential acquisition of m-sequence using sum-product iterative decoding method
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Sum-product algorithm has been considered as near-optimal decoding algorithm for LDPC-like codes. In this paper, sum-product algorithm is used to acquisition of m-sequences. And a special property of m-sequences is utilized to implement incoherent differential acquisition for single path channel. A simplified method to find the correct original phase given the correct phase of differentiated sequence is also proposed. Analysis and simulation results show that the proposed algorithm achieves very good performance.

articleTitle: HSUPA performance with mixed traffic
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, the performance of High Speed uplink Packet Access (HSUPA) with mixed traffic (voice traffic and packet traffic) is studied by a simplified method. The principle of a simple method for mixed traffic study in HSUPA is presented. Then the system including E-TFC selection, Node-B scheduling algorithm such as Proportional-Fair (PF), L1 HARQ and physical channels is modeled for this study. The performance of mixed traffic in HSUPA is studied by the way of qualitative and quantitative analysis with the system simulation results. The peak total cell packet throughput, up to 1.3Mbps for Pedestrian-A 3kmph and 1.16Mpbs for Vehicle A 30kmph, is reached when voice users are not available in the system. More voice users, which have the higher priority in the radio resource allocation than packet users, will lower the total cell packet throughput. The balance between voice users carried on DPCH and packet users carried on E-DCH is needed for the optimum performance.

articleTitle: A novel scheme for suppressing multi-user interference of optical CDMA system
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Arming at the problem of multi-user interference existing in optical code division multiple access (CDMA) system, a novel scheme of suppressing multi-user interference in optical CDMA is presented. It can avoid the case no optical pulse existing while bit 0 is transmitted by adopting a spread spectrum code and its shift as address codes of bit 0 and bit 1, respectively, peak value decision instead of threshold decision is used in receiver to further reduce multi-user interference. The fundamental of it is set forth, optimal optical orthogonal codes are applied as address codes; bit error probability of novel system is derived and analyzed with APD as photo detector. Simulations based on the expression are done. The results show that bit error performance of the novel system can be several orders better than that of conventional system.

articleTitle: Fastpath-based VPN gateway over network processor
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Networks, along with the explosive growth of the Internet, developed quickly and make our lives more convenient and efficient. However, at the same time, people will face much more network security problems such as illegal observation, modification, IP Spoofing, etc. This article proposes a novel type of universal software architecture named Fastpath which is purposely designed and optimized for Network Element (NE) in the Next Generation Networks (NGN), under Linux. Furthermore, it illustrates the experience in developing IPSec-based VPN gateway over IXP425, and offloading IPSec processing to NPEs and coprocessors by using APIs of software AccessLibrary through Open Crypto Framework (OCF). Finally, we investigate the performance issues both internally and externally. Through the benchmarks, we analyze the performance of the system and identify that Fastpath and network processor together can construct a universal and high-functional platform for NE which focuses on network processing.

articleTitle: Channel allocation mechanisms for cognitive radio networks via repeated multi-bid auction
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, we define different rules of channel allocation mechanism for opportunistic spectrum sharing cognitive radio networks under interference temperature constraint. According to these rules, we propose different decentralized cross-layer channel allocation mechanisms based on repeated multi-bid auction. Finally, we show the performances of the allocation mechanisms by simulation results.

articleTitle: A new trust-based electronic exchange system
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Some electronic exchange systems with on-line TTP are fair but TTP might become the system bottleneck. An exchange system with off-line TTP could be more efficient, but it might be unfeasible that disputes could be resolved successfully in external dispute adjudication. This paper proposes a new balance scheme between on-line scheme and off-line scheme. If parties are of high trust degree, the off-line scheme is chosen and TTP's load is lightened; or else the on-line scheme is chosen and fairness is strengthened. This paper also describes the trust mechanism of electronic commerce environment. The adaptations of Zhou-Gollmann protocol and ASW protocol are given to describe trust-based exchange scheme.

articleTitle: The design of magnetic measuring remote node based on wireless sensors network
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: This paper introduces a design of magnetic field sensor remote nodes based on wireless sensors network, which is used in remote magnetic measuring system. The node circuit is consists of nRF9E5 single-chip RF transceiver and AMR sensor IC. The operating frequency is 866MHz, max RF output power +10dBm, receive sensitivity hits −105dBm, and data transmission rates up to 100kb/s.

articleTitle: Quality driven services selecting and performance measurement based on client in video Grid system
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In video grid system, network services are considered as gird resources. Every network management domain has own management strategies and the parameters of quality of service. A video-on-demand service is a composition services which composed of sequential network services and a video Server node service. A video-on-demand service aggregate all the network QoS parameters and the video Server's QoS parameters. Selecting the most suitable service for user task is a problem of multi-objective global optimization. We employ the expansion and supplement of Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process (FAHP) to solve this problem. In our system, the video data packets are transported by TCP protocol. According to the TCP acknowledgment mechanism and utilizing One-point passive monitoring, this paper realizes to measure the network performance parameter of user's video stream on client, such as delay, bandwidth, jitter, and late rate. Finally, an example was presented to demonstrate reasonable and feasibility of these proposed methods.

articleTitle: New safety mechanism of medical monitoring system based on Bluetooth
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, for security problem of medical monitoring system based on Bluetooth technology, we present a serial of improved methods. We use blowfish encryption algorithm to replace E<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> stream encryption algorithm of the Bluetooth standard. The result shows that this encryption algorithm can strengthen security performance of Bluetooth technology.

articleTitle: Automatic video object segmentation using wavelet transform and improved active contour
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, an automatic and accurate video object segmentation algorithm based on wavelet transform and improved active contour is proposed. Firstly, the wavelet transform is applied to two consecutive frames. Then, change detection method and Canny edge detection are applied in wavelet domain. After merging the different edge masks of four sub-bands with union operation, the robust difference edge map of the inter-frame can be obtained. Secondly, the current frame's moving edge is detected and tracked by the difference edge map, current frame edge map, background edge map and previous frame's moving edge. Lastly, morphological operations are applied to the current frame's moving edge to get the outer contour of the moving object and an improved active contour which uses the gradient vector as the external force is used to guide the initial outer contour moving to the actual video object contour. Experiment results show that the proposed algorithm is effective in precise segmentation.

articleTitle: Multiple access performance of ultra-wideband impulse radio in multi-path environment
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, we analyze the performance of the multiple access interference of the time-hopping impulse radio system with pulse position modulation. In particular, the authors focus on the multiple access interference (MAI) performance with SRAKE receiver case, an approximate expression for SIR and probability of error are derived over multi-path environment with additive white Gaussian noise. Our analysis for improving the error performance of the multiple access system provides a feasible scheme. At last, the authors point out that the trade-off among BER, bit rate and multiple users is very important of the UWB system.

articleTitle: Cross-entropy for effect evaluation of jamming to Synthetic Aperture Radar
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The information theory is utilized to investigate the problem of evaluating the effect on jamming SAR. By the means of the entropy to analysis SAR image, we understand that the cross entropy could show the divergence and discrimination information of two kinds of probability distribution. We try the cross-entropy as the rule for SAR jamming effects evaluation. Simulation results of the interference effect evaluation on the SEASAT-A raw data are presented, and the results show that the evaluation rule is effective.

articleTitle: Study of neutrino submarine communications
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Neutrino submarine communication possesses many potential advantages over traditional methods. Difficulties in realizing neutrino communications lie in detecting the neutrino signals and aiming the neutrino beams at submarine directions. A theoretic systems project was brought forward in an attempt to use the deflecting magnetic field to cover a large communication signal range according to the typical requirements of submarine communication. A method to reckon the magnitude of the deflecting magnetic field was introduced. The required volume of Cherenkov detector in receiving the neutrino signals and the event frequency of detecting neutrinos were analyzed; and the flux of neutrino beams was derived. The analytic result shows that it is almost impossible to use neutrinos for submarine communications in terms of the present technology.

articleTitle: A Bayesian approach to robust constrained CMA
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: When adaptive arrays are applied to practical problems, adaptive beamformers can suffer significant performance degradation in the presence of the mismatch between the actual direction of arrival (DOA) of the signal and the look direction of the beamformers. In this paper, a novel robust constrained constant modulus algorithm (CMA) is proposed by using a Bayesian approach, which is robust to uncertainty in source DOA. The proposed algorithm has nearly optimal performance under good conditions, provides an improved robustness to uncertainty in DOA under poor conditions and improves the mean output array SINR. Computer simulations compare the performance of our algorithm with conventional constrained CMA.

articleTitle: A decorrelation technology based on eigen-beamforming in multi-users MIMO systems
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Beamforming technology in the downlink of MU-MIMO promises high gains and efficiency. However, the spatial correlation of antennas leads to a decrease on system performance. In this paper, eigen-beamforming technology is proposed to wipe off the correlation of channels in MU-MIMO. The correlated fading channels are converting into independent ones after beamforming. System performance influenced by the correlation coefficient and the number of multipath is also analyzed in this paper.

articleTitle: A network-based global mobility management architecture
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: This paper specifies a network-based global mobility management architecture, named NetGMM. NetGMM supports network-based mobility management and non-Mobile IP mobile environment. There are two design considerations. The first is that future mobile network requires network-based mobility management shifting the mobility management function from mobile node to access network nodes. The second is that future mobile network will support IP multi-services, introducing a separation between network address and identity of a mobile node entity allow heterogeneous networks to work together without loss of functionality.

articleTitle: Study of antenna selection scheme in MIMO systems
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Antenna selection in MIMO systems is a research hot in recent years, antenna selection can reduce the cost of MIMO system while have the advantages of MIMO systems. This paper provide a new antenna selection scheme: insert variable phase shifter before selection. We also analyze the new scheme, and simulation results show that the new scheme has good performance, select two antennas can have near capacity of full complexity system.

articleTitle: Indoor 802.1x based location determination and real-time tracking
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Location awareness is an important capability for a series of wirelessly-enhanced business and consumer mobile applications. Low-cost devices/software that can be incorporated into a broad range of business and consumer appliances can be used for location determination and tracking. In this paper, we demonstrate a radio beacon-based approach that suggests wireless 802.1x networks can be joined together to provide indoor tracking capability. Our implementation is based on probabilistic and statistical techniques, where signal strengths measurements from active Access Points (AP) are used to estimate the user's location. Simulation results and field tests inside Lancaster University InfoLab21 building show that these techniques can achieve good performance (average accuracy less than 2 m) compared with traditional deterministic methods (i.e. triangulation).

articleTitle: MCMC methods based modulation classification
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, we propose a modulation classifier based on Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods for amplitude-phase modulated signals with multiple unknown parameters such as residual channel effects and noise power. A new Bayesian classifier framework is developed, where Monte Carlo integration is used to approximate the integration of high-dimensional function in the posterior distribution. The proposed classifier is then verified via extensive simulations and comparisons with existing approaches.

articleTitle: The improved space-time MOE blind multiuser detection algorithm
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: An improved space-time MOE blind multiuser detection algorithm is proposed in this paper, which is got through expanding the time-only MOE blind multiuser detection algorithm to space-time domain. The simulation shows that the improved MOE blind multiuser detection algorithm has better performance to combat multiple access interference than the time-only MOE blind multiuser detection algorithm.

Author Keywords: centralized space-time MOE blind multiuser detection

articleTitle: System performance analysis of MRC with unequal power co-channel interference over Nakagami fading channel
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: This paper investigates the system performance for a wireless system employing maximal-ratio-combining (MRC) over Nakagami-m fading channel with multiple unequal-power co-channel interferers (CCI). It derives the exact closed-form probability density function (PDF) and moment generating function (MGF) expressions of output signal-to-interference ratio (SIR). Using the PDF and MGF of the output SIR, the system outage probability and average bit-error-rate (BER) for noncoherent and coherent modulation system are obtained. Some numerical examples are given to illustrate the effects of various parameters on the system performance.

articleTitle: Loss differentiation algorithm for TCP over LEO satellite networks
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Recent growth of the Internet has led the development of Internet services over low earth orbit (LEO) satellites. Despite the progress on improving transmission control protocol (TCP) mechanisms, several studies have reported that conventional TCP over LEO satellite networks have significantly degraded the performance of the TCP protocol. This performance degradation is mainly due to TCP's lack of the ability to differentiate the packet losses caused by network congestion from the losses caused by satellite link random errors. In this paper, we propose an end-to-end mechanism, called SLDA, which based on SACK to accurately differentiate between wireless and congestion losses. Simulation experiments show that the proposed scheme can effectively mitigate the negative impact of wireless link errors on the performance of TCP and provides better fairness compared to the conventional TCP.

articleTitle: Predictive lifetime-based node management in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: This paper presents a dynamic tracking scheme that exploits the predictability of nodes' activity in the wireless sensor networks. A node future activity is predicted by itself. To more realistically represent the various degrees of activity correlation in time, a Gauss-Markov prediction model is used. On the basis of result of the theoretic analysis, we develop a scalable and robust algorithm to cope with the sensor node choice problem for target location under requirements of the cost limitation and high coverage rate. The experimental results reveal that, for not very large sensor fields, the algorithm can solve the node choice problem very well under the requirement of the cost limitation and the complete coverage and also extend the network's living time greatly. Moreover, even in larger sensor fields, it can also find the way to solve the problem with little more time spending.

articleTitle: A cooperative spectrum etiquette for cognitive radio network
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, we propose a cooperative spectrum etiquette for cognitive radio network. The basic idea is to enable mutual information between neighboring radio devices to be shared, which aims at avoiding the classic “tragedy of the commons” effect. Meanwhile, we introduce the concept of clustering into the cooperative mechanisms. We utilize the idea of clustering to provide cooperation between members of the same cluster. Intuitionally, the proposed spectrum etiquette brings about the following benefits, such as low complexity, low delay, as well as alleviating overhead.

articleTitle: Building up active-defending security assurance framework for e-commerce
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Nowadays, security problem has become one of the restricted factors to develop e-commerce. The routine security means is focused on infrastructure, such as firewalls, monitoring tools, or network access controls. But e-commerce system's insecurity problems are ascribed to the insecurity of operating system and the structure of Personal Computer (PC). This article presents an active-defending security assurance framework based on trusted computing platform for e-commerce. The security assurance framework provides the e-commerce system for integrating separate products and tools to meet current secure needs and consolidate internal and external secure requirement, it implements a higher level's defending from the terminal operating platform and controls the insecurity factors at source.

articleTitle: An improved transform domain adaptive narrowband interference suppression technique
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: To suppress the strong narrowband interference (NBI) in the direct sequence spread spectrum (DSSS), a simplified method of the NBI suppression based on wavelet package transform (WPT) is presented in this paper. Based on the power spectrum density (PSD) of the spread spectrum signal and the criterion of energy compaction measure (ECM), this method can track the change of the input signal spectrum and locate the interference in the spread spectrum signal efficiently and quickly, and then change the tap weight adaptively to suppress the strong or weak NBI separately. The simulation results show that the adaptive interference suppression method can eliminate the fast time change strong NBI and decrease the useful information loss during the processing. So the anti-interference performance of the system will be improved.

articleTitle: A logless fast IP traceback scheme against DDoS attacks in wireless ad-hoc network
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Distributed denial-of-service attacks have become the major threat to wireless ad-hoc network. IP traceback plays a key role during defence against DDoS attacks. Several traceback schemes have been proposed for Internet, but they can not be directly applicable to wireless ad-hoc networks, where the nodes are mainly devices with limited bandwidth, computational resource, and unpredictable routing behaviors. In this paper, based on the probabilistic packet marking mechanism we proposed a logless fast IP traceback scheme, which has faster traceback speed than previous work and can be applicable to source traceback in wireless ad-hoc networks.

articleTitle: Research on direct conversion receiver technology and performance analysis
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The direct conversion receivers have advantages of low lost, low power dissipation and high integration, so their application has been getting widely attention. This paper gives an introduction of DCR theory, focuses on the key technology problems of DCR such as DC offset, I/Q mismatch, even-order distortion and so on. The solution to the problems is also given in the paper. The paper provides an analysis of the effect of RF front end on the performance of DCR. In the last, the performance of DCR is simulated through ADS.

articleTitle: A novel adaptive Independent Component Analysis algorithm
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: A novel adaptive Independent Component Analysis (NAICA) algorithm is proposed which can separate the mixture of super- and sub-Gaussian sources. Two novel models are proposed to estimate the probability density function of super- and sub-Gaussian sources respectively. In the framework of natural gradient, the parameters of two models are adaptively manipulated by online kurtosis learning. Applied to the mixture of images and speeches, experiments give good performance of NAICA algorithm.

articleTitle: The limit effect of Inter Pulse Interference on the highest realizable rate of I-UWB
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Inter Pulse Interference (IPI) will increase with improvement of transmission rate of an Impulse Ultra-Wide Band (I-UWB) system, and worsen the Symbol Error Rate (SER), so that restricting to the highest realizable rate. The limit function of IPI to the highest realizable rate of I-UWB is analyzed. Firstly, the estimated formula of IPI of I-UWB is derived, and then, the worsening effect on SER of IPI with the increase of transmission rate under the four channel modes that defined by IEEE is simulated. The results show that, if the SER is required to be lower than one in a thousand, due to the IPI effect, the highest transmission rate that the system can realize is only a few percent of the transmission bandwidth.

articleTitle: Constrained list Viterbi algorithm and its application in image transmission via noisy channels
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The Viterbi algorithm (VA) is a maximum likelihood (ML) decoder for convolutionally encoded data. A more advanced decoding method is list Viterbi algorithm (LVA) which produces the list of the L best output sequences over a certain block length in decoding a terminated convolutional code. The constrained Viterbi algorithm (C-VA) is a method proposed to makes full use of the information of the known correctly decoded bits. In this paper, advantages of these two methods are completely exploited together in image transmission. Simulation results show that the decoding complexity can be reduced dramatically and the performance can be improved greatly by using constrained list Viterbi algorithm (CLVA).

articleTitle: Study on ADBF at subarray level with sidelobe suppression performance
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: ADBF at subarray level has important applications in phased array radar. By generalizing the ADBF at element level we can get the conventional ADBF at subarray level, but its disadvantage is that the sidelobe level of adaptive pattern is much higher. And that MOD method can suppress sidelobe level well, but introduces biggish SINR loss. This paper combines the conventional ADBF at subarray level and MOD method, which can suppress the sidelobe level of adaptive pattern effectively and improve SINR compared with MOD. Simulation results indicate the validity of the introduced method.

articleTitle: Multi-metric QoS Routing based on Fuzzy Theory in Wireless mesh network
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: A novel traffic engineering routing algorithm called Multi-metric QoS-aware Routing based on Fuzzy Theory (MQRFT) is proposed to solve traffic management problem and achieve a good trade-off between QoS provision and network performance based on DSR. The simulation results show that the protocol can improve the performance of managing network congestion effectively in terms of delay, overhead and average throughput.

articleTitle: Reduced complexity receiver based on MIMO systems
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The VBLAST architecture has been proposed as an extremely spectral efficient tool for wireless communications. However, owing to the error propagation, the performance of VBLAST is constrained by the accuracy of the symbols recovered in the previous layer when the traditional detection successive interference cancellation (SIC) algorithm is applied. The performance of VBLAST depends on the performance of the first detected layer. So we proposed a new reduced complexity scheme that the first layer is detected with iterative method and others layers is detected using linear MMSE detection. .The proposed algorithm reduces the error propagation, and the performance of the first detected layer is improved. Simulation result shows that the first detected layer may achieve about 1.5dB gain at t 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup> error bit rate compared to MMSE-VBLAST.

articleTitle: Differentially coherent acquisition algorithm for indoor GPS
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The acquisition of weak signal is a time consuming process for a GPS receiver. If the acquisition is slow, the cold-start and warm-start time is long and the information passed to the tracking program obtained from old data may be out-of-date. Differentially coherent combining of correlation results is proposed for the acquisition of weak GPS signals. It is shown that GPS signals down to −177dBW can be acquired in 200msec without any assistance data and the need for a complex FFT post-processing of correlation results is avoided. Based on the scheme, a novel adaptive threshold algorithm is presented, which can automatically adjust the threshold according to different satellite signal power.

articleTitle: Algorithm for cell search in OFDMA downlink
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: One essential stage in Orthogonal frequency-division multiple access (OFDMA) downlink (DL) is cell search, which is the initialization for user's access to Base Station (BS). This paper proposes an advanced cell search preamble frequency structure based on Constant Amplitude Zero Auto-Correlation (CAZAC) sequence. This scheme spends much lower computational complexity than the conventional cell search method, while efficient cell search performance is achieved. From the result of simulation, this modified preamble structure effectively enhances the user's capability of cell identification, especially for users at the cell boundary even with low SNR.

articleTitle: Scheme of dual dynamic threshold guard channel for access control
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: A dual dynamic threshold access scheme for handoff prioritization is proposed. By dynamically adjusting the value of both thresholds, the system resource utilization can be improved with a better overall system award. Two-dimensional Markov process traffic models for cellular mobile systems are formulated and analyzed. It is verified by the numerical simulations that the DDT-GC-VBR scheme can provide the necessary service guarantee. At the same time, it can decrease the handoff dropping probability and forced termination probability, while improve the system resource utilization.

articleTitle: A fiber magneto-optical switch for NGN
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: A fiber magneto-optical switch is presented by using a 2×2 single-mode fiber coupler and magnetic fluids. By controlling the coupling ratio of the coupler related with magnetic fluid refractive index, the optical switch function can be carried out.

articleTitle: Multi-scaling behaviors in internet traffic
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Scaling refers to the absence of a particular characteristic time scale controlling a stochastic process. The literature on network traffic widely agrees with a mono-scaling Gaussian self-similar traffic model at the large time scales. In this paper, several studies are performed on the Internet traffic. The results show that differs from traditional works, the traces exhibit a multi-scaling, non-Gaussian Poisson behavior at the sub-second time scales. So, we claim that a non-stationary Poisson model needs to be taken into account when modeling network traffic at the sub-second time scales.

articleTitle: PAPR reduction using combined selected mapping and RM code in OFDM-CDMA system
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The OFDM-CDMA system has a high performance characteristic of both OFDM (Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing) and CDMA (Code Division Multiple Access). However it has a significant drawback, the very high peak to average power ratio (PAPR). A modified selective mapping (SLM) technology is introduced in this paper. This technology combines SLM, which aims at PAPR reduction, and RM code, which is excellent and flexible in error control. Simulation results in the paper show to us that the proposed technology can reduce PAPR and improve the error performance considerably.

articleTitle: Security audit logs for IDS
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: To implement audit logs security, the traditional technique was encryption, but the encrypted logs were difficult to partially search and verify. In this paper, a searchable security audit alert logs scheme for IDS was proposed. The hash chain and encryption technology were used to implement the forward security, i.e. in the event that an attacker captures the IDS host, it was impossible for the attacker to read, undetectably modify, or destroy the log entries generated prior to the logging machine's compromise. Moreover, the characteristics of IDS alert log entries were used to build security indexes. With these indexes, the searcher and verifier can search and verify the log entries by recorder number, time stamp, source IP address, destination IP address, and type.

articleTitle: Mitigating NLOS error for UWB Positioning System
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The Ultra-Wideband Positioning System service of wireless communication industry has become a popular issue in the recent years. This service can provide an accurate location for many useful functions. The main problem that causes the two major errors are: measurement error, and NLOS (Non-line-of-sight) error. Especially the NLOS errors have the most serious effect on mobile position system. This paper will put a high emphasis on how to mitigate the error caused by NLOS. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can reach a high accuracy even in a severe environment.

articleTitle: A novel method of twiddle factor generation of the FFT processor for OFDM system
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The generation of twiddle factor is an important part in FFT processor design. This paper presents a new method using small ROM spaces and a few control logic to generate twiddle factor in radix_4 FFT processor. The FPGA simulation results show that it can satisfy the high speed and real time requirement of the pipeline FFT processor.

articleTitle: A fast fixed-base comb method resistant against SPA
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: According to the fixed-base comb method's features, this paper apply the direct computations of 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k</sup>P and 2P+Q to the comb method's precomputation and evaluation stage respectively. Taking advantage of trading inversions for multiplications, the improved method is able to obtain about 73%∼83% improvement in precomputation stage and a range of 38%∼43% in evaluation stage over prime field, furthermore, our improved method is resistant to simple power analysis by pretreating the scalar k.

articleTitle: A 4.6GHz PLL with automatic frequency calibration based on multiple-pass ring oscillator
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: A good-performance high-frequency Phase Locked Loop using a ring oscillator is described. A Voltage Controlled Oscillator with automatic calibration of frequency fluctuated by process and temperature variations is proposed. The VCO adopts new multiple-pass loop to improve frequency with unchangeable stages (phases). The circuit is implemented with TSMC 0.18um standard CMOS technology and power supply is 1.8V. Cadence and Matlab tools are both used to present credible transistor and behavior simulation results.

articleTitle: A novel content based JPEG2000 coding scheme for codestream extraction
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, a new content based JPEG2000 coding scheme for codestream extraction is proposed. In this scheme, we can assign any bit-rate to any number of regions with any shapes, and for the efficiency of compression, different content region (such as natural image, graph or text image) can be compressed in any set order and using different visual-weights mechanism. Most importantly, for the source file compressed using this scheme, we can extract codestream of different region from it more easily and quickly, which enables this scheme applicable in many fields. For example it can simplify many interactive applications dramatically.

articleTitle: An accurate rate control for low-delay video communications using lookup tables
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The entropy of quantized DCT coefficients has the one parameter—the standard quantization parameter (θ) that is the ratio of quantization step to MAD. We have observed that the coding bits of macro block can be precisely estimated using θ value. Two fixed lookup tables, i.e. θ-table and rate-table is created offline with extensive experiments. Using the two tables, we propose a simple and effective rate control algorithm and implement it in H.263+. Simulation results show that the proposed rate control algorithm outperforms TMN8 in terms of PSNR, buffer steadiness and frame skipped. Meanwhile the computational complexity of our algorithm is very low.

articleTitle: Neighborhood-based distributed topological hole detection algorithm in sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Topological holes in sensor networks usually indicate the region where nodes are depleted or not dense enough due to kinds of reasons. In this paper, we study the problem of detecting topological holes in wireless sensor networks. Those sensor nodes have no geographic location information and have a limited communication range. We present a novel distributed topological holes detection algorithm which is based purely on the logical communication topology graph. By exchanging information with its 1-hop and 2-hop neighbors, each node can independently decide whether it is on the boundary of a hole. Those boundary sensor nodes together could describe the region of the topological hole. Experimental results show that our distributed algorithm is effective in exploiting those characteristics of those nodes on the boundaries of holes. And thus it could identify those holes in sensor networks of moderate node densities.

articleTitle: Linear programming in multi-user scheduling for MIMO broadcast channels
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: This paper works on multi-user scheduling for MIMO broadcast channels with large-scale fading. A new approach based on linear programming is taken to the problem. Optimal solution of the linear program always exists and can be implemented as a time-division scheduling, which is optimal under the same transmitting scheme. By analysis and Monte Carlo simulation, several properties of the optimal solution and the practicability of this scheduling are shown. Performances of different transmitting schemes under this scheduling are also analyzed and compared.

articleTitle: A novel improved AODV algorithm based on cross-layer mechanism in wireless mesh network
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Wireless mesh networks (WMNs) suffer from random variations in channel condition. This leads to poor performance in multi-hop wireless mesh networks specially with a conventional routing. To cope with instability of wireless links, new routing metrics must be explored. In this paper we propose a new end-to-end Bit Error Rate (BER) aware metric for multi-hop wireless routing and take hop number into account. We show that using this metric in AODV protocol improves the performance of routing in terms of end-to-end delay and throughput in comparison to minimum-hop count metric.

articleTitle: A novel structure of MIMO-Turbo CDMA system
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: A novel structure of CDMA system is proposed in this paper. Combined with MIMO technique, Turbo en-decoding is used based on the CDMA system, which works well under the enviroments of multiuser and multipath. In this improved CDMA system, the data flow transmitted to one mobile user is divided into two substreams, and each substream is encoded by different Turbo encoder and spread by the same spreading code respectively. The spread data flows are sent to two transmit antennas at base station; while the mobile user despreads and decodes two data flows received from two receive antennas by the same matched filters and two corresponding Turbo decoders respectively. Although Turbo coding will decrease transmit code ratio, MIMO technique compensates the loss of frequency efficiency caused by Turbo codec with channel multiplexing, so the good BER performance is obtained as well as the full transmit rate without much more additional complexity. The paper analyzes the performance of MIMO-Turbo CDMA systems theoretically and experimentally under such conditions of multiuser and multipath. The simulation results show that the novel CDMA systems can be of better performance than the conventional CDMA systems based on single transmit antenna at a base station.

articleTitle: Call admission control under QoS constraints using NeuroEvolution of topologies
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, we solve the call admission control (CAC) problem in a cellular network via a form of NeuroEvolution algorithm. The results are compared with Complete Sharing scheme, which allows all types of traffic to access all available channels at all time, and show that our proposed CAC scheme CN can reduce the handoff failure subject to several predefined Quality of Service (QoS) constraints: the handoff dropping probability (CDR) and intra-class fairness are all guaranteed within the predefined constraints. Additionally, the numerical results shows that under the same handoff failure constraint, better fairness causes higher new setup calls blocking probabilities (CBR) and lower CDR, therefore the fairness and maximizing revenue are two opposite goals, and the fairness and CDR do not conflict with each other.

articleTitle: 5.8GHz broadband channel characteristic analysis using measurement data
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Measurements of Urban microcell channels with 20MHz bandwidth at 5.8GHz frequency have been performed in indoor and outdoor environments. By analyzing the measurement data, the general channel characteristics have been extracted. At the same time, we design a simple 2×2 MIMO channel sounder, with which the spatial-time channel model has been extracted. Compared with SCM (Spatial Channel Model), it provides references on channel model, system design and evaluation for China B3G system.

articleTitle: Redirect-based routing optimizing method on structured P2P network
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: This paper describes a routing optimizing method on structured P2P network. By utilizing redirect mechanism, it gradually gathers the nodes' information at the same sub-network, thus it dramatically reduces the average searching path length, and it does not introduce more traffic into the network. It successfully solves the mismatching problem which disturbs the structured P2P network for a long time in a different way.

articleTitle: A routing protocol for low energy wireless sense network
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Real-time monitoring for mine is a special application of wireless sense network. A improved protocol is presented especially with respect to power consumption compared with mobile adhoc network. Considering making full use of existing resources e.g. routing table, packet format, three ideas, including reversing routing, dynamic sink node, special route request and repeat, are adopted. From analyzing the simulation result by OPNET, the improved protocol reduces the consumption of energy significantly and prolongs the lifetime of nodes efficiently. Open issues and resent research of sensor network are also discussed.

articleTitle: A computationally efficient subband noise estimation algorithm for speech enhancement
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, a computationally efficient subband noise estimation algorithm for speech enhancement is presented. The noisy speech is decomposed into critical band signals and the subband noise estimation is updated by an improved minima controlled recursive averaging (IMCRA) approach. Compared to the classical IMCRA approach, the proposed subband noise estimation can exploit the human ear perceptual properties and lead to significant computational savings. Experimental results show that the proposed approach has comparable performance with lower computational requirements.

articleTitle: The design of high performance dual modulus divider-by Prescaler
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, a novel design plan of divider was presented. In the higher frequency band, M/S DFF structured by CMOS SCL were used to divide to satisfy the high-speed command; in the lower frequency band, DFF with self-latch function were used. This structure not only has locked function but also has less MOS transistors than M/S DFF. So it satisfies the command of lower power and noise. The whole system could realize high-speed, low power, and low-jitter. The circuit was simulated by Cadence Spectre under the CMOS technology of TSMC 0.18um. It was shown that the highest frequency of the divider is up to 5GHz. When T=27 °, VDD=1.8V, f=5GHz, the power consumption of the circuit was only 4.32mW(1.8V×2.4mA).

articleTitle: An all digital DSSS satellite navigation & position transceiver design and VLSI implementation
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The considerations of hardware implementation on an all digital direct-sequence spread spectrum (DSSS) satellite navigation & position transceiver is discussed, including function partition, parameter determination and architecture optimizing. The characteristic of this transceiver lies in directly sampling to the A/D intermediate frequency signal after down-conversion. The digital signal after sampling is dealt with the baseband processing consisting of FPGA and DSP. To achieve the balance between fast acquisition and minimum hardware consumption, the transceiver employs a sliding correlator acquisition strategy and adaptive detection threshold, and the resultant correlator complexity is reduced by structure optimization. The overall architecture is very suitable for VLSI implementation. The design has been implemented on Altera Cyclone EP1C12Q240I7 FPGA device and TI TMS320VC5416 DSP device. The project results show that this modern approach is not only rational and feasible but also abundant in dependability considerations. It can satisfy the requirements for the design index, and has certain surplus.

articleTitle: Face recognition based on two-phase 2DLEM
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Some research efforts have shown that face images possibly reside on a nonlinear sub-manifold. This paper proposes a new feature extraction method, Two Dimensional Laplacian Eigen-Map, (2DLEM), which especially considers the manifold structures of the face images, and extracts the proper features from image matrix directly by using a linear transformation. 2DLEM has a disadvantage that it requires more coefficients for image representation as 2D feature extraction algorithms have. In this paper, we propose a two-phase framework to overcome the disadvantage. The experiments on the ORL database show that 2DLEM achieves the best performance, and the two-phase framework can reduce the dimension effectively.

articleTitle: The study of performance improvements by implementation of RFID in the information production agent
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The RFID applications has been granted high attention and expectation especially since Wal-Mart Stores Inc. announced that they are implementing RFID technology and asked their top 100 vendors ready for deploying RFID before January 2005. More and more benefits are found to be believed to become next revolution of industry.

articleTitle: Receiver design for WLAN systems with packet binary convolutional coding (PBCC) transmission
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: For WLAN systems that adopt PBCC modulation, reduced-state equalization algorithms are generally used to reduce the computation burden of MLSE. Such equalizers have only high performance, if the overall discrete time system to be equalized is minimum phase. The receiver design of using whitened matched filter (WMF) as the pre-filter and adopting M-algorithm to conduct the following equalization is presented. WMF can transform the channel impulse response (CIR) into its minimum phase equivalent. Computation burden can be reduced greatly by setting proper parameters for M-algorithm. Computer simulation results indicate that when such receiver design is adopted, satisfactory performance can be obtained under various kinds of channel conditions. Thus it shows good prospect in real applications.

articleTitle: Comparative study of EFCM algorithm
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Clustering is a procedure through which objects are distinguished or classified in accordance with their similarity. A new clustering algorithm (EFCM) is proposed by extending the criterion function, which includes the well-known fuzzy c-means method as its special case. Convergence of EFCM algorithm is also proposed in this paper. Numerical experiments show that the new clustering algorithm is less sensitive than the traditional FCM method and robust to outliers.

articleTitle: Improved channel estimation using noise reduction for MB-OFDM UWB systems
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The channel estimation is a crucial issue for ultra-wideband (UWB) systems based on the scheme of multi-band OFDM (MB-OFDM), where coherent detection is employed in a general way. The accuracy of channel identification is limited by noise in a certain extend, therefore, measures for noise reduction should be taken. This paper investigates how the performance of a least square (LS) channel estimator can be improved by estimating and suppressing the noise in the signal subspace, according to the property of the UWB channel in a MB-OFDM system. This algorithm of noise reduction is based on the processing of correlation between the noise within and outside the channel impulse response (CIR) subspace. Simulation results show that better performance can be achieved for a range of signal-to-noise ratio (SNR).

articleTitle: Small signals measuring system based on in-system programmability programmable analog circuits
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper a kind of small signals measuring system is designed. The system makes use of in-system programmability programmable analog circuits ispPAC10 to accomplish the design in the analog front end which includes multipath selection, amplification, adjusting (signal smoothing, integration and summing) and buffering circuits. The integrity small signal measurement system which is composed of IspPAC10, self-zero network, single-chip computer and ADC can control the gain and display the measurement values with LED.

articleTitle: An improvement to a geolocation algorithms in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Location awareness is important in many wireless sensor networks. In sensor networks because of the size, weight, battery life and price some nodes (e.g. GPS-equipped nodes) are self-located but all other nodes have to determine their locations by communication with location-aware neighbors. The classical distance-based technique for location determination is triangulation/lateration (referred to as 3NA for short), which determines the location of a node by communication with three neighbors. In 2004 Barbeau et al proposed an algorithm, referred to as 2N+aB for short, that can locate a location-unknown node using two location-aware neighbors plus certain information from a third adjacent location-aware node. In this paper an improvement to Barbeau et al's algorithm, referred to as 2N+cB for short, is proposed. Our computer simulations show that for randomly deployed low-density sensor networks 2N+cB can increase the number of located location-unknown nodes by at least 31% compared with 2N+aB, and the average increase achieves 43.6%. Besides, we give an analysis of 3NA, as an example for the analysis of 2N+aB and 2N+cB, and our simulation result well matches the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: A low complexity differential modulation using quasi-lrthogonal space time block codes
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this letter, we propose a differential detection scheme based on quasi-orthogonal space-time block codes where neither the transmitter nor the receiver knows the Channel State Information(CSI). Simulation results and complexity analysis show that the proposed scheme has good performance and low computational complexity.

articleTitle: A study on the coverage problem in wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In wireless sensor network, one of the fundamental issues is coverage. The coverage problem is discussed in this paper. The effective coverage for the monitored areas or targets provided by sensor networks is a very important criterion of their effectiveness. In this paper, we study the types of the coverage problem according to the deployment of the networks, the characters of monitored areas or targets, the sensing models of sensor nodes and so on. Furthermore, an algorithm is also proposed in order to improve the coverage performance of the networks. The algorithm can move redundant nodes to uncovered or weak-covered areas by the mobility of the nodes. Although there are some limits of energy and node hardware, the algorithm is still effective in practice.

articleTitle: An effecient algorithm for MIMO detection
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: We derive a novel algorithm which can judge out whether the output of the simple detector reliable or not for MIMO detection. In our detection, the initial estimates are obtained by the simple detector, judged by reliability judge rule (RJR) with a threshold. If the estimate satisfies the RJR, we consider the estimate as the final result. Otherwise, the estimates will be through the advanced detector for further improvement. We also give two methods to compute the threshold of RJR, using which we can achieve near the performance of the advanced detector at greatly reduced complexity. Simulation results prove the performance of the proposed algorithm, and the performance-complexity tradeoff can be achieved by adjusting the threshold of RJR.

articleTitle: Capacity analysis and link design of CDMA mobile satellite system
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: This paper integrates the power limit and the interference limit on capacity of CDMA systems, and derives the equations by which the capacity of a CDMA system can be calculated using key system parameters. Then it discusses the relationship between system capacity and link margin, and designs the link parameters with a trade-off capacity and key parameters on-board.

articleTitle: An improved iterative detection method for serially concatenated CPM
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, an improved iterative detection method based on the exchange of weighed extrinsic information probability for Serially Concatenated Continuous Phase Modulation (SCCPM) system is proposed. The method could reduce the phenomena of positive feedback during iterative detection by adaptively adjusting the extrinsic information probability. Simulation results show that the proposed method is effective and SCCPM systems with the improved iterative detection method have excellent power and bandwidth efficiency in Rayleigh fading channels.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of offset-stacked CC-CDMA systems
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: CDMA systems based on orthogonal Complementary Code (CC) spreading can achieve interference-free performance and high system capacity, which are attractive for future communications. In this paper, CC-CDMA systems with Offset-Stack spreading and high order modulation are analyzed. Bit error rate (BER) expression is derived and the system capacity is presented. The BER performances of CC-CDMA systems are compared with those of DS-CDMA systems under the fair conditions of achieving same capacity with equal wireless resource. articleTitle: An effective knowledge search algorithm in grid environment based-experience
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: How to search quickly and efficiently is very important for evaluating performance of the grid. The paper analyzes the existing knowledge search theories, points out their insufficiency and brings forward a new classifying search method based-experiences & field. Under the assumption of similar interests in the same virtual organization (VO), the proposed approach classifies VOs by specialty field and takes full advantage of search history in organization to improve shoots straight and then reduces searching blindness.

articleTitle: Method to cancel noise in speech based on matching pursuits algorithm in time-frequency domain
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: As the development of the technology of speech signal processing, the robust of the technology becomes more important. In order to obtain the useful information, how to eliminate the noise in the real environments and how to recognize the speech in the noise environments become the important research. With the research of speech signal in time-frequency domain (TFD), a method is proposed to cancel the noise in speech, which is based on that the speech signal has been decomposed by Matching pursuits algorithm. In this method, the signal should be decomposed firstly, and then the characteristic of the speech and noise will be showed clearly with using the sum of Wigner distribution of every decomposed part of signal as the Wigner distribution of the whole signal. In paper, the research has been carried out under the different SNR environments. From the experimental results, it can be seen that the novel approach is desirable in canceling noise, and is more effective than the other conventional algorithm to cancel the white noise in noisy speech signal. At the end of paper, the disadvantage of this method is described.

articleTitle: A communication model of Anycast in mobile IP network
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In IPv6 two kinds of new characteristics are proposed, one of which is Anycast and the other is Mobile IP, and both of which have splendid and prosperous future. In this paper, a new kind of Anycast communication model in mobile IP network is created and this model achieves dynamic Anycast group, allows Anycast members to freely leave and join Anycast group, and in some sense solves the existing scalability problem. In addition, this model accomplishes the distributed maintenance and transaction of Anycast service request and the information on Anycast members so it achieves the load balance. This paper deeply analyzes and discusses the feasibility and validity of this communication model, and argues that it is able to support the large-scale Anycast group in mobile IP network.

articleTitle: BER performance of OFDM system on frequency-selective correlated Nakagami fading channels
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: This paper derives closed-form formulas for the average bit-error rate (BER) of orthogonal frequency-division multiplex (OFDM) system with BPSK signal on M-branch frequency-selective correlated Nakagami fading channels with an arbitrary branch covariance. By using the well-known moment generating function-based analysis approach, the resulting expressions for the average BER can be expressed in terms of Lauricella's multivariate hypergeometric function, which can be easily evaluated numerically. The results are used to investigate the effect of the antenna array configuration (e.g., the number of receive antennas, the antenna element separation), and the operating environment (such as the fading severity, the number of multipath taps, angular spread) on the average BER of OFDM systems.

articleTitle: Interoperable affective context collection using MPEG-21
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The vision of the MPEG-21 standard is to specify a multimedia framework for the transparent delivery and consumption of multimedia content across a wide range of networks and devices. The user plays an important role in this framework. Therefore the optimization of the user experience is of uttermost importance. Context needs to be effectively collected and utilized to optimize this experience and MPEG-21 provides the necessary tools to do so. However, the efficient combination of these tools in order to create a context collection framework, remains an issue which is not tackled by the MPEG-21 standard. This paper proposes a framework, which incorporates affective context collection by combining several parts of the standard, as such creating an interoperable context-aware system.

articleTitle: Research on key circuit in CMOS fully integrated RFID devices
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The cost of the RFID devices has strictly hampered the development and application of RFID. At present, due to the diversity of implemented technology of the sub-blocks in the RFID devices, such as the digital sub-block using CMOS technology, analog circuit implemented in CMOS or Bicmos process, yet radio frequency section using GaAs technology, and so on, especially, the reader including many different functional sub-blocks, that is the critical reason of the cost increasing but also unfit to higher levels of integration. Aiming at this problem, combining the complexity of the RFIC design, in this paper, a solution is firstly enounced that all the functional blocks is implemented in low cost standard CMOS technology, and then it is analyzed how the key circuit modules of the RFID devices is designed in detail. At last some design examples are presented to verify the good validity and feasibility.

articleTitle: Blind equalization algorithm based on forward neural network in QAM system
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: In this paper, an improved blind equalization algorithm based on multiple-layer forward neural network is proposed, and a new transfer function for the neural network is designed. The computer simulations show that the improved algorithm have faster convergence speed and smaller bit error rate than traditional forward neural network algorithm.

articleTitle: A secure mobile-IPv6 network model
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Mobile-IPv6 technology brings us convenient but also produces a series of security issues. Virtual private networks allow two or more parties to communicate securely over a public network. VPNs provide the assurance such as confidentiality, host authentication and data integrity by using cryptographic algorithms and protocols. In this article the concepts of mobile IP was introduced and the security problem was analyzed. A VPN implemented with the IP Security Protocol (IPSec) is presented to protect the communication between Mobile Node and Home Agent. According to special demands of mobile network, a secure mobile-IPv6 network model is presented based on IPSec. With this kind of model the high security and reliability can be achieved.

articleTitle: Sparse channel estimation for OFDM systems based on pilot signals and MUSIC algorithm
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: A method of estimating the channel transfer function is presented for orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) systems over sparse channels. The proposed method is based on the observation that the wireless channel can be parameterized as a combination of paths, each characterized by a delay and a complex amplitude. The amplitude of each path shows fast temporal variation due to the mobility of terminals while the delay is almost constant. This method employs multiple signal classification (MUSIC) algorithm to estimate non-sample-spaced path delays and amplitudes of OFDM symbols. Simulations show that this method outperforms the direct zeros-padding discrete fourier transformation (DFT) estimator by 2-3dB in signal-to-noise ratio (SNR).

articleTitle: Rain attenuation compensation scheme of the Ka band multi-beam satellite communication system
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Rain attenuation is a central problem that affects the communication capability and the ratio of systematic utilization in Ka band satellite communication. Based on the analysis of rain data, the characteristics of vast territory and the disparity of rain attenuation distribution of China, optimized power control method to redistribute the power of satellite transition is presented in this paper, which will compensate the rain attenuation and will improve the ratio of systematic utilization. The simulation results show that good performance can be achieved in reducing the influence of rain attenuation on communication systems.

articleTitle: A simple and efficient approach for post-FFT beamforming in OFDM communications
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: A simple method is proposed for space-frequency channel estimation in an orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) system with an antenna array. The conventional Least Square algorithm for channel estimation in the frequency-domain is applied to each antenna. Furthermore, spatial filtering vectors are directly extracted from the estimated channel matrix for beamforming in the frequency-domain, and the channel compensation is implemented in the spatial filtering. Compared with the existing systems where independent beamforming and channel compensation in frequency domain are conducted, respectively, the proposed method can significantly reduce the complexity of the system without loss of performance.

articleTitle: Application of domain decomposition method and improved evolutionary algorithm in optimization of spiral inductors on silicon
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The rising demand for low-cost radio frequency integrated circuits has generated an increasing interest in planar spiral inductors on silicon. However, several kinds of parasitic effects degrade the quality factor of inductors, so it is essential to choose optimal parameters to gain high Q values under some constraints. Thus nonlinear constrained optimization problem is formed. Calculating inductance with domain decomposition method can avoid tedious calculation for mutual inductance, and handling constrained optimization with stochastic ranking-based evolutionary algorithm can avoid determining optimal penalty coefficient. The paper tries to combine both methods and gains better results in less time. Experiments show that combining both methods can solve the nonlinear constrained optimization problem efficiently and successfully.

articleTitle: Study and simulation of QOS-based routing for wireless sensor networks based on OPNET
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: This paper addresses the QOS routing, key technology to provide differential services and utilize the whole resource effectively for wireless sensor networks. Based on the analyzing of QOS routing for wireless sensor networks, a new distributed QOS routing algorithm, according to the minimum node energies simulation model, is presented. Using OPNET we make some simulation of this model. By analyzing the results we find this proposed algorithm can provide differential services both for real-time traffic and best-effort traffic. Besides, it can balance the energy and cost on the whole network and prolong the network lifetime by up to 500%.

articleTitle: Enhanced securely fair non-repudiation protocol
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
