abstract: In this paper, security threats existing in Multi-agent System (MAS) are analyzed in detail, and security architecture of single agent is proposed aiming at these security problems. Meanwhile the secure framework of MAS based on simplified PKI is designed. In addition, the security mechanisms of MAS are discussed, such as logon and logoff, access control, secure communication between agents and security recovery. The architecture and relevant security management mechanisms can guarantee the verification and non-repudiation of activities of agents.

articleTitle: New algorithms for suppression of narrowband interferences in DSSS communications
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The paper proposes ways to judge whether narrowband interferences(NBIs) exist in DSSS system or not. Through judgment we further estimate the types of NBIs and then different algorithms in accordance with the types of interferences are employed. The existence of the NBI will cause the unevenness of the spectrum of the spread spectrum signal, thus using complex envelope in frequency domain can determine whether NBIs exist or not. In the paper, the nonlinear adaptive prediction and decision-directed Kalman filter are used to suppress the single tone and AR NBI respectively, whereas the multiuser detection algorithm is employed to suppress the digital NBI. The results show that methods proposed in the paper outperform over ones that use single method to suppress NBIs.

articleTitle: An adaptive motion search algorithm based on temporal-spatial correlation
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: This paper presents a new adaptive diamond search algorithm for motion estimation based on temporal-spatial correlation property. Each frame image taken from standard video sequences is separated to blocks, the macro-blocks are classified by a criterion based on temporal-spatial correlation value and the initial search point is then predicted. Different search modes are selected according to different image contents, and the best matching block is gotten in accordance with MAD rule. Experiment results show significantly improved performance in image quality and much reduction in computational complexity.

articleTitle: A model for power spatial-temporal distribution prediction in cellular propagation with low base station antenna
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: A viewpoint that more physical propagation principles should be considered in order to improve the modeling accuracy is firstly introduced. Base on this viewpoint, an enhanced elliptical scattering model (EESM) for predicting power spatial-temporal distribution in cellular propagation with low base station antenna is presented by adding two physical concepts of ‘effective scatterer’ and ‘reflecting probability’ to the geometrically based single bounce elliptical model (GBSBEM). Expressions are deduced for power azimuth spectra (PAS) and power delay spectra (PDS), respectively. The comparison of simulated results with measured results shows that, the EESM has obvious higher accuracy than the GBSBEM in both PAS and PDS prediction.

articleTitle: Precision of TDOA positioning using formation flying satellites on geosynchronous earth orbit
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: Regional continuous navigation and positioning system constructed by formation flying satellites on geosynchronous earth orbit needs relative fewer satellites to obtain high precision of positioning. Space structure of formation flying satellites is steady and the orbits of concomitance satellites around reference satellite are closed, which means high precision of satellite-location in space without frequent orbit trimming. GDOP was introduced to describe ability of system positioning and passive positioning method of TDOA was used to calculate radiant-point on earth. Simulation results show that the positioning-precision of this system is 10 m and even better. The way to achieve higher positioning-precision is baseline-growth and precision- improvement of time measure of signal arrival.

articleTitle: Performance of SFTC MIMO-OFDM system in overlapped narrowband interference
publicationTitle: 2006 IET International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks
abstract: The large bandwidth makes MIMO-OFDM system susceptible to Narrowband interference (NBI) which can severely degrade performance. In this paper, the performance of the MIMO-OFDM with SFTC in overlapped Narrowband Interference (NBI) environment is considered. A new analytical on pair-wise error probability (PEP) is proposed. And the performance is also examined by numerical simulations.

Author Keywords: SFTC (space-frequency trellis codes) MIMO-OFDM NBI PEP
